    13	    ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema.required({ id: true, status: true });

    16	export type FunctionCallOutput = z.infer<typeof FunctionCallOutputSchema>;

    18	export function parseFunctionName(name: string) {
    19	    const match = /^mcp__(.+?)__(.+)$/.exec(name);
    20	    return match ? { serverLabel: match[1], name: match[2] } : undefined;
    21	}
===== shared/agents/mcp-output.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	
     3	const SafeMcpPartSchema = z.union([
     4	    z.object({ type: z.literal("text"), text: z.string() }),
     5	    z.object({
     6	        type: z.literal("resource_link"),
     7	        uri: z.string(),
     8	        name: z.string(),
     9	        description: z.string().optional(),
    10	        mimeType: z.string().optional(),
    11	    }),
    12	]);
    13	
    14	type SafeMcpOutput = {
    15	    content: z.infer<typeof SafeMcpPartSchema>[];
    16	    isError?: boolean;
    17	};
    18	
    19	// Retain usable output and media links without copying binary blobs into
    20	// model history or the public Responses stream.
    21	export function safeMcpOutput(output: unknown): SafeMcpOutput {
    22	    const result = output as { content?: unknown; isError?: boolean } | null;
    23	    return {
    24	        content: Array.isArray(result?.content)
    25	            ? result.content.flatMap((part) => {
    26	                  const parsed = SafeMcpPartSchema.safeParse(part);
    27	                  if (parsed.success) return [parsed.data];
    28	                  if (
    29	                      !part ||
    30	                      typeof part !== "object" ||
    31	                      typeof part.type !== "string"
    32	                  )
    33	                      return [];
    34	                  if (
    35	                      part.type === "resource" &&
    36	                      typeof part.resource?.text === "string"
    37	                  ) {
    38	                      return [
    39	                          { type: "text" as const, text: part.resource.text },
    40	                      ];
    41	                  }
    42	                  return [
    43	                      {
    44	                          type: "text" as const,
    45	                          text: `[${part.type} output omitted; use an HTTPS resource link]`,
    46	                      },
    47	                  ];
    48	              })
    49	            : [],
    50	        ...(result?.isError ? { isError: true } : {}),
    51	    };
    52	}
    53	
    54	export function safeMcpModelOutput({ output }: { output: unknown }) {
    55	    const value = safeMcpOutput(output).content.map((part) => ({
    56	        type: "text" as const,
    57	        text:
    58	            part.type === "text"
    59	                ? part.text
    60	                : JSON.stringify({
    61	                      type: part.type,
    62	                      ...(part.type === "resource_link"
    63	                          ? {
    64	                                uri: part.uri,
    65	                                name: part.name,
    66	                                description: part.description,
    67	                                mimeType: part.mimeType,
    68	                            }
    69	                          : {}),
    70	                  }),
    71	    }));
    72	    return value.length
    73	        ? { type: "content" as const, value }
    74	        : {
    75	              type: "text" as const,
    76	              value: "Tool completed without text or linked output.",
    77	          };
    78	}
===== shared/agents/model.ts =====
     1	import { createOpenAICompatible } from "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible";
     2	import type { FinishReason, ToolSet } from "ai";
     3	import {
     4	    type CompletionUsage,
     5	    CompletionUsageSchema,
     6	} from "../schemas/openai.ts";
     7	import type { AgentUsage } from "./types.ts";
     8	
     9	type AgentStep = {
    10	    providerMetadata?: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
    11	};
    12	
    13	export function createAgentModelProvider({
    14	    baseURL,
    15	    fetch: fetcher,
    16	    apiKey,
    17	}: {
    18	    baseURL: string;
    19	    fetch: typeof fetch;
    20	    apiKey?: string;
    21	}) {
    22	    return createOpenAICompatible({
    23	        name: "pollinations",
    24	        ...(apiKey ? { apiKey } : {}),
    25	        baseURL,
    26	        fetch: fetcher,
    27	        metadataExtractor: {
    28	            async extractMetadata({ parsedBody }) {
    29	                return {
    30	                    pollinations: {
    31	                        completionUsage: completionUsageFromBody(parsedBody),
    32	                    },
    33	                };
    34	            },
    35	            createStreamExtractor() {
    36	                let usage: unknown;
    37	                return {
    38	                    processChunk(chunk) {
    39	                        if (
    40	                            chunk &&
    41	                            typeof chunk === "object" &&
    42	                            "usage" in chunk &&
    43	                            chunk.usage != null
    44	                        ) {
    45	                            // Providers may send provisional counts before final usage.
    46	                            usage = chunk.usage;
    47	                        }
    48	                    },
    49	                    buildMetadata() {
    50	                        return {
    51	                            pollinations: {
    52	                                completionUsage:
    53	                                    usage == null
    54	                                        ? null
    55	                                        : completionUsage(usage),
    56	                            },
    57	                        };
    58	                    },
    59	                };
    60	            },
    61	        },
    62	    });
    63	}
    64	
    65	/** Whether the run stopped on calls only the caller can answer (no execute). */
    66	export function awaitsCaller(
    67	    steps: { toolCalls: { toolName: string; invalid?: boolean }[] }[],
    68	    tools: ToolSet,
    69	): boolean {
    70	    return (
    71	        steps
    72	            .at(-1)
    73	            ?.toolCalls.some(
    74	                (call) =>
    75	                    !call.invalid &&
    76	                    Object.hasOwn(tools, call.toolName) &&
    77	                    !tools[call.toolName].execute,
    78	            ) ?? false
    79	    );
    80	}
    81	
    82	export function openAIFinishReason(reason: FinishReason): string {
    83	    if (reason === "tool-calls") return "tool_calls";
    84	    if (reason === "content-filter") return "content_filter";
    85	    if (reason === "stop" || reason === "length") return reason;
    86	    return "stop";
    87	}
    88	
    89	function completionUsage(value: unknown): CompletionUsage | null {
    90	    const parsed = CompletionUsageSchema.safeParse(value);
    91	    // Reject invalid usage only after the SDK resolves its result. Throwing
    92	    // inside metadata extraction also rejects the SDK's sibling promises.
    93	    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
    94	}
    95	
    96	function completionUsageFromBody(body: unknown): CompletionUsage | null {
    97	    if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || !("usage" in body)) {
    98	        return null;
    99	    }
   100	    return completionUsage(body.usage);
   101	}
   102	
   103	function sumUsageField(
   104	    usages: CompletionUsage[],
   105	    value: (usage: CompletionUsage) => number | null | undefined,
   106	): number | undefined {
   107	    let found = false;
   108	    let total = 0;
   109	    for (const usage of usages) {
   110	        const amount = value(usage);
   111	        if (amount == null) continue;
   112	        found = true;
   113	        total += amount;
   114	    }
   115	    return found ? total : undefined;
   116	}
   117	
   118	export function strictAgentUsage(steps: AgentStep[]): AgentUsage {
   119	    const usages = steps.map((step) => {
   120	        const usage = completionUsage(
   121	            step.providerMetadata?.pollinations?.completionUsage,
   122	        );
   123	        if (!usage) throw new Error("Agent response omitted valid usage");
   124	        return usage;
   125	    });
   126	    if (usages.length === 0) {
   127	        throw new Error("Agent response omitted valid usage");
   128	    }
   129	    return {
   130	        inputTokens: sumUsageField(usages, (usage) => usage.prompt_tokens),
   131	        inputTokenDetails: {
   132	            cacheReadTokens: sumUsageField(
   133	                usages,
   134	                (usage) => usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens,
   135	            ),
   136	            cacheWriteTokens: sumUsageField(
   137	                usages,
   138	                (usage) => usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_write_tokens,
   139	            ),
   140	        },
   141	        outputTokens: sumUsageField(usages, (usage) => usage.completion_tokens),
   142	        outputTokenDetails: {
   143	            reasoningTokens: sumUsageField(
   144	                usages,
   145	                (usage) =>
   146	                    usage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens ??
   147	                    usage.reasoning_tokens,
   148	            ),
   149	        },
   150	        totalTokens: sumUsageField(usages, (usage) => usage.total_tokens),
   151	    };
   152	}
===== shared/agents/output.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	import {
     3	    type FunctionCall,
     4	    FunctionCallOutputSchema,
     5	    FunctionCallSchema,
     6	    parseFunctionName,
     7	} from "./function-items.ts";
     8	import { safeMcpOutput } from "./mcp-output.ts";
     9	import type { AgentPart } from "./types.ts";
    10	
    11	const MessageSchema = z.object({
    12	    type: z.literal("message"),
    13	    id: z.string(),
    14	    role: z.literal("assistant"),
    15	    status: z.enum(["in_progress", "completed", "incomplete"]),
    16	    content: z.array(
    17	        z.object({
    18	            type: z.literal("output_text"),
    19	            text: z.string(),
    20	            annotations: z.array(z.unknown()),
    21	            logprobs: z.array(z.unknown()),
    22	        }),
    23	    ),
    24	});
    25	const OutputItemSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
    26	    MessageSchema,
    27	    FunctionCallSchema,
    28	    FunctionCallOutputSchema,
    29	]);
    30	export type AgentOutputItem = z.infer<typeof OutputItemSchema>;
    31	
    32	/** One ordered output collector serves JSON responses and streaming events. */
    33	export function collectOutput(
    34	    send?: (type: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
    35	) {
    36	    const items: AgentOutputItem[] = [];
    37	    const skippedToolCalls = new Set<string>();
    38	    const pendingCalls = new Map<string, FunctionCall>();
    39	    const callIds = new Set<string>();
    40	    let message: z.infer<typeof MessageSchema> | undefined;
    41	    const closeMessage = (status: "completed" | "incomplete" = "completed") => {
    42	        if (!message) return;
    43	        message.status = status;
    44	        const position = {
    45	            item_id: message.id,
    46	            output_index: items.indexOf(message),
    47	            content_index: 0,
    48	        };
    49	        send?.("response.output_text.done", {
    50	            ...position,
    51	            text: message.content[0].text,
    52	            logprobs: [],
    53	        });
    54	        send?.("response.content_part.done", {
    55	            ...position,
    56	            part: message.content[0],
    57	        });
    58	        send?.("response.output_item.done", {
    59	            output_index: position.output_index,
    60	            item: message,
    61	        });
    62	        message = undefined;
    63	    };
    64	    return {
    65	        items,
    66	        onPart(part: AgentPart) {
    67	            if (part.type === "text-delta") {
    68	                if (!part.text) return;
    69	                if (!message) {
    70	                    message = {
    71	                        id: `msg_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    72	                        type: "message",
    73	                        role: "assistant",
    74	                        status: "in_progress",
    75	                        content: [],
    76	                    };
    77	                    items.push(message);
    78	                    send?.("response.output_item.added", {
    79	                        output_index: items.length - 1,
    80	                        item: message,
    81	                    });
    82	                    message.content.push({
    83	                        type: "output_text",
    84	                        text: "",
    85	                        annotations: [],
    86	                        logprobs: [],
    87	                    });
    88	                    send?.("response.content_part.added", {
    89	                        item_id: message.id,
    90	                        output_index: items.length - 1,
    91	                        content_index: 0,
    92	                        part: message.content[0],
    93	                    });
    94	                }
    95	                message.content[0].text += part.text;
    96	                send?.("response.output_text.delta", {
    97	                    item_id: message.id,
    98	                    output_index: items.indexOf(message),
    99	                    content_index: 0,
   100	                    delta: part.text,
   101	                    logprobs: [],
   102	                });
   103	                return;
   104	            }
   105	            if (part.type === "tool-call") {
   106	                // The SDK feeds invalid attempts back to the model for recovery;
   107	                // they never executed an MCP tool and are not public call history.
   108	                if (part.invalid) {
   109	                    skippedToolCalls.add(part.toolCallId);
   110	                    return;
   111	                }
   112	                closeMessage();
   113	                if (callIds.has(part.toolCallId)) {
   114	                    throw new Error("Agent reused a tool call ID");
   115	                }
   116	                callIds.add(part.toolCallId);
   117	                const item = FunctionCallSchema.parse({
   118	                    type: "function_call",
   119	                    id: `fc_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
   120	                    call_id: part.toolCallId,
   121	                    name: part.toolName,
   122	                    arguments: JSON.stringify(part.input ?? {}),
   123	                    status: "completed",
   124	                });
   125	                pendingCalls.set(part.toolCallId, item);
   126	                items.push(item);
   127	                const position = {
   128	                    item_id: item.id,
   129	                    output_index: items.length - 1,
   130	                };
   131	                send?.("response.output_item.added", {
   132	                    output_index: position.output_index,
   133	                    item: { ...item, arguments: "", status: "in_progress" },
   134	                });
   135	                send?.("response.function_call_arguments.delta", {
   136	                    ...position,
   137	                    delta: item.arguments,
   138	                });
   139	                send?.("response.function_call_arguments.done", {
   140	                    ...position,
   141	                    arguments: item.arguments,
   142	                });
   143	                send?.("response.output_item.done", {
   144	                    output_index: position.output_index,
   145	                    item,
   146	                });
   147	                return;
   148	            }
   149	            if (skippedToolCalls.delete(part.toolCallId)) return;
   150	            const call = pendingCalls.get(part.toolCallId);
   151	            if (!call) {
   152	                throw new Error("Agent tool result has no matching call");
   153	            }
   154	            pendingCalls.delete(part.toolCallId);
   155	            closeMessage();
   156	            const result =
   157	                part.type === "tool-error"
   158	                    ? {
   159	                          isError: true,
   160	                          content: [
   161	                              {
   162	                                  type: "text",
   163	                                  text:
   164	                                      part.error instanceof Error
   165	                                          ? part.error.message
   166	                                          : String(part.error),
   167	                              },
   168	                          ],
   169	                      }
   170	                    : parseFunctionName(call.name)
   171	                      ? safeMcpOutput(part.output)
   172	                      : (part.output ?? null);
   173	            const item = FunctionCallOutputSchema.parse({
   174	                type: "function_call_output",
   175	                id: `fco_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
   176	                call_id: call.call_id,
   177	                // Content parts rather than a bare string: Open WebUI iterates
   178	                // the output of every function_call_output item it receives.
   179	                output: [{ type: "input_text", text: JSON.stringify(result) }],
   180	                status: "completed",
   181	            });
   182	            items.push(item);
   183	            const output_index = items.length - 1;
   184	            send?.("response.output_item.added", {
   185	                output_index,
   186	                item: { ...item, output: [], status: "in_progress" },
   187	            });
   188	            send?.("response.output_item.done", { output_index, item });
   189	        },
   190	        finish(
   191	            finishReason: string,
   192	            callerTools: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(),
   193	        ): AgentOutputItem[] {
   194	            if (
   195	                [...pendingCalls.values()].some(
   196	                    (call) => !callerTools.has(call.name),
   197	                )
   198	            ) {
   199	                throw new Error("Agent tool call has no result");
   200	            }
   201	            closeMessage(
   202	                finishReason === "length" || finishReason === "content_filter"
   203	                    ? "incomplete"
   204	                    : "completed",
   205	            );
   206	            return z.array(OutputItemSchema).parse(items);
   207	        },
   208	    };
   209	}

    33	type JsonObject = Record<string, unknown>;
    34	type UserMessage = Extract<ModelMessage, { role: "user" }>;
    35	type PromptCacheProviderOptions = {
    36	    openaiCompatible: {
    37	        prompt_cache_breakpoint: { mode: "explicit" };
    38	    };
    39	};
    40	
    41	// collectOutput serializes executed tool failures in this shape.
    42	const ToolErrorOutputSchema = z.object({
    43	    isError: z.literal(true),
    44	    content: z.array(z.object({ type: z.literal("text"), text: z.string() })),
    45	});
    46	
    47	export class AgentResponsesRequestError extends Error {
    48	    constructor(
    49	        message: string,
    50	        readonly param: string,
    51	    ) {
    52	        super(message);
    53	    }
    54	}
    55	
    56	function invalidRequest(message: string, param: string): never {
    57	    throw new AgentResponsesRequestError(message, param);
    58	}
    59	
    60	function objectValue(value: unknown, param: string): JsonObject {
    61	    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
    62	        invalidRequest(`${param} must be an object`, param);
    63	    }
    64	    return value as JsonObject;
    65	}
    66	
    67	function stringValue(value: unknown, param: string): string {
    68	    if (typeof value !== "string") {
    69	        invalidRequest(`${param} must be a string`, param);
    70	    }
    71	    return value;
    72	}
    73	
    74	function promptCacheProviderOptions(
    75	    value: JsonObject,
    76	): PromptCacheProviderOptions | undefined {
    77	    if (value.prompt_cache_breakpoint === undefined) return undefined;
    78	    const breakpoint = objectValue(
    79	        value.prompt_cache_breakpoint,
    80	        "input.prompt_cache_breakpoint",
    81	    );
    82	    if (breakpoint.mode !== "explicit") {
    83	        invalidRequest(
    84	            'prompt_cache_breakpoint must be { "mode": "explicit" }',
    85	            "input.prompt_cache_breakpoint",
    86	        );
    87	    }
    88	    return {
    89	        openaiCompatible: {
    90	            prompt_cache_breakpoint: { mode: "explicit" },
    91	        },
    92	    };
    93	}
    94	
    95	function hasPromptCacheBreakpoint(
    96	    input: CreateResponseRequest["input"],
    97	): boolean {
    98	    return (
    99	        Array.isArray(input) &&
   100	        input.some((raw) => {
   101	            if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || !("content" in raw)) {
   102	                return false;
   103	            }
   104	            const content = (raw as JsonObject).content;
   105	            return (
   106	                Array.isArray(content) &&
   107	                content.some(
   108	                    (part) =>
   109	                        part != null &&
   110	                        typeof part === "object" &&
   111	                        "prompt_cache_breakpoint" in part,
   112	                )
   113	            );
   114	        })
   115	    );
   116	}
   117	
   118	function textContent(
   119	    content: unknown,
   120	    role: "assistant" | "developer" | "system",
   121	): { content: string; providerOptions?: PromptCacheProviderOptions } {
   122	    if (typeof content === "string") return { content };
   123	    if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
   124	        invalidRequest("Message content must be text", "input");
   125	    }
   126	    let providerOptions: PromptCacheProviderOptions | undefined;
   127	    const text = content
   128	        .map((raw) => {
   129	            const part = objectValue(raw, "input");
   130	            const validTypes =
   131	                role === "assistant"
   132	                    ? ["output_text", "text"]
   133	                    : ["input_text", "text"];
   134	            if (!validTypes.includes(String(part.type))) {
   135	                invalidRequest(
   136	                    `Unsupported ${role} content part: ${String(part.type)}`,
   137	                    "input",
   138	                );
   139	            }
   140	            providerOptions =
   141	                promptCacheProviderOptions(part) ?? providerOptions;
   142	            return stringValue(part.text, "input");
   143	        })
   144	        .join("");
   145	    return { content: text, ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}) };
   146	}
   147	
   148	function userContent(content: unknown): UserMessage["content"] {
   149	    if (typeof content === "string") return content;
   150	    if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
   151	        invalidRequest(
   152	            "User message content must be text or an array",
   153	            "input",
   154	        );
   155	    }
   156	    return content.map((raw) => {
   157	        const part = objectValue(raw, "input");
   158	        const providerOptions = promptCacheProviderOptions(part);
   159	        if (part.type === "input_text" || part.type === "text") {
   160	            return {
   161	                type: "text" as const,
   162	                text: stringValue(part.text, "input"),
   163	                ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
   164	            };
   165	        }
   166	        if (part.type === "input_image") {
   167	            return {
   168	                type: "image" as const,
   169	                image: stringValue(part.image_url, "input"),
   170	                ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
   171	            };
   172	        }
   173	        return invalidRequest(
   174	            `Unsupported user content part: ${String(part.type)}`,
   175	            "input",
   176	        );
   177	    }) as UserMessage["content"];
   178	}
   179	
   180	async function inputMessages(
   181	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   182	    tools?: ToolSet,
   183	): Promise<ModelMessage[]> {
   184	    const messages: ModelMessage[] = [];
   185	    if (request.instructions) {
   186	        messages.push({ role: "system", content: request.instructions });
   187	    }
   188	    if (typeof request.input === "string") {
   189	        messages.push({ role: "user", content: request.input });
   190	        return messages;
   191	    }
   192	
   193	    const itemIds = new Set<string>();
   194	    const toolCallIds = new Set<string>();
   195	    const pendingCalls = new Map<string, ResponseFunctionCall>();
   196	    let calls: ToolCallPart[] = [];
   197	    let results: ToolResultPart[] = [];
   198	    for (const raw of request.input) {
   199	        const item = objectValue(raw, "input");
   200	        if (item.id !== undefined) {
   201	            const id = stringValue(item.id, "input.id");
   202	            if (!id || itemIds.has(id)) {
   203	                invalidRequest(
   204	                    "Responses history item IDs must be unique",
   205	                    "input.id",
   206	                );
   207	            }
   208	            itemIds.add(id);
   209	        }
   210	        if (item.type === "function_call") {
   211	            // Input items carry optional id and status, unlike the items the
   212	            // agent emits: Open WebUI strips both when it replays history.
   213	            const parsed = ResponseFunctionCallSchema.safeParse(item);
   214	            if (
   215	                !parsed.success ||
   216	                (parsed.data.status ?? "completed") !== "completed" ||
   217	                toolCallIds.has(parsed.data.call_id)
   218	            ) {
   219	                invalidRequest(
   220	                    "Tool history must contain unique completed function calls",
   221	                    "input",
   222	                );
   223	            }
   224	            const call = parsed.data;
   225	            toolCallIds.add(call.call_id);
   226	            let input: JsonObject;
   227	            try {
   228	                input = objectValue(
   229	                    JSON.parse(call.arguments),
   230	                    "input.arguments",
   231	                );
   232	            } catch {
   233	                invalidRequest(
   234	                    "Function call arguments must be a JSON object",
   235	                    "input.arguments",
   236	                );
   237	            }
   238	            if (!pendingCalls.size) {
   239	                calls = [];
   240	                results = [];
   241	                messages.push({ role: "assistant", content: calls });
   242	                messages.push({ role: "tool", content: results });
   243	            }
   244	            pendingCalls.set(call.call_id, call);
   245	            calls.push({
   246	                type: "tool-call",
   247	                toolCallId: call.call_id,
   248	                toolName: call.name,
   249	                input,
   250	            });
   251	            continue;
   252	        }
   253	        if (item.type === "function_call_output") {
   254	            const parsed = ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema.safeParse(item);
   255	            const call = parsed.success
   256	                ? pendingCalls.get(parsed.data.call_id)
   257	                : undefined;
   258	            if (
   259	                !parsed.success ||
   260	                (parsed.data.status ?? "completed") !== "completed" ||
   261	                !call
   262	            ) {
   263	                invalidRequest(
   264	                    "Function outputs must match an unfinished history call",
   265	                    "input",
   266	                );
   267	            }
   268	            const isMcp = Boolean(parseFunctionName(call.name));
   269	            const outputText = functionOutputText(parsed.data.output);
   270	            let output: z.infer<ReturnType<typeof z.json>>;
   271	            try {
   272	                output = z.json().parse(JSON.parse(outputText));
   273	            } catch {
   274	                // Caller functions may return ordinary text, not only JSON.
   275	                output = outputText;
   276	            }
   277	            try {
   278	                if (isMcp) {
   279	                    const result = objectValue(output, "input.output");
   280	                    if (
   281	                        !Array.isArray(result.content) ||
   282	                        (result.isError !== undefined &&
   283	                            typeof result.isError !== "boolean")
   284	                    ) {
   285	                        throw new Error("Invalid MCP result");
   286	                    }
   287	                }
   288	            } catch {
   289	                invalidRequest(
   290	                    "Function output must contain a JSON MCP result",
   291	                    "input.output",
   292	                );
   293	            }
   294	            let modelOutput: ToolResultPart["output"] =
   295	                typeof output === "string"
   296	                    ? { type: "text", value: output }
   297	                    : { type: "json", value: output };
   298	            const toModelOutput = tools?.[call.name]?.toModelOutput;
   299	            const toolError = ToolErrorOutputSchema.safeParse(output);
   300	            if (isMcp) {
   301	                modelOutput = safeMcpModelOutput({ output });
   302	            } else if (toolError.success) {
   303	                // Like the SDK, bypass the successful-output formatter on errors.
   304	                modelOutput = {
   305	                    type: "error-text",
   306	                    value: toolError.data.content
   307	                        .map((part) => part.text)
   308	                        .join("\n"),
   309	                };
   310	            } else if (toModelOutput) {
   311	                modelOutput = await toModelOutput({
   312	                    toolCallId: call.call_id,
   313	                    input: JSON.parse(call.arguments),
   314	                    output,
   315	                });
   316	            }
   317	            results.push({
   318	                type: "tool-result",
   319	                toolCallId: call.call_id,
   320	                toolName: call.name,
   321	                output: modelOutput,
   322	            });
   323	            pendingCalls.delete(call.call_id);
   324	            continue;
   325	        }
   326	        if (pendingCalls.size) {
   327	            invalidRequest(
   328	                "Function calls require results before the next message",
   329	                "input",
   330	            );
   331	        }
   332	        if (item.type && item.type !== "message") {
   333	            invalidRequest(
   334	                `Unsupported Responses input item: ${String(item.type)}`,
   335	                "input",
   336	            );
   337	        }
   338	        const role = stringValue(item.role, "input");
   339	        if (role === "developer" || role === "system") {
   340	            const { content, providerOptions } = textContent(
   341	                item.content,
   342	                role,
   343	            );
   344	            messages.push({
   345	                role: "system",
   346	                content,
   347	                ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
   348	            });
   349	            continue;
   350	        }
   351	        if (role === "user") {
   352	            messages.push({ role: "user", content: userContent(item.content) });
   353	            continue;
   354	        }
   355	        if (role === "assistant") {
   356	            const { content, providerOptions } = textContent(
   357	                item.content,
   358	                role,
   359	            );
   360	            messages.push({
   361	                role: "assistant",
   362	                content,
   363	                ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
   364	            });
   365	            continue;
   366	        }
   367	        invalidRequest(`Unsupported Responses message role: ${role}`, "input");
   368	    }
   369	    if (pendingCalls.size) {
   370	        invalidRequest("Function calls require matching results", "input");
   371	    }
   372	    return messages;
   373	}
   374	
   375	function requestSettings(
   376	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   377	): AgentGenerationSettings {
   378	    if (request.max_tool_calls != null) {
   379	        invalidRequest(
   380	            "Per-request tool-call limits are not supported by managed agents",
   381	            "max_tool_calls",
   382	        );
   383	    }
   384	    if (
   385	        request.reasoning &&
   386	        Object.keys(request.reasoning).some(
   387	            (key) => key !== "effort" && key !== "summary",
   388	        )
   389	    ) {
   390	        invalidRequest(
   391	            "Only reasoning effort is supported by managed agents",
   392	            "reasoning",
   393	        );
   394	    }
   395	    if (request.reasoning?.summary != null) {
   396	        invalidRequest(
   397	            "Reasoning summaries are not supported by managed agents",
   398	            "reasoning.summary",
   399	        );
   400	    }
   401	    const reasoningEffort = request.reasoning?.effort;
   402	    if (
   403	        reasoningEffort != null &&
   404	        !["none", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"].includes(
   405	            String(reasoningEffort),
   406	        )
   407	    ) {
   408	        invalidRequest("Invalid reasoning effort", "reasoning.effort");
   409	    }
   410	    if (request.tool_choice !== undefined && request.tool_choice !== "auto") {
   411	        invalidRequest(
   412	            "Caller-provided tool choice is not supported by managed agents",
   413	            "tool_choice",
   414	        );
   415	    }
   416	    if (request.parallel_tool_calls === false) {
   417	        invalidRequest(
   418	            "Disabling parallel tool calls is not supported by managed agents",
   419	            "parallel_tool_calls",
   420	        );
   421	    }
   422	    if (request.text !== undefined) {
   423	        invalidRequest(
   424	            "Structured text output is not supported by managed agents",
   425	            "text",
   426	        );
   427	    }
   428	    if (request.include?.length) {
   429	        invalidRequest(
   430	            "Additional included output is not supported by managed agents",
   431	            "include",
   432	        );
   433	    }
   434	    if ((request.top_logprobs ?? 0) > 0) {
   435	        invalidRequest("Log probabilities are not supported", "top_logprobs");
   436	    }
   437	    if (request.truncation === "auto") {
   438	        invalidRequest("Automatic truncation is not supported", "truncation");
   439	    }
   440	    if (request.stream_options?.include_obfuscation === true) {
   441	        invalidRequest(
   442	            "Stream obfuscation is not supported by managed agents",
   443	            "stream_options.include_obfuscation",
   444	        );
   445	    }
   446	
   447	    const inputHasPromptCacheBreakpoint = hasPromptCacheBreakpoint(
   448	        request.input,
   449	    );
   450	    const promptCacheOptions =
   451	        request.prompt_cache_options ??
   452	        (inputHasPromptCacheBreakpoint ? { mode: "explicit" as const } : null);
   453	    const providerOptions = {
   454	        ...(reasoningEffort ? { reasoningEffort } : {}),
   455	        ...(request.safety_identifier || request.user
   456	            ? { user: request.safety_identifier ?? request.user }
   457	            : {}),
   458	        ...(request.service_tier ? { service_tier: request.service_tier } : {}),
   459	        ...(request.prompt_cache_key
   460	            ? { prompt_cache_key: request.prompt_cache_key }
   461	            : {}),
   462	        ...(promptCacheOptions
   463	            ? { prompt_cache_options: promptCacheOptions }
   464	            : {}),
   465	        ...(request.prompt_cache_retention
   466	            ? { prompt_cache_retention: request.prompt_cache_retention }
   467	            : {}),
   468	    };
   469	    return {
   470	        promptCacheBreakpoint:
   471	            promptCacheOptions?.mode === "explicit" &&
   472	            !inputHasPromptCacheBreakpoint,
   473	        ...(request.max_output_tokens
   474	            ? { maxOutputTokens: request.max_output_tokens }
   475	            : {}),
   476	        ...(request.temperature == null
   477	            ? {}
   478	            : { temperature: request.temperature }),
   479	        ...(request.top_p == null ? {} : { topP: request.top_p }),
   480	        ...(request.frequency_penalty == null
   481	            ? {}
   482	            : { frequencyPenalty: request.frequency_penalty }),
   483	        ...(request.presence_penalty == null
   484	            ? {}
   485	            : { presencePenalty: request.presence_penalty }),
   486	        ...(Object.keys(providerOptions).length
   487	            ? { providerOptions: { pollinations: providerOptions } }
   488	            : {}),
   489	    };
   490	}
   491	
   492	function responseUsage(output: AgentOutput): ResponseUsage {
   493	    const usage = buildUsage(output.usage, output.toolCallCounts);
   494	    return ResponseUsageSchema.parse({
   495	        input_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens,
   496	        input_tokens_details: {
   497	            ...usage.prompt_tokens_details,
   498	            cached_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens ?? 0,
   499	            cache_write_tokens:
   500	                usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens ?? 0,
   501	        },
   502	        output_tokens: usage.completion_tokens,
   503	        output_tokens_details: {
   504	            ...usage.completion_tokens_details,
   505	            reasoning_tokens:
   506	                usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens ?? 0,
   507	        },
   508	        total_tokens: usage.total_tokens,
   509	        tool_call_counts: usage.tool_call_counts,
   510	    });
   511	}

   513	function responseConfiguration(
   514	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   515	    callerTools: ReadonlySet<string>,
   516	) {
   517	    const reasoning = request.reasoning
   518	        ? {
   519	              effort:
   520	                  typeof request.reasoning.effort === "string"
   521	                      ? request.reasoning.effort
   522	                      : null,
   523	              summary: null,
   524	          }
   525	        : null;
   526	    return {
   527	        previous_response_id: null,
   528	        instructions: request.instructions ?? null,
   529	        tools: (request.tools ?? []).filter((tool) =>
   530	            callerTools.has(tool.name),
   531	        ),
   532	        tool_choice: "auto",
   533	        truncation: "disabled",
   534	        parallel_tool_calls: true,
   535	        text: { format: { type: "text" } },
   536	        top_p: request.top_p ?? 1,
   537	        presence_penalty: request.presence_penalty ?? 0,
   538	        frequency_penalty: request.frequency_penalty ?? 0,
   539	        top_logprobs: request.top_logprobs ?? 0,
   540	        temperature: request.temperature ?? 1,
   541	        reasoning,
   542	        max_output_tokens: request.max_output_tokens ?? null,
   543	        max_tool_calls: null,
   544	        store: false,
   545	        background: false,
   546	        service_tier: request.service_tier ?? "default",
   547	        metadata: request.metadata ?? {},
   548	        safety_identifier: request.safety_identifier ?? null,
   549	        prompt_cache_key: request.prompt_cache_key ?? null,
   550	    };
   551	}

   553	function responseObject(
   554	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   555	    output: AgentOutput,
   556	    id: string,
   557	    createdAt: number,
   558	    items: AgentOutputItem[],
   559	    callerTools: ReadonlySet<string>,
   560	) {
   561	    const incomplete =
   562	        output.finishReason === "length" ||
   563	        output.finishReason === "content_filter";
   564	    const response = {
   565	        id,
   566	        object: "response" as const,
   567	        created_at: createdAt,
   568	        completed_at: incomplete ? null : Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
   569	        status: incomplete ? ("incomplete" as const) : ("completed" as const),
   570	        incomplete_details: incomplete
   571	            ? {
   572	                  reason:
   573	                      output.finishReason === "content_filter"
   574	                          ? "content_filter"
   575	                          : "max_output_tokens",
   576	              }
   577	            : null,
   578	        model: request.model,
   579	        output: items,
   580	        error: null,
   581	        usage: responseUsage(output),
   582	        ...responseConfiguration(request, callerTools),
   583	    };
   584	    CreateResponseResponseSchema.parse(response);
   585	    return response;
   586	}

   588	function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
   589	    const message =
   590	        typeof error === "string" ? error : communityEndpointErrorDetail(error);
   591	    return message?.trim() ? message : "Agent request failed";
   592	}
   593	
   594	export function agentResponsesError(error: unknown): Response {
   595	    const invalid = error instanceof AgentResponsesRequestError;
   596	    const upstreamStatus = APICallError.isInstance(error)
   597	        ? error.statusCode
   598	        : undefined;
   599	    const status = invalid
   600	        ? 400
   601	        : upstreamStatus && upstreamStatus >= 400
   602	          ? upstreamStatus
   603	          : 502;
   604	    return Response.json(
   605	        {
   606	            error: {
   607	                message: errorMessage(error),
   608	                type: invalid ? "invalid_request_error" : "server_error",
   609	                code: invalid ? "unsupported_parameter" : "agent_error",
   610	                param: invalid ? error.param : null,
   611	            },
   612	        },
   613	        { status },
   614	    );
   615	}
   616	
   617	function streamResponse(
   618	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   619	    runner: AgentRunner,
   620	    messages: ModelMessage[],
   621	    settings: AgentGenerationSettings,
   622	    signal: AbortSignal,
   623	    tools: ToolSet,
   624	    callerTools: ReadonlySet<string>,
   625	): Response {
   626	    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
   627	    const responseId = `resp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   628	    const createdAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
   629	    const cancellation = new AbortController();
   630	    const runSignal = AbortSignal.any([signal, cancellation.signal]);
   631	    let sequenceNumber = 0;
   632	    let cancelled = false;
   633	    const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
   634	        start(controller) {
   635	            const send = (type: string, payload: JsonObject) => {
   636	                if (cancelled) return;
   637	                controller.enqueue(
   638	                    encoder.encode(
   639	                        `event: ${type}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({
   640	                            type,
   641	                            sequence_number: sequenceNumber++,
   642	                            ...payload,
   643	                        })}\n\n`,
   644	                    ),
   645	                );
   646	            };
   647	            const initialResponse = {
   648	                id: responseId,
   649	                object: "response",
   650	                created_at: createdAt,
   651	                completed_at: null,
   652	                status: "in_progress",
   653	                incomplete_details: null,
   654	                model: request.model,
   655	                output: [],
   656	                error: null,
   657	                usage: null,
   658	                ...responseConfiguration(request, callerTools),
   659	            };
   660	            const collected = collectOutput(send);
   661	            // Do not block stream initialization on the run: cancel() must
   662	            // abort an in-flight model/tool call, not wait for it to finish.
   663	            void (async () => {
   664	                try {
   665	                    send("response.created", { response: initialResponse });
   666	                    const output = await runner({
   667	                        messages,
   668	                        settings,
   669	                        signal: runSignal,
   670	                        stream: true,
   671	                        onPart: collected.onPart,
   672	                        tools,
   673	                    });
   674	                    if (cancelled) return;
   675	                    runSignal.throwIfAborted();
   676	                    const response = responseObject(
   677	                        request,
   678	                        output,
   679	                        responseId,
   680	                        createdAt,
   681	                        collected.finish(output.finishReason, callerTools),
   682	                        callerTools,
   683	                    );
   684	                    send(
   685	                        response.status === "incomplete"
   686	                            ? "response.incomplete"
   687	                            : "response.completed",
   688	                        { response },
   689	                    );
   690	                } catch (error) {
   691	                    if (cancelled) return;
   692	                    const message = errorMessage(error);
   693	                    const responseError = { code: "agent_error", message };
   694	                    send("error", { ...responseError, param: null });
   695	                    send("response.failed", {
   696	                        response: {
   697	                            ...initialResponse,
   698	                            status: "failed",
   699	                            output: collected.items,
   700	                            error: responseError,
   701	                        },
   702	                    });
   703	                } finally {
   704	                    if (!cancelled) {
   705	                        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode("data: [DONE]\n\n"));
   706	                        controller.close();
   707	                    }
   708	                }
   709	            })();
   710	        },
   711	        cancel(reason) {
   712	            cancelled = true;
   713	            cancellation.abort(reason);
   714	        },
   715	    });
   716	    return new Response(stream, {
   717	        headers: {
   718	            "content-type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
   719	            "cache-control": "no-cache",
   720	            connection: "keep-alive",
   721	        },
   722	    });
   723	}
   724	
   725	/** The request's function tools. Without execute, the SDK returns their calls
   726	 * for the caller to answer. */
   727	function requestTools(request: CreateResponseRequest): ToolSet {
   728	    const tools: ToolSet = Object.create(null);
   729	    for (const definition of request.tools ?? []) {
   730	        if (
   731	            !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(definition.name) ||
   732	            definition.name.startsWith("mcp__") ||
   733	            Object.hasOwn(tools, definition.name)
   734	        ) {
   735	            invalidRequest(
   736	                "Caller tool names must be unique, use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and not start with mcp__",
   737	                "tools",
   738	            );
   739	        }
   740	        tools[definition.name] = {
   741	            description: definition.description ?? undefined,
   742	            inputSchema: jsonSchema(
   743	                definition.parameters ?? { type: "object", properties: {} },
   744	            ),
   745	            ...(definition.strict == null ? {} : { strict: definition.strict }),
   746	        };
   747	    }
   748	    return tools;
   749	}
   750	
   751	export async function handleAgentResponsesRequest(
   752	    request: CreateResponseRequest,
   753	    signal: AbortSignal,
   754	    runner: AgentRunner,
   755	    agentTools: ToolSet = {},
   756	): Promise<Response> {
   757	    try {
   758	        signal.throwIfAborted();
   759	        // The agent's own tools win a name clash.
   760	        const tools = { ...requestTools(request), ...agentTools };
   761	        const messages = await inputMessages(request, tools);
   762	        signal.throwIfAborted();
   763	        const settings = requestSettings(request);
   764	        const callerTools = new Set(
   765	            Object.entries(tools)
   766	                .filter(([, tool]) => !tool.execute)
   767	                .map(([name]) => name),
   768	        );
   769	        if (request.stream) {
   770	            return streamResponse(
   771	                request,
   772	                runner,
   773	                messages,
   774	                settings,
   775	                signal,
   776	                tools,
   777	                callerTools,
   778	            );
   779	        }
   780	        const collected = collectOutput();
   781	        const output = await runner({
   782	            messages,
   783	            settings,
   784	            signal,
   785	            stream: false,
   786	            onPart: collected.onPart,
   787	            tools,
   788	        });
   789	        signal.throwIfAborted();
   790	        return Response.json(
   791	            responseObject(
   792	                request,
   793	                output,
   794	                `resp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
   795	                Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
   796	                collected.finish(output.finishReason, callerTools),
   797	                callerTools,
   798	            ),
   799	        );
   800	    } catch (error) {
   801	        return agentResponsesError(error);
   802	    }
   803	}
===== shared/agents/sdk-runner.ts =====
     1	import type { ModelMessage, ToolLoopAgent, ToolSet } from "ai";
     2	import type { AgentPart } from "./types.ts";
     3	
     4	/** Forward SDK output; the caller owns configuration, cleanup, and stop policy. */
     5	export async function runSdkAgent<TOOLS extends ToolSet>(
     6	    agent: ToolLoopAgent<never, TOOLS>,
     7	    {
     8	        messages,
     9	        signal,
    10	        stream,
    11	        onPart,
    12	    }: {
    13	        messages: ModelMessage[];
    14	        signal: AbortSignal;
    15	        stream: boolean;
    16	        onPart: (part: AgentPart) => void;
    17	    },
    18	) {
    19	    if (stream) {
    20	        const result = await agent.stream({ messages, abortSignal: signal });
    21	        for await (const part of result.fullStream) {
    22	            if (part.type === "error") throw part.error;
    23	            if (part.type === "tool-result" && part.preliminary) continue;
    24	            if (
    25	                part.type === "text-delta" ||
    26	                part.type === "tool-call" ||
    27	                part.type === "tool-result" ||
    28	                part.type === "tool-error"
    29	            ) {
    30	                onPart(part);
    31	            }
    32	        }
    33	        const [finishReason, steps] = await Promise.all([
    34	            result.finishReason,
    35	            result.steps,
    36	        ]);
    37	        return { finishReason, steps };
    38	    }
    39	
    40	    const result = await agent.generate({ messages, abortSignal: signal });
    41	    for (const step of result.steps) {
    42	        for (const part of step.content) {
    43	            if (part.type === "text") {
    44	                onPart({ type: "text-delta", text: part.text });
    45	            }
    46	            if (
    47	                part.type === "tool-call" ||
    48	                part.type === "tool-result" ||
    49	                part.type === "tool-error"
    50	            ) {
    51	                onPart(part);
    52	            }
    53	        }
    54	    }
    55	    return { finishReason: result.finishReason, steps: result.steps };
    56	}

     3	function tokenCount(value: number | undefined, name: string): number {
     4	    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || (value ?? -1) < 0) {
     5	        throw new Error(`Agent response omitted valid ${name}`);
     6	    }
     7	    return value as number;

    10	export function buildUsage(usage: AgentUsage, toolCallCounts: ToolCallCounts) {
    11	    const promptTokens = tokenCount(usage.inputTokens, "input usage");
    12	    const completionTokens = tokenCount(usage.outputTokens, "output usage");
    13	    const totalTokens = usage.totalTokens ?? promptTokens + completionTokens;
    14	    tokenCount(totalTokens, "total usage");

    17	        completion_tokens: completionTokens,
    18	        total_tokens: totalTokens,
    19	        prompt_tokens_details: {
    20	            cached_tokens: usage.inputTokenDetails?.cacheReadTokens ?? null,

    22	                usage.inputTokenDetails?.cacheWriteTokens ?? null,
    23	        },

    25	            reasoning_tokens: usage.outputTokenDetails?.reasoningTokens ?? null,

===== shared/auth/account-permissions.ts =====
     1	import { HTTPException } from "hono/http-exception";
     2	import type { RefusalContext } from "../http/fix-link.ts";
     3	import { permissionRequired } from "../http/permission-required-error.ts";
     4	import type { CONSENT_PERMISSIONS } from "./authorize-config.ts";
     5	
     6	type AccountPermission = (typeof CONSENT_PERMISSIONS)[number];
     7	
     8	type AccountPermissionApiKey = {
     9	    permissions?: Record<string, string[]>;
    10	};
    11	
    12	// The account owner (a dashboard session or session token) has no key, so no
    13	// key restrictions apply. A key needs the scope granted explicitly.
    14	export function hasAccountPermission(
    15	    apiKey: AccountPermissionApiKey | undefined,
    16	    permission: AccountPermission,
    17	): boolean {
    18	    if (!apiKey) return true;
    19	    return !!apiKey.permissions?.account?.includes(permission);
    20	}
    21	
    22	/** Refuses a key without the permission, with a link to grant it to that key. */
    23	export function requireAccountPermission(
    24	    c: RefusalContext,
    25	    permission: AccountPermission,
    26	): void {
    27	    if (hasAccountPermission(c.var.auth?.apiKey, permission)) return;
    28	    // Agent run tokens never carry account permissions (api-key.ts), so a
    29	    // grant would only widen the owner's key without letting the agent in.
    30	    if (c.var.auth?.agentRun) {
    31	        throw new HTTPException(403, {
    32	            message: `Agent runs can't use 'account:${permission}'.`,
    33	        });
    34	    }
    35	    throw permissionRequired(
    36	        c,
    37	        { permission },
    38	        `API key does not have 'account:${permission}' permission.`,
    39	    );
    40	}

===== shared/auth/agent-run-token.ts =====
     1	import { Buffer } from "node:buffer";
     2	import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
     3	import { jwtVerify, SignJWT } from "jose";
     4	
     5	export const AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_PREFIX = "ag_";
     6	export const AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 1800;
     7	
     8	const AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_ISSUER = "gen.pollinations.ai";
     9	const AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_AUDIENCE = "pollinations-api";
    10	const MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS = 5;
    11	
    12	export type AgentRunClaims = {
    13	    parentApiKeyId: string;
    14	    // The request_id of the call that minted this token, so its generations can
    15	    // be grouped. The agent's steps arrive as separate requests, each minting
    16	    // its own id, and this token is the only thing that crosses that hop. Keep
    17	    // it in the signature: the agent holds the token, so a header carrying the
    18	    // same id would be a value the agent gets to choose.
    19	    parentRequestId: string;
    20	    managedAgentId?: string;
    21	    // The community model id of the agent the token was minted for, so a
    22	    // refusal during the run can name the agent that asked.
    23	    agentModelId?: string;
    24	    issuedAt: number;
    25	    expiresAt: number;
    26	};
    27	
    28	function signingKey(secret: string): Uint8Array {
    29	    return new TextEncoder().encode(
    30	        `pollinations-agent-run-token:v1\0${secret}`,
    31	    );
    32	}
    33	
    34	export async function signAgentRunToken(opts: {
    35	    secret: string;
    36	    parentApiKeyId: string;
    37	    parentRequestId: string;
    38	    managedAgentId?: string;
    39	    agentModelId?: string;
    40	    expiresIn?: number;
    41	    now?: number;
    42	}): Promise<string> {
    43	    const issuedAt = opts.now ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    44	    const expiresIn = opts.expiresIn ?? AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS;
    45	    if (expiresIn < 1 || expiresIn > AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS) {
    46	        throw new Error("Invalid agent run token lifetime");
    47	    }
    48	
    49	    const token = await new SignJWT({
    50	        version: 1,
    51	        parentRequestId: opts.parentRequestId,
    52	        ...(opts.managedAgentId ? { managedAgentId: opts.managedAgentId } : {}),
    53	        ...(opts.agentModelId ? { agentModelId: opts.agentModelId } : {}),
    54	    })
    55	        .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT" })
    56	        .setIssuer(AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_ISSUER)
    57	        .setAudience(AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_AUDIENCE)
    58	        .setSubject(opts.parentApiKeyId)
    59	        .setJti(crypto.randomUUID())
    60	        .setIssuedAt(issuedAt)
    61	        .setExpirationTime(issuedAt + expiresIn)
    62	        .sign(signingKey(opts.secret));
    63	
    64	    return `${AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_PREFIX}${token}`;
    65	}
    66	
    67	export async function verifyAgentRunToken(
    68	    token: string,
    69	    secret: string,
    70	    now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    71	): Promise<AgentRunClaims> {
    72	    if (!token.startsWith(AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_PREFIX)) {
    73	        throw new Error("Invalid agent run token prefix");
    74	    }
    75	
    76	    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(
    77	        token.slice(AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_PREFIX.length),
    78	        signingKey(secret),
    79	        {
    80	            algorithms: ["HS256"],
    81	            issuer: AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_ISSUER,
    82	            audience: AGENT_RUN_TOKEN_AUDIENCE,
    83	            currentDate: new Date(now * 1000),
    84	            clockTolerance: MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS,
    85	            typ: "JWT",
    86	        },
    87	    );
    88	
    89	    // jwtVerify has already proven this token came from signAgentRunToken with
    90	    // this secret, and checked issuer, audience and expiry. What is left is
    91	    // shape: the JWT library types every claim as unknown.
    92	    if (
    93	        typeof payload.sub !== "string" ||
    94	        !payload.sub ||
    95	        typeof payload.jti !== "string" ||
    96	        !payload.jti ||
    97	        typeof payload.iat !== "number" ||
    98	        typeof payload.exp !== "number" ||
    99	        typeof payload.parentRequestId !== "string" ||
   100	        !payload.parentRequestId ||
   101	        (payload.managedAgentId !== undefined &&
   102	            (typeof payload.managedAgentId !== "string" ||
   103	                !payload.managedAgentId)) ||
   104	        (payload.agentModelId !== undefined &&
   105	            (typeof payload.agentModelId !== "string" || !payload.agentModelId))
   106	    ) {
   107	        throw new Error("Invalid agent run token claims");
   108	    }
   109	
   110	    return {
   111	        parentApiKeyId: payload.sub,
   112	        parentRequestId: payload.parentRequestId,
   113	        ...(typeof payload.managedAgentId === "string"
   114	            ? { managedAgentId: payload.managedAgentId }
   115	            : {}),
   116	        ...(typeof payload.agentModelId === "string"
   117	            ? { agentModelId: payload.agentModelId }
   118	            : {}),
   119	        issuedAt: payload.iat,
   120	        expiresAt: payload.exp,
   121	    };
   122	}
   123	
   124	export type Grant =
   125	    | { category: string }
   126	    | { model: string }
   127	    | { permission: string };
   128	
   129	/**
   130	 * Signs that a run of this agent was refused this grant on this key. The grant
   131	 * link reaches the owner through the agent, so an unsigned name would let one
   132	 * agent pose as another. Binding the key and the grant stops a signed name
   133	 * from being moved onto a different request.
   134	 */
   135	export function signGrantAgent(opts: {
   136	    secret: string;
   137	    apiKeyId: string;
   138	    grant: Grant;
   139	    agent: string;
   140	}): string {
   141	    const { grant } = opts;
   142	    const entry =
   143	        "category" in grant
   144	            ? `category:${grant.category}`
   145	            : "model" in grant
   146	              ? `model:${grant.model}`
   147	              : `permission:${grant.permission}`;
   148	    return createHmac("sha256", `pollinations-grant-agent:v1\0${opts.secret}`)
   149	        .update([opts.apiKeyId, entry, opts.agent].join("\0"))
   150	        .digest("base64url");
   151	}
   152	
   153	export function verifyGrantAgent(
   154	    opts: Parameters<typeof signGrantAgent>[0] & { sig: string },
   155	): boolean {
   156	    const expected = Buffer.from(signGrantAgent(opts));
   157	    const actual = Buffer.from(opts.sig);
   158	    return (
   159	        expected.length === actual.length && timingSafeEqual(expected, actual)
   160	    );
   161	}

    72	export function validateRedirectUriFormat(redirectUri: string): void {
    73	    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+\-.]*:\/\/.+/.test(redirectUri)) {
    74	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
    75	            message: "Must be a valid URL with a scheme (e.g. https://...)",
    76	        });
    77	    }
    78	    let parsed: URL;
    79	    try {
    80	        parsed = new URL(redirectUri);
    81	    } catch {
    82	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
    83	            message: "Must be a valid URL with a scheme (e.g. https://...)",
    84	        });
    85	    }
    86	    if (parsed.hash) {
    87	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
    88	            message: "Redirect URI must not include a fragment",
    89	        });
    90	    }
    91	    // Catches two URLs run together, e.g. typed after a pre-filled default.
    92	    if (parsed.pathname.includes("://")) {
    93	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
    94	            message: "Redirect URI must be a single URL",
    95	        });
    96	    }
    97	    if (!isAllowedRedirectUrl(parsed)) {
    98	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
    99	            message:
   100	                "Redirect URI must use https://, except http:// is allowed for loopback hosts",
   101	        });
   102	    }
   103	}
   104	
   105	function cleanRedirectUris(redirectUris: string[]): string[] {
   106	    return redirectUris
   107	        .map((uri) => uri.trim())
   108	        .filter((uri): uri is string => uri.length > 0);
   109	}
   110	
   111	function rejectInvalidClientId(): never {
   112	    throw new HTTPException(400, {
   113	        message: "Invalid client_id",
   114	    });
   115	}
   116	
   117	// Caller-provided metadata is restricted to a typed allowlist. Server-controlled
   118	// fields like keyType / createdVia / plaintextKey / app attribution can never
   119	// be set or overridden by callers, even via /account/keys metadata patches.
   120	function pickCallerMetadata(
   121	    metadata: CallerMetadata | undefined,
   122	    isPublishable: boolean,
   123	): Record<string, unknown> {
   124	    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   125	    const redirectUris = cleanRedirectUris(metadata?.redirectUris ?? []);
   126	    if (isPublishable && redirectUris.length > 0) {
   127	        out.redirectUris = redirectUris;
   128	    }
   129	    if (typeof metadata?.redirectOrigin === "string")
   130	        out.redirectOrigin = metadata.redirectOrigin;
   131	    if (typeof metadata?.deviceUserCode === "string")
   132	        out.deviceUserCode = metadata.deviceUserCode;
   133	    if (typeof metadata?.description === "string")
   134	        out.description = metadata.description;
   135	    if (isPublishable) {
   136	        out.earningsEnabled = metadata?.earningsEnabled === true;
   137	    }
   138	    return out;
   139	}
   140	
   141	type ApiKeyDb = ReturnType<typeof drizzle<typeof schema>>;
   142	
   143	/**
   144	 * Resolve a publishable app key that may act as an OAuth client_id. Rejects
   145	 * keys that are unknown, revoked, not publishable, or owned by a banned user.
   146	 */
   147	export async function findPublishableClientKey(
   148	    authClient: CreateApiKeyAuthClient,
   149	    db: ApiKeyDb,
   150	    clientId: string,
   151	): Promise<typeof schema.apikey.$inferSelect | null> {
   152	    if (!clientId.startsWith("pk_")) return null;
   153	
   154	    const result = await authClient.api.verifyApiKey({
   155	        body: { key: clientId },
   156	    });
   157	    const keyId = result.valid ? result.key?.id : null;
   158	    if (!keyId) return null;
   159	
   160	    const clientKey = await db.query.apikey.findFirst({
   161	        where: eq(schema.apikey.id, keyId),
   162	    });
   163	    if (!clientKey || clientKey.prefix !== "pk") return null;
   164	    const owner = await db.query.user.findFirst({
   165	        where: eq(schema.user.id, clientKey.referenceId),
   166	    });
   167	    if (!owner || isUserBanned(owner)) return null;
   168	    return clientKey;
   169	}
   170	
   171	async function validateClientRedirectBinding(
   172	    authClient: CreateApiKeyAuthClient,
   173	    db: ApiKeyDb,
   174	    metadata: CallerMetadata | undefined,
   175	): Promise<VerifiedClientAttribution | null> {
   176	    if (!metadata) return null;
   177	    const requestedClientId = metadata.requestedClientId;
   178	    if (typeof requestedClientId !== "string") {
   179	        return null;
   180	    }
   181	
   182	    const clientKey = await findPublishableClientKey(
   183	        authClient,
   184	        db,
   185	        requestedClientId,
   186	    );
   187	    if (!clientKey) rejectInvalidClientId();
   188	    const attribution = {
   189	        clientId: clientKey.id,
   190	    };
   191	
   192	    if (typeof metadata.deviceUserCode === "string") {
   193	        const device = await db.query.deviceCode.findFirst({
   194	            where: eq(
   195	                schema.deviceCode.userCode,
   196	                metadata.deviceUserCode.toUpperCase(),
   197	            ),
   198	        });
   199	        if (
   200	            !device ||
   201	            device.status !== "pending" ||
   202	            device.expiresAt < new Date() ||
   203	            device.clientId !== requestedClientId
   204	        ) {
   205	            throw new HTTPException(400, {
   206	                message: "client_id mismatch",
   207	            });
   208	        }
   209	        return attribution;
   210	    }
   211	
   212	    if (typeof metadata.redirectUri !== "string") {
   213	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
   214	            message: "redirect_uri is required when client_id is provided",
   215	        });
   216	    }
   217	    // No scheme/format check on the incoming redirect_uri here: scheme policy is
   218	    // enforced at registration (validateRedirectUriFormat on the app key's
   219	    // redirectUris). The allowlist match below is the only gate the auth flow
   220	    // applies, so a registered URI of any kind round-trips unchanged.
   221	    const allowlist = getRedirectUris(parseMetadata(clientKey.metadata));
   222	    if (!redirectUriMatchesAllowlist(metadata.redirectUri, allowlist)) {
   223	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
   224	            message: "redirect_uri not in allowlist for this client_id",
   225	        });
   226	    }
   227	    return attribution;
   228	}
   229	
   230	export async function createApiKeyForUser({
   231	    authClient,
   232	    dbBinding,
   233	    userId,
   234	    name,
   235	    type,
   236	    expiresIn,
   237	    allowedModels,
   238	    pollenBudget,
   239	    questPollenOnly = false,
   240	    accountPermissions,
   241	    metadata,
   242	    defaultCreatedVia,
   243	    createdByApiKeyId,
   244	    originAppKeyId,
   245	}: CreateApiKeyForUserInput) {
   246	    const db = drizzle(dbBinding, { schema });
   247	    const attribution = await validateClientRedirectBinding(
   248	        authClient,
   249	        db,
   250	        metadata,
   251	    );
   252	
   253	    const isPublishable = type === "publishable";
   254	    if (isPublishable && pollenBudget != null && pollenBudget !== 0) {
   255	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
   256	            message: "Publishable keys must have a pollen budget of 0",
   257	        });
   258	    }
   259	    const effectivePollenBudget = isPublishable ? 0 : pollenBudget;
   260	    const callerMetadata = pickCallerMetadata(metadata, isPublishable);
   261	    if (Array.isArray(callerMetadata.redirectUris)) {
   262	        for (const uri of callerMetadata.redirectUris as string[]) {
   263	            validateRedirectUriFormat(uri);
   264	        }
   265	    }
   266	
   267	    const safeAccountPerms =
   268	        sanitizeAuthorizeAccountPermissions(accountPermissions);
   269	
   270	    // An App Key (pk_) never authenticates requests, so it holds no scopes.
   271	    const permissions: Record<string, string[]> = {};
   272	    if (allowedModels && !isPublishable) {
   273	        permissions.models = await toModelPermissions(dbBinding, allowedModels);
   274	    }
   275	    if (safeAccountPerms && safeAccountPerms.length > 0 && !isPublishable) {
   276	        permissions.account = safeAccountPerms;
   277	    }
   278	
   279	    const prefix = isPublishable ? "pk" : "sk";
   280	    const baseMetadata = {
   281	        ...callerMetadata,
   282	        keyType: type,
   283	        createdVia: defaultCreatedVia,
   284	        ...(createdByApiKeyId && { createdByApiKeyId }),
   285	        ...(originAppKeyId && { originAppKeyId }),
   286	    };
   287	
   288	    const created = await authClient.api.createApiKey({
   289	        body: {
   290	            name,
   291	            prefix,
   292	            userId,
   293	            ...(expiresIn != null && { expiresIn }),
   294	            metadata: baseMetadata,
   295	            permissions:
   296	                Object.keys(permissions).length > 0 ? permissions : undefined,
   297	        },
   298	    });
   299	
   300	    if (!created?.id || !created?.key) {
   301	        throw new HTTPException(500, {
   302	            message: "Failed to create API key",
   303	        });
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    const finalMetadata = {
   307	        ...baseMetadata,
   308	        ...(isPublishable && { plaintextKey: created.key }),
   309	    };
   310	
   311	    const d1Updates: Partial<typeof schema.apikey.$inferInsert> = {
   312	        metadata: JSON.stringify(finalMetadata),
   313	    };
   314	    if (effectivePollenBudget != null) {
   315	        d1Updates.pollenBalance = effectivePollenBudget;
   316	    }
   317	    if (questPollenOnly) d1Updates.questPollenOnly = true;
   318	    if (!isPublishable && attribution) {
   319	        d1Updates.byopClientKeyId = attribution.clientId;
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    await db
   323	        .update(schema.apikey)
   324	        .set(d1Updates)
   325	        .where(eq(schema.apikey.id, created.id));
   326	
   327	    return {
   328	        id: created.id,
   329	        key: created.key,
   330	        name: created.name,
   331	        type,
   332	        prefix,
   333	        start: created.start,
   334	        expiresAt: created.expiresAt,
   335	        expiresIn,
   336	        permissions: Object.keys(permissions).length > 0 ? permissions : null,
   337	        pollenBudget: effectivePollenBudget ?? null,
   338	        questPollenOnly,
   339	        byopClientKeyId:
   340	            !isPublishable && attribution ? attribution.clientId : null,
   341	        metadata: finalMetadata,
   342	    };
   343	}
===== shared/auth/api-key-expires-in.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * Key lifetime in whole seconds from now. Shared by every path that accepts
     5	 * an `expiresIn` for an API key (key creation, the OAuth code grant and the
     6	 * device grant) so they all accept and reject the same values.
     7	 */
     8	export const apiKeyExpiresInSchema = z
     9	    .number()
    10	    .int()
    11	    .positive()
    12	    .refine(
    13	        (seconds) =>
    14	            Number.isFinite(new Date(Date.now() + seconds * 1000).getTime()),
    15	        "Expiry is outside the supported date range",
    16	    );
===== shared/auth/api-key-metadata.ts =====
     1	export function parseMetadata(
     2	    raw: string | null | undefined,
     3	): Record<string, unknown> {
     4	    if (!raw) return {};
     5	    try {
     6	        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
     7	        return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
     8	            ? parsed
     9	            : {};
    10	    } catch {
    11	        return {};
    12	    }
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function getRedirectUris(meta: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    16	    const list = meta.redirectUris;
    17	    return Array.isArray(list)
    18	        ? list.filter(
    19	              (value): value is string =>
    20	                  typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0,
    21	          )
    22	        : [];
    23	}

    67	export class BannedAccountError extends Error {
    68	    constructor(message = "Account banned") {
    69	        super(message);
    70	        this.name = "BannedAccountError";
    71	    }
    72	}

    74	export class StagingAccessDeniedError extends Error {
    75	    constructor() {
    76	        super("staging is invite-only");
    77	        this.name = "StagingAccessDeniedError";
    78	    }
    79	}
    80	
    81	/**
    82	 * Throws StagingAccessDeniedError if the env is staging and the user is not in
    83	 * either staging allowlist. No-op outside staging.
    84	 * Fails closed: a missing user or empty/missing allowlists deny access.
    85	 *
    86	 * Called at request-time (every API-key or session-cookie request) to defend
    87	 * against pre-existing sessions/keys that predate the lockdown. See #11137.
    88	 */
    89	export function assertStagingAccess(
    90	    env: {
    91	        ENVIRONMENT?: string;
    92	        STAGING_ALLOWED_GITHUB_IDS?: string;
    93	        STAGING_ALLOWED_EMAILS?: string;
    94	    },
    95	    user:
    96	        | { githubId?: number | null; email?: string | null }
    97	        | null
    98	        | undefined,
    99	): void {
   100	    if (env.ENVIRONMENT !== "staging") return;
   101	    const allowedGithubIds = parseGithubIdList(env.STAGING_ALLOWED_GITHUB_IDS);
   102	    const allowedEmails = parseEmailList(env.STAGING_ALLOWED_EMAILS);
   103	    const ghId = user?.githubId;
   104	    const email = normalizeEmail(user?.email);
   105	    if (
   106	        (!ghId || !allowedGithubIds.has(Number(ghId))) &&
   107	        (!email || !allowedEmails.has(email))
   108	    ) {
   109	        throw new StagingAccessDeniedError();
   110	    }
   111	}
   112	
   113	export function parseEmailList(raw: string | undefined | null): Set<string> {
   114	    if (!raw) return new Set();
   115	    const emails = new Set<string>();
   116	    for (const part of raw.split(",")) {
   117	        const normalized = normalizeEmail(part);
   118	        if (normalized) emails.add(normalized);
   119	    }
   120	    return emails;
   121	}
   122	
   123	function normalizeEmail(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
   124	    const normalized = value?.trim().toLowerCase();
   125	    return normalized?.includes("@") ? normalized : null;
   126	}
   127	
   128	export function createApiKeyPlugin() {
   129	    return apiKey({
   130	        enableMetadata: true,
   131	        deferUpdates: true,
   132	        defaultPrefix: PUBLISHABLE_KEY_PREFIX,
   133	        defaultKeyLength: 16,
   134	        minimumNameLength: 1,
   135	        maximumNameLength: 253,
   136	        startingCharactersConfig: {
   137	            charactersLength: 10,
   138	        },
   139	        customKeyGenerator: (options: {
   140	            length: number;
   141	            prefix: string | undefined;
   142	        }) => {
   143	            const isPublishable = options.prefix === PUBLISHABLE_KEY_PREFIX;
   144	            const keyLength = isPublishable ? 16 : 32;
   145	            const chars =
   146	                "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";
   147	            const randomBytes = crypto.getRandomValues(
   148	                new Uint8Array(keyLength),
   149	            );
   150	            const key = Array.from(
   151	                randomBytes,
   152	                (byte) => chars[byte % chars.length],
   153	            ).join("");
   154	            return options.prefix ? `${options.prefix}_${key}` : key;
   155	        },
   156	        keyExpiration: {
   157	            minExpiresIn: 0,
   158	            // Override Better Auth's 365-day default with JavaScript Date's range.
   159	            maxExpiresIn: 100_000_000,
   160	        },
   161	        rateLimit: {
   162	            enabled: false,
   163	        },
   164	    });
   165	}
