    36	export type CommunityModelRewardInput = {
    37	    userId: string;
    38	    rewardRate: number;
    39	    /**
    40	     * What to pay the reward on, when that is not what the caller was charged.
    41	     * A fallback owner is paid on their own listing: the caller bought the
    42	     * model they asked for, so rewarding a share of that price would pay the
    43	     * rescuer more than they charge for the same work.
    44	     */
    45	    basePrice?: number;
    46	};
    47	
    48	export function selectCommunityModelReward(
    49	    requestedCommunityEndpoint: CommunityEndpointRuntime | null | undefined,
    50	    servedCommunityEndpoint: CommunityEndpointRuntime | null | undefined,
    51	    servedPrice: number | undefined,
    52	): CommunityModelRewardInput | null {
    53	    if (servedCommunityEndpoint?.visibility === "public") {
    54	        return {
    55	            userId: servedCommunityEndpoint.ownerUserId,
    56	            rewardRate: COMMUNITY_MODEL_REWARD_RATE,
    57	            basePrice: servedPrice,
    58	        };
    59	    }
    60	
    61	    if (
    62	        requestedCommunityEndpoint?.visibility === "public" &&
    63	        servedCommunityEndpoint?.visibility === "private" &&
    64	        servedCommunityEndpoint.ownerUserId ===
    65	            requestedCommunityEndpoint.ownerUserId
    66	    ) {
    67	        return {
    68	            userId: requestedCommunityEndpoint.ownerUserId,
    69	            rewardRate: COMMUNITY_MODEL_REWARD_RATE,
    70	            basePrice: servedPrice,
    71	        };
    72	    }
    73	
    74	    return null;
    75	}
    76	
    77	interface DeductionParams {
    78	    db: DrizzleD1Database;
    79	    isBilledUsage: boolean;
    80	    totalPrice?: number;
    81	    userId?: string;
    82	    apiKeyId?: string;
    83	    apiKeyPollenBalance?: number | null;
    84	    apiKeyReservedAmount?: number;
    85	    byopClientKeyId?: string | null;
    86	    modelPaidOnly?: boolean;
    87	    /** The key never spends paid Pollen, so the charge always takes Quest Pollen. */
    88	    questPollenOnly?: boolean;
    89	    communityModelReward?: CommunityModelRewardInput | null;
    90	}
    91	
    92	export async function resolveDevMarkup(
    93	    db: DrizzleD1Database,
    94	    byopClientKeyId: string | null | undefined,
    95	    baselinePrice: number,
    96	    payerUserId: string | undefined,
    97	): Promise<MarkupResolution | null> {
    98	    if (!byopClientKeyId || !payerUserId) return null;
    99	
   100	    const credit = computeDevCredit(baselinePrice);
   101	    if (credit <= 0) return null;
   102	
   103	    const [clientRow] = await db
   104	        .select({
   105	            userId: apikeyTable.referenceId,
   106	            metadata: apikeyTable.metadata,
   107	            prefix: apikeyTable.prefix,
   108	            enabled: apikeyTable.enabled,
   109	            expiresAt: apikeyTable.expiresAt,
   110	        })
   111	        .from(apikeyTable)
   112	        .where(
   113	            and(
   114	                eq(apikeyTable.id, byopClientKeyId),
   115	                eq(apikeyTable.prefix, "pk"),
   116	                eq(apikeyTable.enabled, true),
   117	                or(
   118	                    isNull(apikeyTable.expiresAt),
   119	                    gt(apikeyTable.expiresAt, new Date()),
   120	                ),
   121	            ),
   122	        )
   123	        .limit(1);
   124	
   125	    if (!byopClientAllowsMarkup(clientRow, payerUserId)) return null;
   126	
   127	    return {
   128	        devUserId: clientRow.userId,
   129	        devCredit: credit,
   130	        markupRate: MARKUP_PCT,
   131	    };
   132	}
   133	
   134	export function resolveCommunityModelReward(
   135	    reward: CommunityModelRewardInput | null | undefined,
   136	    baselinePrice: number,
   137	    payerUserId: string | undefined,
   138	): CommunityModelRewardResolution | null {
   139	    if (!reward || !payerUserId) return null;
   140	    // Never above what was charged: a target repriced between resolving the
   141	    // fallback and settling the request must not pay out more than we took.
   142	    const rewardBase = Math.min(
   143	        reward.basePrice ?? baselinePrice,
   144	        baselinePrice,
   145	    );
   146	    if (rewardBase <= 0 || reward.rewardRate <= 0) return null;
   147	
   148	    const credit = roundPollenLedgerAmount(rewardBase * reward.rewardRate);
   149	    if (credit <= 0) return null;
   150	
   151	    return {
   152	        userId: reward.userId,
   153	        rewardRate: reward.rewardRate,
   154	        credit,
   155	    };
   156	}
   157	
   158	/**
   159	 * Handles balance deduction and developer credits for billable requests.
   160	 *
   161	 * The pipeline, in order:
   162	 *
   163	 *   1. resolve markup eligibility (DB lookup) and the community reward (pure),
   164	 *   2. compute `billedPrice` (baseline + markup, snapped to ledger precision),
   165	 *   3. deduct the payer (user balance, then API-key budget),
   166	 *   4. credit the dev (BYOP markup) and community owner (reward).
   167	 *
   168	 * Returns `billedPrice` — the rounded amount actually debited from the payer
   169	 * (`totalPrice + devCredit`, snapped to `POLLEN_BILLING_PRECISION`). Callers
   170	 * should use this for analytics/event totals so they match the ledger.
   171	 */
   172	export async function handleBalanceDeduction(params: DeductionParams): Promise<{
   173	    markup: MarkupResolution | null;
   174	    communityModelReward: CommunityModelRewardResolution | null;
   175	    payerBucket: Bucket | null;
   176	    postDeductionPackBalance: number | null;
   177	    lastPackPollen: number | null;
   178	    billedPrice: number;
   179	}> {
   180	    const {
   181	        db,
   182	        isBilledUsage,
   183	        totalPrice,
   184	        userId,
   185	        apiKeyId,
   186	        apiKeyPollenBalance,
   187	        apiKeyReservedAmount,
   188	        byopClientKeyId,
   189	        modelPaidOnly,
   190	        questPollenOnly,
   191	        communityModelReward: communityModelRewardInput,
   192	    } = params;
   193	
   194	    if (
   195	        apiKeyId &&
   196	        hasApiKeyBudget(apiKeyPollenBalance) &&
   197	        apiKeyReservedAmount === undefined
   198	    ) {
   199	        throw new Error(
   200	            `API key budget reservation is missing for ${apiKeyId}`,
   201	        );
   202	    }
   203	
   204	    if (!isBilledUsage || totalPrice == null || totalPrice === 0) {
   205	        await reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   206	            db,
   207	            apiKeyId,
   208	            apiKeyPollenBalance,
   209	            apiKeyReservedAmount,
   210	            0,
   211	        );
   212	        return {
   213	            markup: null,
   214	            communityModelReward: null,
   215	            payerBucket: null,
   216	            postDeductionPackBalance: null,
   217	            lastPackPollen: null,
   218	            billedPrice: 0,
   219	        };
   220	    }
   221	
   222	    // The caller already bears the upstream cost of their own community
   223	    // endpoint. Do not charge them through Pollinations or pay them back a
   224	    // partial reward. The reward input follows the endpoint that actually
   225	    // served the request, so a fallback owned by somebody else is still billed.
   226	    if (communityModelRewardInput?.userId === userId) {
   227	        await reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   228	            db,
   229	            apiKeyId,
   230	            apiKeyPollenBalance,
   231	            apiKeyReservedAmount,
   232	            0,
   233	        );
   234	        return {
   235	            markup: null,
   236	            communityModelReward: null,
   237	            payerBucket: null,
   238	            postDeductionPackBalance: null,
   239	            lastPackPollen: null,
   240	            billedPrice: 0,
   241	        };
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    // 1. Resolve the two independent "who else gets money" inputs.
   245	    let markup: MarkupResolution | null;
   246	    try {
   247	        markup = await resolveDevMarkup(
   248	            db,
   249	            byopClientKeyId,
   250	            totalPrice,
   251	            userId,
   252	        );
   253	    } catch (error) {
   254	        await reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   255	            db,
   256	            apiKeyId,
   257	            apiKeyPollenBalance,
   258	            apiKeyReservedAmount,
   259	            0,
   260	        );
   261	        throw error;
   262	    }
   263	    let communityModelReward = resolveCommunityModelReward(
   264	        communityModelRewardInput,
   265	        totalPrice,
   266	        userId,
   267	    );
   268	
   269	    // 2. The payer is charged baseline + markup (the community reward is paid
   270	    //    out of the baseline, not added on top of what the payer owes).
   271	    const billedPrice = computeBilledPrice(totalPrice, markup);
   272	
   273	    // 3. Deduct the payer. Markup and reward credits go to the same bucket the
   274	    //    payer drew from, so they are only possible once that bucket is known.
   275	    let payerBucket: Bucket | null = null;
   276	    let postDeductionPackBalance: number | null = null;
   277	    let lastPackPollen: number | null = null;
   278	    let payerDeducted = !userId;
   279	
   280	    try {
   281	        if (userId) {
   282	            const deduction = await deductUserBalance(
   283	                db,
   284	                userId,
   285	                billedPrice,
   286	                modelPaidOnly,
   287	                questPollenOnly,
   288	            );
   289	            payerBucket = deduction.bucket;
   290	            postDeductionPackBalance = deduction.postDeductionPackBalance;
   291	            lastPackPollen = deduction.lastPackPollen;
   292	            payerDeducted = true;
   293	            if (
   294	                deduction.postDeductionBalance != null &&
   295	                deduction.postDeductionBalance < 0
   296	            ) {
   297	                markup = null;
   298	                communityModelReward = null;
   299	                log.warn(
   300	                    "Suppressed generation credits because the payer's {bucket} balance is negative after deduction ({balance})",
   301	                    {
   302	                        bucket: payerBucket,
   303	                        balance: deduction.postDeductionBalance,
   304	                    },
   305	                );
   306	            }
   307	        }
   308	
   309	        // API key budgets are decremented by the amount the user authorized the
   310	        // app to spend, including BYOP markup when it applies. Later failures
   311	        // must not discard the committed user debit.
   312	        if (apiKeyId && hasApiKeyBudget(apiKeyPollenBalance)) {
   313	            try {
   314	                await reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   315	                    db,
   316	                    apiKeyId,
   317	                    apiKeyPollenBalance,
   318	                    apiKeyReservedAmount,
   319	                    billedPrice,
   320	                );
   321	            } catch (error) {
   322	                log.error(
   323	                    "API key reconciliation failed for {keyId} after committed debit: {error}",
   324	                    {
   325	                        keyId: apiKeyId,
   326	                        error:
   327	                            error instanceof Error
   328	                                ? error.message
   329	                                : String(error),
   330	                    },
   331	                );
   332	            }
   333	        }
   334	
   335	        // 4. Credits. Both require a payer bucket (nothing to net against
   336	        //    otherwise) and write to it so the flows stay in balance.
   337	        if (markup) {
   338	            try {
   339	                await creditDev(db, markup, payerBucket);
   340	            } catch (error) {
   341	                log.error("Dev credit failed for {devUserId}: {error}", {
   342	                    devUserId: markup.devUserId,
   343	                    error:
   344	                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   345	                });
   346	                markup = null;
   347	            }
   348	        }
   349	        if (communityModelReward) {
   350	            try {
   351	                await creditCommunityOwner(
   352	                    db,
   353	                    communityModelReward,
   354	                    payerBucket,
   355	                );
   356	            } catch (error) {
   357	                log.error(
   358	                    "Community model reward failed for {userId}: {error}",
   359	                    {
   360	                        userId: communityModelReward.userId,
   361	                        error:
   362	                            error instanceof Error
   363	                                ? error.message
   364	                                : String(error),
   365	                    },
   366	                );
   367	                communityModelReward = null;
   368	            }
   369	        }
   370	    } catch (error) {
   371	        if (!payerDeducted) {
   372	            try {
   373	                await reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   374	                    db,
   375	                    apiKeyId,
   376	                    apiKeyPollenBalance,
   377	                    apiKeyReservedAmount,
   378	                    0,
   379	                );
   380	            } catch (releaseError) {
   381	                log.error(
   382	                    "Failed to release API key reservation after payer deduction failed: {error}",
   383	                    {
   384	                        error:
   385	                            releaseError instanceof Error
   386	                                ? releaseError.message
   387	                                : String(releaseError),
   388	                    },
   389	                );
   390	            }
   391	        }
   392	        throw error;
   393	    }
   394	
   395	    return {
   396	        markup,
   397	        communityModelReward,
   398	        payerBucket,
   399	        postDeductionPackBalance,
   400	        lastPackPollen,
   401	        billedPrice,
   402	    };
   403	}
   404	
   405	/** Baseline charge + dev markup, snapped to the shared ledger precision. */
   406	function computeBilledPrice(
   407	    totalPrice: number,
   408	    markup: MarkupResolution | null,
   409	): number {
   410	    return roundPollenLedgerAmount(totalPrice + (markup?.devCredit ?? 0));
   411	}
   412	
   413	/** Credit the dev the BYOP markup, into the bucket the payer drew from. */
   414	async function creditDev(
   415	    db: DrizzleD1Database,
   416	    markup: MarkupResolution,
   417	    payerBucket: Bucket | null,
   418	): Promise<void> {
   419	    if (!payerBucket) {
   420	        throw new Error("BYOP markup requires a payer balance bucket");
   421	    }
   422	    const creditAmount = roundPollenLedgerAmount(markup.devCredit);
   423	    const { ok } = await atomicCreditUserBalance(
   424	        db,
   425	        markup.devUserId,
   426	        payerBucket,
   427	        creditAmount,
   428	    );
   429	    if (!ok) {
   430	        throw new Error(
   431	            `Dev credit UPDATE affected 0 rows for ${markup.devUserId}`,
   432	        );
   433	    }
   434	    log.debug(
   435	        "Credited {credit} pollen to dev {devUserId} {bucket} balance (markup={pct}%)",
   436	        {
   437	            credit: creditAmount,
   438	            devUserId: markup.devUserId,
   439	            bucket: payerBucket,
   440	            pct: (markup.markupRate * 100).toFixed(0),
   441	        },
   442	    );
   443	}
   444	
   445	/** Credit the community model owner their reward, into the payer's bucket. */
   446	async function creditCommunityOwner(
   447	    db: DrizzleD1Database,
   448	    reward: CommunityModelRewardResolution,
   449	    payerBucket: Bucket | null,
   450	): Promise<void> {
   451	    if (!payerBucket) {
   452	        throw new Error(
   453	            "Community model reward requires a payer balance bucket",
   454	        );
   455	    }
   456	    const { ok } = await atomicCreditUserBalance(
   457	        db,
   458	        reward.userId,
   459	        payerBucket,
   460	        reward.credit,
   461	    );
   462	    if (!ok) {
   463	        throw new Error(
   464	            `Community model reward UPDATE affected 0 rows for ${reward.userId}`,
   465	        );
   466	    }
   467	    log.debug(
   468	        "Credited {credit} pollen to community model owner {userId} {bucket} balance (reward={pct}%)",
   469	        {
   470	            credit: reward.credit,
   471	            userId: reward.userId,
   472	            bucket: payerBucket,
   473	            pct: (reward.rewardRate * 100).toFixed(0),
   474	        },
   475	    );
   476	}
   477	
   478	function hasApiKeyBudget(
   479	    balance: number | null | undefined,
   480	): balance is number {
   481	    return typeof balance === "number";
   482	}
   483	
   484	async function reconcileApiKeyBalance(
   485	    db: DrizzleD1Database,
   486	    apiKeyId: string | undefined,
   487	    apiKeyPollenBalance: number | null | undefined,
   488	    reservedAmount: number | undefined,
   489	    billedAmount: number,
   490	): Promise<void> {
   491	    if (!apiKeyId || !hasApiKeyBudget(apiKeyPollenBalance)) return;
   492	    if (reservedAmount === undefined) {
   493	        throw new Error(
   494	            `API key budget reservation is missing for ${apiKeyId}`,
   495	        );
   496	    }
   497	
   498	    const adjustment = roundPollenLedgerAmount(billedAmount - reservedAmount);
   499	    try {
   500	        const { ok } = await atomicAdjustApiKeyBalance(
   501	            db,
   502	            apiKeyId,
   503	            adjustment,
   504	        );
   505	        if (!ok) {
   506	            throw new Error(
   507	                `API key budget reconciliation affected 0 rows for ${apiKeyId}`,
   508	            );
   509	        }
   510	        log.debug(
   511	            "Reconciled API key {keyId} budget from reserved={reserved} to billed={billed}",
   512	            { keyId: apiKeyId, reserved: reservedAmount, billed: billedAmount },
   513	        );
   514	    } catch (error) {
   515	        log.error("Failed to reconcile API key budget for {keyId}: {error}", {
   516	            keyId: apiKeyId,
   517	            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : error,
   518	        });
   519	        throw error;
   520	    }
   521	}
   522	
   523	async function deductUserBalance(
   524	    db: DrizzleD1Database,
   525	    userId: string,
   526	    amount: number,
   527	    modelPaidOnly?: boolean,
   528	    questPollenOnly?: boolean,
   529	): Promise<{
   530	    bucket: Bucket | null;
   531	    postDeductionPackBalance: number | null;
   532	    lastPackPollen: number | null;
   533	    postDeductionBalance: number | null;
   534	}> {
   535	    try {
   536	        const {
   537	            ok,
   538	            bucket,
   539	            packBalance,
   540	            lastPackPollen,
   541	            postDeductionBalance,
   542	        } = await atomicDeductUserBalance(
   543	            db,
   544	            userId,
   545	            amount,
   546	            modelPaidOnly ?? false,
   547	            questPollenOnly ?? false,
   548	        );
   549	        if (!ok) {
   550	            throw new Error(
   551	                `User balance deduction affected 0 rows for ${userId}`,
   552	            );
   553	        }
   554	        const deductionSource = {
   555	            fromTier: bucket === "tier" ? amount : 0,
   556	            fromPack: bucket === "pack" ? amount : 0,
   557	        };
   558	
   559	        log.debug(
   560	            "Decremented {price} pollen from user {userId} (quest: -{fromTier}, pack: -{fromPack})",
   561	            {
   562	                price: amount,
   563	                userId,
   564	                ...deductionSource,
   565	            },
   566	        );
   567	        return {
   568	            bucket,
   569	            postDeductionPackBalance: bucket === "pack" ? packBalance : null,
   570	            lastPackPollen,
   571	            postDeductionBalance,
   572	        };
   573	    } catch (error) {
   574	        log.error("Failed to decrement user balance for {userId}: {error}", {
   575	            userId,
   576	            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   577	        });
   578	        throw error;
   579	    }
   580	}
===== shared/cache.ts =====
     1	import type { Logger } from "@logtape/logtape";
     2	
     3	interface CacheOptions<TArgs extends unknown[]> {
     4	    log: Logger;
     5	    ttl: number;
     6	    kv: KVNamespace;
     7	    keyGenerator: (...args: TArgs) => string | Promise<string>;
     8	}
     9	
    10	interface CacheEntry<T> {
    11	    value: T;
    12	    ttl: number;
    13	}
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * Creates a cached version of an async function using Cloudflare KV
    17	 * @param fn The async function to cache
    18	 * @param options Cache configuration options
    19	 * @returns A cached version of the function
    20	 */
    21	export function cached<TArgs extends unknown[], TReturn>(
    22	    fn: (...args: TArgs) => Promise<TReturn>,
    23	    options: CacheOptions<TArgs>,
    24	): (...args: TArgs) => Promise<TReturn> {
    25	    const { ttl, kv, keyGenerator, log } = options;
    26	
    27	    return async (...args: TArgs): Promise<TReturn> => {
    28	        const cacheKey = await keyGenerator(...args);
    29	
    30	        try {
    31	            log.trace("Fetching from cache: {key}", { key: cacheKey });
    32	            const cachedData = (await kv.get(
    33	                cacheKey,
    34	                "json",
    35	            )) as CacheEntry<TReturn> | null;
    36	            if (cachedData) {
    37	                const ttlChanged = cachedData.ttl !== ttl;
    38	                if (!ttlChanged) {
    39	                    return cachedData.value;
    40	                }
    41	            }
    42	        } catch (error) {
    43	            log.warn("Failed to read from cache: {error}", { error });
    44	        }
    45	
    46	        log.trace("Executing function: {key}", { key: cacheKey });
    47	        const result = await fn(...args);
    48	
    49	        try {
    50	            log.trace("Writing to cache: {key}", { key: cacheKey });
    51	            const cacheEntry: CacheEntry<TReturn> = {
    52	                value: result,
    53	                ttl,
    54	            };
    55	            await kv.put(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(cacheEntry), {
    56	                expirationTtl: ttl,
    57	            });
    58	        } catch (error) {
    59	            log.warn("Failed to write to cache: {error}", { error });
    60	        }
    61	
    62	        return result;
    63	    };
    64	}

     3	/** The visitor IP that Cloudflare saw. Clients cannot set CF-Connecting-IP. */

     8	/** Lowercase, zero-padded hex encoding of a byte buffer. */
     9	export function bytesToHex(bytes: ArrayBuffer): string {
    10	    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(bytes))
    11	        .map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    12	        .join("");
    13	}
    14	
    15	/** Salted SHA-256 hash of the full IP — irreversible without the salt. */
    16	export async function hashIp(
    17	    ip: string | undefined,
    18	    salt: string,
    19	): Promise<string | undefined> {
    20	    if (!ip) return undefined;
    21	    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${salt}:${ip}`);
    22	    return bytesToHex(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data));
    23	}
    24	
    25	/** Strip `::ffff:` prefix from IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. */
    26	export function stripIPv4MappedPrefix(ip: string): string {
    27	    const match = ip.match(/^::ffff:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$/i);
    28	    return match ? match[1] : ip;
    29	}
    30	
    31	/** Expand IPv6 `::` shorthand to full 8-group form. */
    32	function expandIPv6(ip: string): string {
    33	    if (!ip.includes("::")) {
    34	        return ip
    35	            .split(":")
    36	            .map((group) => group.padStart(4, "0"))
    37	            .join(":");
    38	    }
    39	    const halves = ip.split("::");
    40	    const left = halves[0] ? halves[0].split(":") : [];
    41	    const right = halves[1] ? halves[1].split(":") : [];
    42	    const middle = Array(8 - left.length - right.length).fill("0000");
    43	    return [...left, ...middle, ...right]
    44	        .map((group) => group.padStart(4, "0"))
    45	        .join(":");
    46	}
    47	
    48	/** Truncate IP to /24 subnet (IPv4) or /48 subnet (IPv6, first 3 groups). */
    49	export function truncateIpToSubnet(ip: string | undefined): string | undefined {
    50	    if (!ip) return undefined;
    51	    const normalized = stripIPv4MappedPrefix(ip);
    52	    if (normalized.includes(".")) {
    53	        const parts = normalized.split(".");
    54	        if (parts.length === 4) return `${parts[0]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[2]}.0`;
    55	    }
    56	    if (normalized.includes(":")) {
    57	        const groups = expandIPv6(normalized).split(":");
    58	        return `${groups[0]}:${groups[1]}:${groups[2]}::`;
    59	    }
    60	    return undefined;
    61	}
===== shared/community-endpoint-urls.ts =====
     1	export function validateCommunityEndpointUrl(value: string): string {
     2	    if (value !== value.trim()) {
     3	        throw new Error("Endpoint URL cannot include surrounding whitespace");
     4	    }
     5	    const url = new URL(value);
     6	    if (url.protocol !== "https:") {
     7	        throw new Error("Endpoint URL must use https");
     8	    }
     9	    if (url.username || url.password) {
    10	        throw new Error("Endpoint URL cannot include credentials");
    11	    }
    12	    if (isBlockedHostname(url.hostname)) {
    13	        throw new Error("Endpoint URL cannot target a private host");
    14	    }
    15	    if (url.hash) {
    16	        throw new Error("Endpoint URL cannot include a fragment");
    17	    }
    18	    return value;
    19	}
    20	
    21	export function normalizeCommunityAssetUrl(
    22	    value: string,
    23	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
    24	): string {
    25	    const url = new URL(value);
    26	    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") {
    27	        throw new Error("Image URL must use http or https");
    28	    }
    29	    if (url.username || url.password || isBlockedHostname(url.hostname)) {
    30	        throw new Error("Image URL cannot target a private host");
    31	    }
    32	    if (
    33	        url.protocol === "http:" &&
    34	        url.hostname !== new URL(endpointBaseUrl).hostname
    35	    ) {
    36	        throw new Error("HTTP image URL must use the endpoint host");
    37	    }
    38	    url.hash = "";
    39	    return url.toString();
    40	}

    70	export function communityOpenAIBaseUrl(baseUrl: string): string {
    71	    const validated = validateCommunityEndpointUrl(baseUrl);
    72	    const url = new URL(validated);
    73	    const suffix = configuredCommunityEndpointSuffix(url);
    74	    if (!suffix) return validated;
    75	    const pathname = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    76	    url.pathname = pathname.slice(0, -suffix.length);
    77	    return url.toString();
    78	}
    79	
    80	const COMMUNITY_OPENAI_ENDPOINT_SUFFIXES = [
    81	    "/chat/completions",
    82	    "/images/generations",
    83	    "/images/edits",
    84	    "/audio/transcriptions",
    85	    "/audio/speech",
    86	    "/embeddings",
    87	    "/responses",
    88	] as const;
    89	
    90	function configuredCommunityEndpointSuffix(url: URL): string | undefined {
    91	    const pathname = url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    92	    return COMMUNITY_OPENAI_ENDPOINT_SUFFIXES.find((suffix) =>
    93	        pathname.endsWith(suffix),
    94	    );
    95	}
    96	
    97	function communityOpenAIEndpointUrl(baseUrl: string, suffix: string): string {
    98	    const validated = validateCommunityEndpointUrl(baseUrl);
    99	    if (configuredCommunityEndpointSuffix(new URL(validated)) === suffix) {
   100	        return validated;
   101	    }
   102	    const url = new URL(communityOpenAIBaseUrl(validated));
   103	    url.pathname = `${url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "")}${suffix}`;
   104	    return url.toString();
   105	}
   106	
   107	export function isBlockedHostname(hostname: string): boolean {
   108	    const host = hostname
   109	        .replace(/^\[|\]$/g, "")
   110	        .replace(/\.$/, "")
   111	        .toLowerCase();
   112	    if (host === "localhost" || host.endsWith(".localhost")) return true;
   113	    if (host.endsWith(".local")) return true;
   114	    if (host.includes(":")) return true;
   115	    if (host.startsWith("127.") || host.startsWith("10.")) return true;
   116	    if (host.startsWith("169.254.")) return true;
   117	    if (host.startsWith("100.")) {
   118	        const second = Number(host.split(".")[1]);
   119	        if (second >= 64 && second <= 127) return true;
   120	    }
   121	    if (host.startsWith("192.168.")) return true;
   122	    const ipv4 = host.split(".").map(Number);
   123	    if (
   124	        ipv4.length === 4 &&
   125	        ipv4.every(
   126	            (part) => Number.isInteger(part) && part >= 0 && part <= 255,
   127	        ) &&
   128	        (ipv4[0] === 0 ||
   129	            (ipv4[0] ?? 0) >= 224 ||
   130	            (ipv4[0] === 198 && (ipv4[1] === 18 || ipv4[1] === 19)))
   131	    ) {
   132	        return true;
   133	    }
   134	    const match172 = host.match(/^172\.(\d+)\./);
   135	    if (match172) {
   136	        const second = Number(match172[1]);
   137	        if (second >= 16 && second <= 31) return true;
   138	    }
   139	    return false;
   140	}

   139	export function normalizeCommunityEndpointAdvertised(
   140	    value: CommunityEndpointAdvertised | null | undefined,
   141	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality,
   142	): CommunityEndpointAdvertised {
   143	    if (!value || modality !== "text") return {};
   144	    const advertised: CommunityEndpointAdvertised = {};
   145	    if (value.capabilities?.length) {
   146	        const declared = new Set<string>(value.capabilities);
   147	        const capabilities = COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_CAPABILITIES.filter(
   148	            (capability) => declared.has(capability),
   149	        );
   150	        if (capabilities.length) advertised.capabilities = capabilities;
   151	    }
   152	    if (value.contextLength) advertised.contextLength = value.contextLength;
   153	    if (value.streaming === false) advertised.streaming = false;
   154	    return advertised;
   155	}

   209	        rawUsagePaths: OPENAI_CHAT_USAGE_PATHS[usageType],
   210	        ...COMMUNITY_PRICE_FIELD_BY_USAGE_TYPE[usageType],
   211	    }),
   212	) as readonly {
   213	    key: (typeof COMMUNITY_PRICE_FIELD_BY_USAGE_TYPE)[OpenAIChatUsageType]["key"];
   214	    usageType: OpenAIChatUsageType;
   215	    label: string;
   216	    priceUnit: "million";
   217	    rawUsagePaths: readonly string[];
   218	}[];

   327	export type CommunityEndpointPriceField =
   328	    | (typeof COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS)[number]
   329	    | (typeof COMMUNITY_IMAGE_TOKEN_PRICE_FIELDS)[number]
   330	    | (typeof COMMUNITY_TRANSCRIPTION_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS)[number]

   334	type CommunityModalitySpec = {
   335	    category: Category;
   336	    inputModalities: readonly ModelInputModality[];
   337	    outputModalities: readonly ModelOutputModality[];
   338	    supportedEndpoints: readonly string[];
   339	    // Specialized categories such as transcription must reject sibling routes
   340	    // unless the route explicitly opts into this endpoint list.
   341	    restrictDefinitionEndpoints?: boolean;
   342	    endpointsByInputModality?: Partial<
   343	        Record<ModelInputModality, readonly string[]>
   344	    >;
   345	    priceFields: readonly CommunityEndpointPriceField[];
   346	    tokenPriceFields?: readonly CommunityEndpointPriceField[];
   347	};

   349	/**
   350	 * Maps each community upstream API shape to the ordinary catalog contract it
   351	 * publishes. The upstream modality deliberately remains distinct from the
   352	 * catalog category: transcription endpoints, for example, are catalogued as
   353	 * audio models with text output.
   354	 */

   407	
   408	export function communityEndpointPriceFieldsForModality(
   409	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality,
   410	    imagePricing: CommunityEndpointImagePricing = "request",
   411	): readonly CommunityEndpointPriceField[] {
   412	    const spec: CommunityModalitySpec = COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[modality];
   413	    if (imagePricing === "tokens" && spec.tokenPriceFields) {
   414	        return spec.tokenPriceFields;
   415	    }
   416	    return spec.priceFields;
   417	}
   418	
   419	export function communityEndpointSupportedEndpoints(
   420	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality,
   421	    inputModalities: readonly ModelInputModality[],
   422	): string[] {
   423	    const spec: CommunityModalitySpec = COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[modality];
   424	    const endpoints = [...spec.supportedEndpoints];
   425	    for (const inputModality of inputModalities) {
   426	        endpoints.push(
   427	            ...(spec.endpointsByInputModality?.[inputModality] ?? []),
   428	        );
   429	    }
   430	    return endpoints;
   431	}
   432	
   433	export type CommunityEndpointPriceKey =
   434	    (typeof COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS)[number]["key"];
   435	
   436	export type CommunityEndpointPrices = Record<CommunityEndpointPriceKey, number>;
   437	
   438	export function communityEndpointPrices(
   439	    source: Partial<CommunityEndpointPrices>,
   440	): CommunityEndpointPrices {
   441	    return Object.fromEntries(
   442	        COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS.map((field) => [
   443	            field.key,
   444	            source[field.key] ?? 0,
   445	        ]),
   446	    ) as CommunityEndpointPrices;
   447	}
   448	
   449	/**
   450	 * True when the owner charges nothing for calling this endpoint. The price set
   451	 * must be complete — a missing field is not a free one.
   452	 */
   453	export function isFreeCommunityEndpoint(
   454	    prices: CommunityEndpointPrices,
   455	): boolean {
   456	    return COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS.every(
   457	        (field) => prices[field.key] === 0,
   458	    );
   459	}
   460	
   461	export function communityEndpointPricesForModality(
   462	    source: Partial<CommunityEndpointPrices>,
   463	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality,
   464	    imagePricing: CommunityEndpointImagePricing = "request",
   465	): CommunityEndpointPrices {
   466	    const allowed = new Set(
   467	        communityEndpointPriceFieldsForModality(modality, imagePricing).map(
   468	            (field) => field.key,
   469	        ),
   470	    );
   471	    return Object.fromEntries(
   472	        COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS.map((field) => [
   473	            field.key,
   474	            allowed.has(field.key) ? (source[field.key] ?? 0) : 0,
   475	        ]),
   476	    ) as CommunityEndpointPrices;
   477	}
   478	
   479	/**
   480	 * Bounds how much latency one request can spend failing before it gives up:
   481	 * every extra target is another upstream timeout the caller waits through.
   482	 * Enforced on write and re-applied when the generation registry links entries.
   483	 */
   484	export const MAX_FALLBACK_TARGETS = 3;
   485	
   486	/**
   487	 * True when `target` costs no more than `primary` on every price field.
   488	 *
   489	 * The caller is charged the primary's price whichever endpoint serves, so this
   490	 * bounds the PAYOUT rather than the invoice: a rescuer is paid on their own
   491	 * listing, and this rule is what guarantees that stays at or below what was
   492	 * charged. It also stops an owner routing traffic to a pricier model whose
   493	 * owner would then earn more than the caller was quoted.
   494	 */
   495	export function isCommunityFallbackPricingAllowed(
   496	    primary: CommunityEndpointPrices,
   497	    target: CommunityEndpointPrices,
   498	): boolean {
   499	    return COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS.every(
   500	        (field) => target[field.key] <= primary[field.key],
   501	    );
   502	}
   503	
   504	/**
   505	 * A fallback cannot require a balance bucket the caller was never required to
   506	 * have for the primary model. A paid-only primary may fall back to either kind.
   507	 */
   508	export function isCommunityFallbackBalanceAllowed(
   509	    primary: { paidOnly: boolean },
   510	    target: { paidOnly?: boolean },
   511	): boolean {
   512	    return !target.paidOnly || primary.paidOnly;
   513	}
   514	
   515	export type CommunityFallbackPrimary = {
   516	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality;
   517	    imagePricing: CommunityEndpointImagePricing;
   518	    paidOnly: boolean;
   519	    inputModalities?: readonly ModelInputModality[] | null;
   520	    prices: CommunityEndpointPrices;
   521	};
   522	
   523	/**
   524	 * Why a Pollinations model cannot serve a community model's failed requests,
   525	 * or null when it can. The caller still pays the community model's price for
   526	 * the served model's usage, so both must count usage in the same units, and
   527	 * no rate sheet of the served model may cost more. A provider-reported charge
   528	 * (`providerBilling`) can still exceed the sheet.
   529	 */
   530	export function staticFallbackRejection(
   531	    primary: CommunityFallbackPrimary,
   532	    target: ModelDefinition,
   533	): string | null {
   534	    const spec: CommunityModalitySpec =
   535	        COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[primary.modality];
   536	    const inputs = normalizeCommunityEndpointInputModalities(
   537	        primary.inputModalities,
   538	        primary.modality,
   539	    );
   540	    if (!isVisibleModelDefinition(target)) return "is not a public model";
   541	    // Gen links a target only if it serves every endpoint of the primary.
   542	    // Static video models default to image routes without /video/{prompt}.
   543	    if (
   544	        primary.modality === "video" ||
   545	        target.category !== spec.category ||
   546	        (target.supportedEndpoints &&
   547	            !communityEndpointSupportedEndpoints(
   548	                primary.modality,
   549	                inputs,
   550	            ).every((endpoint) =>
   551	                target.supportedEndpoints?.includes(endpoint),
   552	            )) ||
   553	        !spec.outputModalities.every((modality) =>
   554	            target.outputModalities?.includes(modality),
   555	        ) ||
   556	        !inputs.every((modality) => target.inputModalities?.includes(modality))
   557	    ) {
   558	        return `cannot serve this model's ${primary.modality} requests`;
   559	    }
   560	    if (
   561	        target.billing ||
   562	        target.priceUnits ||
   563	        isFlatRateModel(target) !==
   564	            (primary.modality === "image" && primary.imagePricing === "request")
   565	    ) {
   566	        return "counts usage in units this model's prices do not cover";
   567	    }
   568	    if (!isCommunityFallbackBalanceAllowed(primary, target)) {
   569	        return "accepts only Paid Pollen, which this model does not require";
   570	    }
   571	    const quoted = communityPriceDefinition(
   572	        primary.prices,
   573	        primary.modality,
   574	        primary.imagePricing,
   575	    );
   576	    // Neither below what Pollinations pays nor below the model's own price.
   577	    const multiplier = Math.max(
   578	        target.priceMultiplier,
   579	        ...Object.values(target.priceMultiplierVariants ?? {}),
   580	        1,
   581	    );
   582	    return getCostSheetsForModel(target).every((cost) =>
   583	        isFallbackPricingAllowed(quoted, derivePrice(cost, multiplier)),
   584	    )
   585	        ? null
   586	        : "costs more than this model";
   587	}
   588	
   589	export function normalizeCommunityEndpointModality(
   590	    value: string | null | undefined,
   591	): CommunityEndpointModality {
   592	    if (value === "transcription") return "transcription";
   593	    if (value === "speech") return "speech";
   594	    if (value === "video") return "video";
   595	    if (value === "image") return "image";
   596	    if (value === "embedding") return "embedding";
   597	    return "text";
   598	}
   599	
   600	export function normalizeCommunityEndpointImagePricing(
   601	    value: string | null | undefined,
   602	): CommunityEndpointImagePricing {
   603	    return value === "tokens" ? "tokens" : "request";
   604	}
   605	
   606	export function normalizeCommunityEndpointInputModalities(
   607	    value: readonly ModelInputModality[] | null | undefined,
   608	    endpointModality: CommunityEndpointModality,
   609	): ModelInputModality[] {
   610	    // Both empty cases — nothing declared, and a declared set that shares
   611	    // nothing with this modality — fall back to the modality's own first
   612	    // input: text for text, image, and video endpoints; audio for transcription.
   613	    // Falling back to a bare "text" would hand a transcription endpoint the
   614	    // one input it cannot accept, which the write path then rejects with a
   615	    // 400 naming an input the owner never chose.
   616	    const permitted = COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[endpointModality].inputModalities;
   617	    const declared = new Set(value ?? []);
   618	    const normalized = permitted.filter((modality) => declared.has(modality));
   619	    return normalized.length ? [...normalized] : [permitted[0]];
   620	}
   621	
   622	// Access/visibility of a registered endpoint. Private is the default; choosing
   623	// public on create or update is allowlist-gated.
   624	//   private → owner-only callable, shown only to the owner, no owner-set price
   625	//   public  → anyone callable, listed in the model catalog, priced
   626	export const COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_VISIBILITIES = ["private", "public"] as const;
   627	
   628	export type CommunityEndpointVisibility =
   629	    (typeof COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_VISIBILITIES)[number];
   630	
   631	/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   632	 * Listing storage
   633	 *
   634	 * A row carries what every listing has — who owns it, what it is called,
   635	 * whether it is published — plus one `payload` whose shape `type` selects.
   636	 * A field that belongs to one kind of listing exists only in that kind's
   637	 * payload, so a listing cannot store a price it never charges or a credential
   638	 * it never sends. The invariants that used to be checked field by field on
   639	 * write are now the absence of somewhere to put the value.
   640	 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
   641	
   642	export const LISTING_TYPES = [
   643	    "proxy",
   644	    "prompt_agent",
   645	    "code_agent",
   646	    "endpoint_agent",
   647	] as const;
   648	
   649	// Prompt agents execute inside Gen and have no upstream URL. The common target
   650	// column remains required for every listing, so store this safe sentinel and
   651	// replace it with Gen's public API URL only when presenting the row to callers.
   652	// The reserved .invalid host guarantees it can never become a real target.
   653	export const PROMPT_AGENT_BASE_URL_PLACEHOLDER =
   654	    "https://agent-runtime.invalid/api/agent-runtime/v1";
   655	export const CODE_AGENT_BASE_URL_PLACEHOLDER =
   656	    "https://code-agent-runtime.invalid/v1/responses";
   657	
   658	export type ListingType = (typeof LISTING_TYPES)[number];
   659	
   660	/**
   661	 * The owner's own OpenAI-compatible server, reached with the upstream bearer
   662	 * secret registered for that server. This is never the owner's or caller's
   663	 * Pollinations credential. The only kind that names a price, because it is the
   664	 * only kind whose caller is buying something from the owner.
   665	 */
   666	const StoredCommunityEndpointPricesSchema = z.object(
   667	    Object.fromEntries(
   668	        COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_PRICE_FIELDS.map((field) => [
   669	            field.key,
   670	            z.number().finite().min(0).default(0),
   671	        ]),
   672	    ) as Record<CommunityEndpointPriceKey, z.ZodDefault<z.ZodNumber>>,
   673	);
   674	
   675	export const ProxyListingPayloadSchema = z
   676	    .object({
   677	        bearerTokenCiphertext: z.string().min(1),
   678	        // Media listings have no text API and do not need a data migration.
   679	        api: CommunityEndpointApiSchema.nullable().default(null),
   680	        // Owner-set: callers may only spend Paid Pollen on this model.
   681	        paidOnly: z.boolean(),
   682	        modality: z.enum(COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_MODALITIES),
   683	        imagePricing: z.enum(COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_IMAGE_PRICING_MODES),
   684	        inputModalities: z.array(z.enum(MODEL_INPUT_MODALITIES)).min(1),
   685	        perUserRpm: z.number().finite().positive().nullable(),
   686	        fallbacks: z
   687	            .array(z.string().min(1))
   688	            .transform((fallbacks) => fallbacks.slice(0, MAX_FALLBACK_TARGETS)),
   689	        advertised: CommunityEndpointAdvertisedSchema.optional(),
   690	        prices: StoredCommunityEndpointPricesSchema,
   691	    })
   692	    .refine(
   693	        (payload) => (payload.modality === "text") === (payload.api !== null),
   694	        {
   695	            path: ["api"],
   696	            message:
   697	                "Text models require an API; other modalities do not accept one",
   698	        },
   699	    )
   700	    .transform(({ advertised: storedAdvertised, ...payload }) => {
   701	        const advertised = normalizeCommunityEndpointAdvertised(
   702	            storedAdvertised,
   703	            payload.modality,
   704	        );
   705	        return {
   706	            ...payload,
   707	            inputModalities: normalizeCommunityEndpointInputModalities(
   708	                payload.inputModalities,
   709	                payload.modality,
   710	            ),
   711	            ...(Object.keys(advertised).length ? { advertised } : {}),
   712	        };
   713	    });
   714	
   715	export type ProxyListingPayload = z.infer<typeof ProxyListingPayloadSchema>;
   716	
   717	/**
   718	 * A managed prompt agent Gen runs locally. Its row id is also the model used
   719	 * to load this configuration from the same row.
   720	 */
   721	export const BuiltinMcpServerIdSchema = z.enum(AGENT_MCP_SERVER_IDS);
   722	const AgentMcpServersSchema = z
   723	    .array(BuiltinMcpServerIdSchema)
   724	    .max(AGENT_MCP_SERVER_IDS.length)
   725	    .refine((servers) => new Set(servers).size === servers.length, {
   726	        message: "Duplicate MCP servers are not allowed",
   727	    });
   728	export const PromptAgentConfigSchema = z.object({
   729	    systemPrompt: z.string().trim().min(1).max(8000),
   730	    baseModel: z.string().trim().min(1).max(253),
   731	    // A saved agent can list a server agents have since lost (Connectors, or
   732	    // a save the previous Enter version accepted mid-deploy). It runs
   733	    // without that server instead of dropping out of the catalog.
   734	    mcpServers: z
   735	        .array(z.string())
   736	        .transform((servers) =>
   737	            servers.filter(
   738	                (id) => getMcpServerDefinition(id)?.agents !== false,
   739	            ),
   740	        )
   741	        .pipe(AgentMcpServersSchema)
   742	        .optional()
   743	        .default([]),
   744	});
   745	export const PromptAgentInputSchema = PromptAgentConfigSchema.extend({
   746	    mcpServers: AgentMcpServersSchema.optional().default([]),
   747	}).strict();
   748	
   749	export type PromptAgentListingPayload = z.infer<typeof PromptAgentConfigSchema>;
   750	
   751	const GitHubRepositorySchema = z
   752	    .string()
   753	    .trim()
   754	    .url()
   755	    .transform((value, context) => {
   756	        const url = new URL(value);
   757	        const parts = url.pathname
   758	            .replace(/\.git$/, "")
   759	            .split("/")
   760	            .filter(Boolean);
   761	        if (
   762	            url.protocol !== "https:" ||
   763	            url.hostname !== "github.com" ||
   764	            url.username ||
   765	            url.password ||
   766	            url.port ||
   767	            url.search ||
   768	            url.hash ||
   769	            parts.length !== 2
   770	        ) {
   771	            context.addIssue({
   772	                code: "custom",
   773	                message: "Repository must be an HTTPS GitHub repository URL",
   774	            });
   775	            return z.NEVER;
   776	        }
   777	        return `https://github.com/${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}`;
   778	    });

   837	const LISTING_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_BY_TYPE = {
   838	    proxy: ProxyListingPayloadSchema,

   841	    endpoint_agent: EndpointAgentListingPayloadSchema,

   844	/**
   845	 * Read a stored payload back into its typed shape.
   846	 *
   847	 * Storage is the only place a payload arrives untyped, so it is normalized
   848	 * once here and every reader downstream gets a complete value. A payload
   849	 * missing what its type requires returns null, which leaves the listing out of
   850	 * the catalog rather than in it half-populated.
   851	 */
   852	export function parseListingPayload<K extends ListingType>(
   853	    type: K,
   854	    raw: string | null,
   855	): ListingPayloadByType[K] | null {
   856	    let parsed: unknown;
   857	    try {
   858	        parsed = raw === null ? null : JSON.parse(raw);
   859	    } catch {
   860	        return null;
   861	    }
   862	    const result = LISTING_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_BY_TYPE[type].safeParse(parsed);
   863	    return result.success ? (result.data as ListingPayloadByType[K]) : null;
   864	}

   866	export function pendingCommunityEndpointChangeIsReady(
   867	    pendingAt: Date | null,
   868	    now = Date.now(),
   869	): boolean {
   870	    return (
   871	        pendingAt !== null &&
   872	        now >= pendingAt.getTime() + COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DELAY_MS
   873	    );
   874	}

   876	export function effectiveCommunityEndpointVisibility(
   877	    visibility: CommunityEndpointVisibility,
   878	    pendingVisibility: CommunityEndpointVisibility | null,
   879	    pendingAt: Date | null,
   880	    now = Date.now(),
   881	): CommunityEndpointVisibility {
   882	    return pendingVisibility &&
   883	        pendingCommunityEndpointChangeIsReady(pendingAt, now)
   884	        ? pendingVisibility
   885	        : visibility;
   886	}

   888	/** Apply only the delayed price policy, preserving newer credentials/settings. */
   889	export function applyPendingProxyPricing(
   890	    current: ProxyListingPayload,
   891	    pending: ProxyListingPayload | null,
   892	): ProxyListingPayload {
   893	    return pending
   894	        ? {
   895	              ...current,
   896	              paidOnly: pending.paidOnly,
   897	              imagePricing: pending.imagePricing,
   898	              prices: pending.prices,
   899	          }
   900	        : current;
   901	}
   902	
   903	export function resolveEffectiveProxyListing(
   904	    state: {
   905	        visibility: CommunityEndpointVisibility;
   906	        payload: ProxyListingPayload;
   907	        pendingVisibility: CommunityEndpointVisibility | null;
   908	        pendingPayload: ProxyListingPayload | null;
   909	        pendingAt: Date | null;
   910	    },
   911	    now = Date.now(),
   912	) {
   913	    const pendingAt = state.pendingAt;
   914	    const pendingReady = pendingCommunityEndpointChangeIsReady(pendingAt, now);
   915	    const hasPending =
   916	        pendingAt !== null &&
   917	        (state.pendingVisibility !== null || state.pendingPayload !== null);
   918	    return {
   919	        pendingReady,
   920	        visibility:
   921	            pendingReady && state.pendingVisibility
   922	                ? state.pendingVisibility
   923	                : state.visibility,
   924	        payload: pendingReady
   925	            ? applyPendingProxyPricing(state.payload, state.pendingPayload)
   926	            : state.payload,
   927	        pending:
   928	            !pendingReady && hasPending
   929	                ? {
   930	                      effectiveAt: new Date(
   931	                          pendingAt.getTime() +
   932	                              COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_CHANGE_DELAY_MS,
   933	                      ),
   934	                      visibility: state.pendingVisibility,
   935	                      payload: state.pendingPayload,
   936	                  }
   937	                : null,
   938	    };
   939	}

  1003	/**
  1004	 * Whether calls to this endpoint spend the caller's balance downstream.

  1007	 * does: its owner pays their own upstream and charges the caller a declared

  1009	 * fact that decides which credential goes on the wire, so it has one name.

  1011	export function usesAgentRunToken(endpoint: CommunityEndpointRuntime): boolean {

  1070	export function communityEndpointErrorDetail(body: unknown): string | null {
  1071	    if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return null;
  1072	    if (
  1073	        "error" in body &&
  1074	        body.error &&
  1075	        typeof body.error === "object" &&
  1076	        "message" in body.error &&
  1077	        typeof body.error.message === "string"
  1078	    ) {
  1079	        return body.error.message;
  1080	    }
  1081	    if ("error" in body && typeof body.error === "string") return body.error;
  1082	    if ("message" in body && typeof body.message === "string") {
  1083	        return body.message;
  1084	    }

  1094	export function parseCommunityModelId(
  1095	    model: string,
  1096	): CommunityModelParts | null {
  1097	    const value = model.startsWith(COMMUNITY_MODEL_PREFIX)
  1098	        ? model.slice(COMMUNITY_MODEL_PREFIX.length).trim()
  1099	        : model.trim();
  1100	    const separator = value.indexOf("/");
  1101	    if (separator <= 0) return null;
  1102	
  1103	    const ownerGithubUsername = value.slice(0, separator).trim();
  1104	    const modelName = value.slice(separator + 1).trim();
  1105	    if (!ownerGithubUsername || !modelName) return null;
  1106	    return { ownerGithubUsername, modelName };
  1107	}

  1109	export function normalizeCommunityProviderUrl(value: string): string {
  1110	    const url = new URL(value.trim());
  1111	    if (url.protocol !== "https:") {
  1112	        throw new Error("Provider URL must use https");
  1113	    }
  1114	    if (url.username || url.password) {
  1115	        throw new Error("Provider URL cannot include credentials");
  1116	    }
  1117	    url.hash = "";
  1118	    return url.toString();
  1119	}

  1121	/**
  1122	 * Audio duration reported by an OpenAI-compatible transcription response.
  1123	 *
  1124	 * The three shapes in the wild: gpt-4o-transcribe reports `usage.seconds`,
  1125	 * whisper-style servers report `usage.duration`, and stock whisper
  1126	 * `verbose_json` puts `duration` at the top level. Returns null when none of
  1127	 * them carry a usable number — callers decide what that means, and both the
  1128	 * registration probe and the request path treat it as a failure so an endpoint
  1129	 * that cannot be metered is never billed at zero.
  1130	 */
  1131	export function communityTranscriptionSeconds(body: unknown): number | null {
  1132	    if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return null;
  1133	    const record = body as Record<string, unknown>;
  1134	    const usage =
  1135	        record.usage && typeof record.usage === "object"
  1136	            ? (record.usage as Record<string, unknown>)
  1137	            : undefined;
  1138	    for (const value of [usage?.duration, usage?.seconds, record.duration]) {
  1139	        if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0) {
  1140	            return value;
  1141	        }
  1142	    }
  1143	    return null;
  1144	}
  1145	
  1146	export function communityPriceDefinition(
  1147	    endpoint: CommunityEndpointPrices,
  1148	    modality: CommunityEndpointModality,
  1149	    imagePricing: CommunityEndpointImagePricing = "request",
  1150	): PriceDefinition {
  1151	    const pricing: PriceDefinition = {};
  1152	    for (const field of communityEndpointPriceFieldsForModality(
  1153	        modality,
  1154	        imagePricing,
  1155	    )) {
  1156	        const price = endpoint[field.key];
  1157	        // Zero is an intentional rate here (private models, unpriced usage
  1158	        // buckets), not a missing one: keep it explicit so billing charges 0
  1159	        // instead of warning about a missing conversion rate on every call.
  1160	        if (Number.isFinite(price) && price >= 0) {
  1161	            pricing[field.usageType] = price;
  1162	        }
  1163	    }
  1164	    return pricing;
  1165	}
  1166	
  1167	export function communityModelDefinition(
  1168	    endpoint: CommunityModelDefinitionInput,
  1169	): ModelDefinition {
  1170	    const parsed = parseCommunityModelId(endpoint.modelId);
  1171	    const description = endpoint.description?.trim();
  1172	    const legacyAlias = parsed
  1173	        ? legacyCommunityModelId(parsed.ownerGithubUsername, parsed.modelName)
  1174	        : null;
  1175	    const aliases =
  1176	        legacyAlias && legacyAlias !== endpoint.modelId ? [legacyAlias] : [];
  1177	    const modality = normalizeCommunityEndpointModality(endpoint.modality);
  1178	    const imagePricing = normalizeCommunityEndpointImagePricing(
  1179	        endpoint.imagePricing,
  1180	    );
  1181	    const spec: CommunityModalitySpec = COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[modality];
  1182	    const isImage = modality === "image";
  1183	    // Token-priced image endpoints bill like text models (usage × per-token
  1184	    // rates), so only fixed per-request image endpoints are flat-rate.
  1185	    const isFlatRateImage = isImage && imagePricing === "request";
  1186	    const inputModalities = normalizeCommunityEndpointInputModalities(
  1187	        endpoint.inputModalities,
  1188	        modality,
  1189	    );
  1190	    const providerName = endpoint.providerName?.trim();
  1191	    const providerUrl = endpoint.providerUrl?.trim();
  1192	    const {
  1193	        capabilities: advertisedCapabilities = [],
  1194	        streaming,
  1195	        ...advertised
  1196	    } = normalizeCommunityEndpointAdvertised(endpoint.advertised, modality);
  1197	    const capabilities = new Set<ModelCapability>([
  1198	        ...advertisedCapabilities,
  1199	        ...(endpoint.capabilities ?? []),
  1200	    ]);
  1201	    return {
  1202	        aliases,
  1203	        provider: "community",
  1204	        perUserRpm: endpoint.perUserRpm,
  1205	        publisher: providerName || "Community",
  1206	        brandUrl: providerName && providerUrl ? providerUrl : undefined,
  1207	        brandIconUrl: endpoint.providerIconUrl ?? undefined,
  1208	        category: spec.category,
  1209	        cost: communityPriceDefinition(endpoint, modality, imagePricing),
  1210	        priceMultiplier: 1,
  1211	        addedDate: endpoint.addedDate ?? 0,
  1212	        title: endpoint.title,
  1213	        description: description || undefined,
  1214	        inputModalities,
  1215	        outputModalities: endpoint.outputModalities ?? [
  1216	            ...spec.outputModalities,
  1217	        ],
  1218	        ...(spec.restrictDefinitionEndpoints
  1219	            ? {
  1220	                  supportedEndpoints: communityEndpointSupportedEndpoints(
  1221	                      modality,
  1222	                      inputModalities,
  1223	                  ),
  1224	              }
  1225	            : {}),
  1226	        requiredSafetyFeatures: endpoint.requiredSafetyFeatures,
  1227	        ...(endpoint.fallbacks?.length
  1228	            ? { fallbacks: endpoint.fallbacks }
  1229	            : {}),
  1230	        paidOnly: endpoint.paidOnly,
  1231	        alpha: true,
  1232	        // Explicit false (not omitted) for token-priced image endpoints: the
  1233	        // catalog only renders per-1M prices when flat_rate === false or a
  1234	        // prompt token price is set.
  1235	        ...(isImage ? { flatRate: isFlatRateImage } : {}),
  1236	        ...(capabilities.has("tool_calling") ? { tools: true } : {}),
  1237	        ...(capabilities.has("reasoning") ? { reasoning: true } : {}),
  1238	        ...(capabilities.has("web_search") ? { search: true } : {}),
  1239	        ...(capabilities.has("code_execution") ? { codeExecution: true } : {}),
  1240	        ...(streaming === false ? { supportsStreaming: false } : {}),
  1241	        ...advertised,
  1242	    };
  1243	}

     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	import { normalizeCommunityAssetUrl } from "./community-endpoint-urls.ts";

     7	export const MAX_COMMUNITY_IMAGE_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
     8	export const MAX_COMMUNITY_VIDEO_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
     9	// A JSON envelope carrying a 20 MB base64 clip is at most ~28 MB; leave a
    10	// small amount of room for the envelope while still bounding provider output.
    11	export const MAX_COMMUNITY_MEDIA_RESPONSE_BYTES =
    12	    Math.ceil((MAX_COMMUNITY_VIDEO_BYTES * 4) / 3) + 64 * 1024;
    13	
    14	const CommunityVideoUsageSchema = z.object({
    15	    usage: z.object({ duration: z.number().positive().nullish() }).nullish(),
    16	});
    17	
    18	/** Prefer reported seconds; a validated request duration is the fallback. */
    19	export function communityVideoSeconds(
    20	    body: unknown,
    21	    requestedDuration?: number,
    22	): number {
    23	    const result = CommunityVideoUsageSchema.safeParse(body);
    24	    const duration = result.success
    25	        ? (result.data.usage?.duration ?? requestedDuration)
    26	        : undefined;
    27	    if (duration === undefined) {
    28	        throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
    29	            message:
    30	                "Community video endpoint returned invalid usage.duration or no billable duration; report generated seconds in usage.duration or supply a request duration",
    31	        });
    32	    }
    33	    return duration;
    34	}
    35	
    36	/**
    37	 * Pull the first usable image out of an OpenAI images response: inline base64
    38	 * when present, otherwise the URL it points at, fetched under the shared
    39	 * timeout and size cap.
    40	 *
    41	 * Returns null when the body carries no usable image, so each caller can
    42	 * phrase that in its own words. A URL that is unsafe, unreachable, or oversized
    43	 * throws UpstreamError(502) — the gen funnel renders that status directly, and the
    44	 * enter probe flattens it to a 400 with the same message.
    45	 */
    46	export async function firstCommunityImageBytes(
    47	    body: unknown,
    48	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
    49	): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    50	    if (
    51	        !body ||
    52	        typeof body !== "object" ||
    53	        !("data" in body) ||
    54	        !Array.isArray(body.data)
    55	    ) {
    56	        return null;
    57	    }
    58	    for (const image of body.data) {
    59	        if (!image || typeof image !== "object") continue;
    60	        if (
    61	            "b64_json" in image &&
    62	            typeof image.b64_json === "string" &&
    63	            image.b64_json.length > 0
    64	        ) {
    65	            return decodeCommunityBase64(image.b64_json);
    66	        }
    67	        if (
    68	            "url" in image &&
    69	            typeof image.url === "string" &&
    70	            image.url.length > 0
    71	        ) {
    72	            return fetchCommunityImageBytes(image.url, endpointBaseUrl);
    73	        }
    74	    }
    75	    return null;
    76	}
    77	
    78	/**
    79	 * Read one completed clip from the synchronous community video contract.
    80	 * Publishers return OpenAI-images-style `data` with either `b64_json` or a
    81	 * downloadable URL.
    82	 */
    83	export async function firstCommunityVideoBytes(
    84	    body: unknown,
    85	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
    86	): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    87	    if (
    88	        !body ||
    89	        typeof body !== "object" ||
    90	        !("data" in body) ||
    91	        !Array.isArray(body.data)
    92	    ) {
    93	        return null;
    94	    }
    95	    for (const video of body.data) {
    96	        if (!video || typeof video !== "object") continue;
    97	        if (
    98	            "b64_json" in video &&
    99	            typeof video.b64_json === "string" &&
   100	            video.b64_json.length > 0
   101	        ) {
   102	            // Base64 expands bytes by roughly 4/3. Reject oversized inline
   103	            // payloads before decoding so an untrusted endpoint cannot force a
   104	            // much larger temporary allocation inside the Worker.
   105	            if (
   106	                video.b64_json.length >
   107	                Math.ceil((MAX_COMMUNITY_VIDEO_BYTES * 4) / 3) + 128
   108	            ) {
   109	                throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   110	                    message: "Endpoint video is larger than 20 MB",
   111	                });
   112	            }
   113	            const bytes = decodeCommunityBase64(video.b64_json);
   114	            if (!bytes) continue;
   115	            if (bytes.byteLength > MAX_COMMUNITY_VIDEO_BYTES) {
   116	                throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   117	                    message: "Endpoint video is larger than 20 MB",
   118	                });
   119	            }
   120	            return bytes;
   121	        }
   122	        if (
   123	            "url" in video &&
   124	            typeof video.url === "string" &&
   125	            video.url.length > 0
   126	        ) {
   127	            return fetchCommunityVideoBytes(video.url, endpointBaseUrl);
   128	        }
   129	    }
   130	    return null;
   131	}
   132	
   133	export function decodeCommunityBase64(value: string): Uint8Array | null {
   134	    try {
   135	        const encoded = value
   136	            .replace(/^data:[^,]+,/, "")
   137	            .replace(/\s/g, "")
   138	            .replace(/-/g, "+")
   139	            .replace(/_/g, "/");
   140	        const decoded = atob(encoded);
   141	        return Uint8Array.from(decoded, (character) => character.charCodeAt(0));
   142	    } catch {
   143	        return null;
   144	    }
   145	}
   146	
   147	async function fetchCommunityImageBytes(
   148	    value: string,
   149	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
   150	): Promise<Uint8Array> {
   151	    const url = safeCommunityAssetUrl(value, endpointBaseUrl, "image");
   152	    let response: Response;
   153	    try {
   154	        // The URL is validated against https + the private-host blocklist
   155	        // above; following redirects would let the endpoint bounce us to an
   156	        // unvalidated destination.
   157	        response = await fetch(url, {
   158	            redirect: "manual",
   159	            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT_MS),
   160	        });
   161	    } catch (error) {
   162	        throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   163	            message: "Endpoint image URL timed out or could not connect",
   164	            responseBody: JSON.stringify({
   165	                error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   166	            }),
   167	            requestUrl: new URL(url),
   168	        });
   169	    }
   170	    if (!response.ok) {
   171	        throw new UpstreamError(502, {
   172	            message: `Endpoint image URL responded ${response.status}`,
   173	            upstreamStatus: response.status,
   174	            responseBody: await response.text().catch(() => undefined),
   175	            requestUrl: new URL(url),
   176	        });
   177	    }
   178	    return readResponseBytes(response, MAX_COMMUNITY_IMAGE_BYTES, () =>
   179	        UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   180	            message: "Endpoint image is larger than 20 MB",
   181	        }),
   182	    );
   183	}
   184	
   185	async function fetchCommunityVideoBytes(
   186	    value: string,
   187	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
   188	): Promise<Uint8Array> {
   189	    const url = safeCommunityAssetUrl(value, endpointBaseUrl, "video");
   190	    let response: Response;
   191	    try {
   192	        response = await fetch(url, {
   193	            redirect: "manual",
   194	            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT_MS),
   195	        });
   196	    } catch (error) {
   197	        throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   198	            message: "Endpoint video URL timed out or could not connect",
   199	            responseBody: JSON.stringify({
   200	                error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   201	            }),
   202	            requestUrl: new URL(url),
   203	        });
   204	    }
   205	    if (!response.ok) {
   206	        throw new UpstreamError(502, {
   207	            message: `Endpoint video URL responded ${response.status}`,
   208	            upstreamStatus: response.status,
   209	            responseBody: await response.text().catch(() => undefined),
   210	            requestUrl: new URL(url),
   211	        });
   212	    }
   213	    try {
   214	        return await readResponseBytes(
   215	            response,
   216	            MAX_COMMUNITY_VIDEO_BYTES,
   217	            () =>
   218	                UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   219	                    message: "Endpoint video is larger than 20 MB",
   220	                }),
   221	        );
   222	    } catch (error) {
   223	        if (error instanceof UpstreamError) throw error;
   224	        throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   225	            message: "Endpoint video could not be read",
   226	            responseBody: JSON.stringify({
   227	                error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   228	            }),
   229	        });
   230	    }
   231	}
   232	
   233	function safeCommunityAssetUrl(
   234	    value: string,
   235	    endpointBaseUrl: string,
   236	    kind: "image" | "video",
   237	): string {
   238	    try {
   239	        return normalizeCommunityAssetUrl(value, endpointBaseUrl);
   240	    } catch {
   241	        throw UpstreamError.fromProvider(502, {
   242	            message: `Endpoint returned an unsafe ${kind} URL`,
   243	        });
   244	    }
   245	}
===== shared/community-provider-icon.ts =====
     1	const COMMUNITY_PROVIDER_ICON_URL =
     2	    /^https:\/\/media\.pollinations\.ai\/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,194}$/u;
     3	
     4	/** Only canonical object URLs from the public media service are safe as icons. */
     5	export function isCommunityProviderIconUrl(value: unknown): value is string {
     6	    return typeof value === "string" && COMMUNITY_PROVIDER_ICON_URL.test(value);
     7	}

   306	export const communityEndpoint = sqliteTable("community_endpoint", {
   307	  id: text("id").primaryKey(),
   308	  ownerUserId: text("owner_user_id")
   309	    .notNull()
   310	    .references(() => user.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
   311	  name: text("name").notNull(),
   312	  title: text("title").notNull(),
   313	  description: text("description"),
   314	  // What this listing IS to callers, and the only thing deciding whether a
   315	  // call is sent a run token that spends the caller's balance.
   316	  //   proxy         → the owner's server, called with its upstream secret
   317	  //   prompt_agent  → an agent Gen runs, named by this row's id
   318	  //   code_agent    → a single JavaScript module Gen dispatches
   319	  //   endpoint_agent → an agent on the owner's own server
   320	  type: text("type", { enum: LISTING_TYPES }).default("proxy").notNull(),
   321	  // Every listing stores an OpenAI-compatible target. Prompt agents use an
   322	  // environment-neutral sentinel which is never routed.
   323	  baseUrl: text("base_url").notNull(),
   324	  upstreamModel: text("upstream_model").notNull(),
   325	  // Gateway policy shared by every community model and agent type.
   326	  requiredSafetyFeatures: text("required_safety_features", { mode: "json" })
   327	    .$type<SafetyFeature[]>()
   328	    .default(sql`'[]'`)
   329	    .notNull(),
   330	  // Everything that belongs to one kind of listing rather than all of them.
   331	  // Shape is selected by `type`; read it with parseListingPayload. Fields a
   332	  // kind does not have simply have nowhere to live, which is what replaced the
   333	  // per-field rejections the write path used to carry.
   334	  payload: text("payload").notNull().default("{}"),
   335	  // Models default to private (owner-only and free). Public visibility is
   336	  // allowlist-gated and may be free or owner-priced.
   337	  visibility: text("visibility", { enum: ["private", "public"] })
   338	    .default("private")
   339	    .notNull(),
   340	  // A public price change or private-to-public transition becomes effective
   341	  // 3 hours after it is submitted. The pending payload is only meaningful
   342	  // for proxy listings; visibility applies to every listing type.
   343	  pendingPayload: text("pending_payload"),
   344	  pendingVisibility: text("pending_visibility", {
   345	    enum: ["private", "public"],
   346	  }),
   347	  pendingAt: integer("pending_at", { mode: "timestamp" }),
   348	  // Historical manual/monitor hide metadata; discovery now uses visibility
   349	  // and recent reliability. Kept for D1/Tinybird history, never updated.
   350	  hiddenAt: integer("hidden_at", { mode: "timestamp" }),
   351	  hiddenReason: text("hidden_reason"),
   352	  hiddenBy: text("hidden_by"),
   353	  createdAt: integer("created_at", { mode: "timestamp" })
   354	    .defaultNow()
   355	    .notNull(),
   356	  updatedAt: integer("updated_at", { mode: "timestamp" })
   357	    .defaultNow()
   358	    .$onUpdate(() => /* @__PURE__ */ new Date())
   359	    .notNull(),
   360	}, (table) => [
   361	  index("idx_community_endpoint_owner_user_id").on(table.ownerUserId),
   362	  uniqueIndex("idx_community_endpoint_owner_name").on(
   363	    table.ownerUserId,
   364	    table.name,
   365	  ),
   366	  check(
   367	    "community_endpoint_type",
   368	    sql`type IN ('proxy', 'prompt_agent', 'code_agent', 'endpoint_agent')`,
   369	  ),
   370	  check(
   371	    "community_endpoint_prompt_agent_model",
   372	    sql`type NOT IN ('prompt_agent', 'code_agent') OR upstream_model = id`,

===== shared/db/sandbox.ts =====
     1	// Sandboxes gen keeps running until their timeout, 10 minutes at a time
     2	// (gen's routes/e2b.ts). E2B's metadata is set once at create, so the keep
     3	// lives here: a timeout or pause changes it.
     4	
     5	import {
     6	    index,
     7	    integer,
     8	    primaryKey,
     9	    sqliteTable,
    10	    text,
    11	} from "drizzle-orm/sqlite-core";

    14	export const sandboxKeep = sqliteTable("sandbox_keep", {
    15	    sandboxId: text("sandbox_id").primaryKey(),
    16	    // The key that set the timeout pays every renewal; without one (set from
    17	    // the dashboard), the sandbox's owner does.
    18	    apiKeyId: text("api_key_id").references(() => apikey.id, {
    19	        onDelete: "cascade",
    20	    }),
    21	    until: integer("until", { mode: "timestamp" }).notNull(),
    22	    // Opt-in: the cron pauses the sandbox after this many seconds without
    23	    // activity and leaves the keep, so the next wake resumes it.
    24	    idleTimeout: integer("idle_timeout"),
    25	    // The last activity gen saw: a request to a shared port, or a connect
    26	    // or timeout by the owner. The cron also counts the sandbox's own key.
    27	    activeAt: integer("active_at", { mode: "timestamp" }),
    28	});
    29	
    30	// Gen's Azure sandboxes (gen's routes/azure-sandboxes.ts): what E2B keeps for
    31	// each sandbox and Azure doesn't. Azure keeps the box itself.
    32	export const azureSandbox = sqliteTable(
    33	    "azure_sandbox",
    34	    {
    35	        sandboxId: text("sandbox_id").primaryKey(),
    36	        userId: text("user_id").notNull(),
    37	        templateId: text("template_id").notNull(),
    38	        metadata: text("metadata", { mode: "json" })
    39	            .$type<Record<string, string>>()
    40	            .notNull(),
    41	        // Azure never returns a sandbox's environment, where envd gets it.
    42	        envdAccessToken: text("envd_access_token").notNull(),
    43	        // When the run started, and when its lease ends: gen's cron stops the
    44	        // sandbox then, as E2B's timeout would.
    45	        startedAt: integer("started_at", { mode: "timestamp_ms" }).notNull(),
    46	        endAt: integer("end_at", { mode: "timestamp_ms" }).notNull(),
    47	    },
    48	    (table) => [index("azure_sandbox_user_id_idx").on(table.userId)],
    49	);

    51	// Sandbox ports gen serves at <port>-<sandbox id>.pollinations.app (gen's
    52	// routes/e2b.ts): a request wakes the sandbox, paid in advance like a connect.
    53	export const sandboxPort = sqliteTable(
    54	    "sandbox_port",
    55	    {
    56	        sandboxId: text("sandbox_id").notNull(),
    57	        port: integer("port").notNull(),
    58	        // As for a keep: the key that shared the port pays each wake; without
    59	        // one (shared from the dashboard), the sandbox's owner does.
    60	        apiKeyId: text("api_key_id").references(() => apikey.id, {
    61	            onDelete: "cascade",
    62	        }),
    63	        // Requests carry the share's secret in this header (lowercase); gen
    64	        // keeps only its SHA-256.
    65	        header: text("header").notNull(),
    66	        secretHash: text("secret_hash").notNull(),
    67	    },
    68	    (table) => [primaryKey({ columns: [table.sandboxId, table.port] })],
    69	);
