===== shared/registry/cost-variants.ts =====
     1	// Cost-variant helpers used by registry model definitions. This module must
     2	// stay free of runtime imports from registry.ts: image.ts/text.ts call these
     3	// helpers at module-init time while registry.ts imports their service maps,
     4	// so a value import back into registry.ts would create an evaluation-order
     5	// cycle that silently empties MODEL_REGISTRY in bundled workers.
     6	
     7	import type { PricingDimension } from "./public-pricing";
     8	import type {
     9	    CostDefinition,
    10	    CostVariantMetadata,
    11	    ModelDefinition,
    12	    Usage,
    13	    UsageType,
    14	} from "./registry";
    15	
    16	// Normalized request facts that can affect pricing. Set by the service layer
    17	// via the track middleware's pricing input; a provider's response may refine
    18	// them. Consumed by selectCostVariant and billing adjustments. Keep this
    19	// vocabulary small: a key earns its place when a live model prices on it.
    20	export type PricingInput = {
    21	    resolution?: string;
    22	    quality?: string;
    23	    hasImage?: boolean;
    24	    hasReferenceVideo?: boolean;
    25	    maxImageDimension?: number;
    26	    megapixels?: number;
    27	    searchContextSize?: "low" | "medium" | "high";
    28	    hasDiarization?: boolean;
    29	    hasPrompt?: boolean;
    30	    stemVariation?: "two_stems_v1" | "six_stems_v1";
    31	    /** Provider confirmed this response used an explicit prompt-cache entry. */
    32	    hasExplicitCacheHit?: boolean;
    33	    /** Trusted provider receipt, carried from the generation response. */
    34	    providerBilling?: { units: number; unitCost: number };
    35	};
    36	
    37	export type CostVariantContext = {
    38	    usage: Usage;
    39	    input?: PricingInput;
    40	};
    41	
    42	// Prompt-side token count used by long-context selectors: every prompt token
    43	// bucket counts toward the provider's context threshold (cached and modality
    44	// tokens included); promptAudioSeconds is a duration, not a token count.
    45	const PROMPT_TOKEN_TYPES: UsageType[] = [
    46	    "promptTextTokens",
    47	    "promptCachedTokens",
    48	    "promptCacheWriteTokens",
    49	    "promptAudioTokens",
    50	    "promptImageTokens",
    51	    "promptVideoTokens",
    52	];
    53	
    54	export function totalPromptTokens(usage: Usage): number {
    55	    return PROMPT_TOKEN_TYPES.reduce(
    56	        (total, usageType) => total + (usage[usageType] ?? 0),
    57	        0,
    58	    );
    59	}
    60	
    61	// Selector factory for provider long-context tiers with a strict boundary.
    62	// Azure meters GPT requests as <272k / >272k context length, repricing the
    63	// entire request once the threshold is crossed.
    64	export function longContextAbove(minPromptTokens: number) {
    65	    return ({ usage }: CostVariantContext): "long_context" | undefined =>
    66	        totalPromptTokens(usage) > minPromptTokens ? "long_context" : undefined;
    67	}
    68	
    69	// OpenRouter pricing tiers apply when prompt tokens meet or exceed the
    70	// advertised minimum.
    71	export function longContextAtLeast(minPromptTokens: number) {
    72	    return ({ usage }: CostVariantContext): "long_context" | undefined =>
    73	        totalPromptTokens(usage) >= minPromptTokens
    74	            ? "long_context"
    75	            : undefined;
    76	}
    77	
    78	// Selects a named rate sheet when the request explicitly uses one of the
    79	// model's non-default resolutions. The default resolution stays on base rates.
    80	export function matchResolution<const R extends string>(...resolutions: R[]) {
    81	    return ({ input }: CostVariantContext): R | undefined =>
    82	        resolutions.find((resolution) => resolution === input?.resolution);
    83	}
    84	
    85	// Pairs variant sheets with their selector so TypeScript checks that the
    86	// selector can only return names that exist in the sheets.
    87	export function defineCostVariants<
    88	    const V extends Record<string, CostDefinition>,
    89	>(
    90	    costVariants: V,
    91	    selectCostVariant: (
    92	        context: CostVariantContext,
    93	    ) => (keyof V & string) | undefined,
    94	    costVariantMetadata: { [K in keyof V]: CostVariantMetadata },
    95	    defaultCostVariantLabel: string,
    96	    pricingDimensions?: Array<
    97	        Omit<PricingDimension, "values"> & {
    98	            values: Record<(keyof V & string) | "", string>;
    99	        }
   100	    >,
   101	): Pick<
   102	    ModelDefinition,
   103	    | "costVariants"
   104	    | "selectCostVariant"
   105	    | "costVariantMetadata"
   106	    | "defaultCostVariantLabel"
   107	    | "pricingDimensions"
   108	> {
   109	    return {
   110	        costVariants,
   111	        selectCostVariant,
   112	        costVariantMetadata,
   113	        defaultCostVariantLabel,
   114	        pricingDimensions,
   115	    };
   116	}

===== shared/registry/embeddings.ts =====
     1	import { EMBEDDING_FALLBACKS } from "./embeddings-fallbacks";
     2	import { mergeFallbacks } from "./merge-fallbacks";
     3	import { perMillion } from "./price-helpers";
     4	import type { ModelDefinition } from "./registry";
     5

===== shared/registry/gemini-billing.ts =====
     1	import type { BillingRules } from "./registry";
     2	
     3	const OPENROUTER_CACHE_TTL_HOURS = 5 / 60;
     4	const GEMINI_3_GROUNDING_COST_PER_QUERY = 14 / 1000;
     5	const VERTEX_CACHE_TTL_HOURS = 1;
     6	
     7	type GeminiBillingOutput = {
     8	    usage?: {
     9	        cost?: unknown;
    10	        cache_creation_input_tokens?: unknown;
    11	        prompt_tokens_details?: {
    12	            cache_write_tokens?: unknown;
    13	        };
    14	        server_tool_use_details?: {
    15	            web_search_requests?: unknown;
    16	        };
    17	    };
    18	    choices?: {
    19	        groundingMetadata?: GroundingMetadata;
    20	        message?: { provider_metadata?: GatewaySearchMetadata };
    21	        delta?: { provider_metadata?: GatewaySearchMetadata };
    22	    }[];
    23	    streamEvents?: GeminiBillingOutput[];
    24	};
    25	
    26	type GatewaySearchMetadata = {
    27	    gateway?: { gatewayToolCalls?: { exa_search?: number } };
    28	};
    29	
    30	type GroundingMetadata = {
    31	    webSearchQueries?: string[];
    32	    groundingChunks?: { web?: { uri?: string } }[];
    33	};
    34	
    35	function outputEvents(output: unknown): GeminiBillingOutput[] {
    36	    const o = output as GeminiBillingOutput | undefined;
    37	    return Array.isArray(o?.streamEvents) ? o.streamEvents : o ? [o] : [];
    38	}
    39	
    40	function eachGroundingMetadata(output: unknown): GroundingMetadata[] {
    41	    const metadata: GroundingMetadata[] = [];
    42	    for (const event of outputEvents(output)) {
    43	        const choices = Array.isArray(event?.choices) ? event.choices : [];
    44	        for (const choice of choices) {
    45	            if (choice?.groundingMetadata)
    46	                metadata.push(choice.groundingMetadata);
    47	        }
    48	    }
    49	    return metadata;
    50	}
    51	
    52	function webSearchQueryStrings(metadata: GroundingMetadata): string[] {
    53	    if (!Array.isArray(metadata.webSearchQueries)) return [];
    54	    return metadata.webSearchQueries.filter(
    55	        (query): query is string =>
    56	            typeof query === "string" && query.trim() !== "",
    57	    );
    58	}
    59	
    60	// Gemini 3.x charges per distinct search query. Streaming chunks repeat the
    61	// cumulative list, so deduplicate before billing.
    62	function countGeminiWebSearchQueries(output: unknown): number {
    63	    const queries = new Set<string>();
    64	    for (const metadata of eachGroundingMetadata(output)) {
    65	        for (const query of webSearchQueryStrings(metadata)) {
    66	            queries.add(query.trim());
    67	        }
    68	    }
    69	    return queries.size || countReportedWebSearchRequests(output);
    70	}
    71	
    72	function positiveUsageCounter(
    73	    select: (event: GeminiBillingOutput) => unknown,
    74	): (output: unknown) => number {
    75	    return (output) => {
    76	        for (const event of [...outputEvents(output)].reverse()) {
    77	            const value = select(event);
    78	            if (
    79	                typeof value === "number" &&
    80	                Number.isFinite(value) &&
    81	                value > 0
    82	            ) {
    83	                return value;
    84	            }
    85	        }
    86	        return 0;
    87	    };
    88	}
    89	
    90	const countVertexCacheWriteTokens = positiveUsageCounter(
    91	    (event) =>
    92	        event.usage?.cache_creation_input_tokens ??
    93	        event.usage?.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_write_tokens,
    94	);
    95	
    96	// OpenRouter reports the complete cached prefix in cache_write_tokens. Its
    97	// Google routes add five minutes of storage on writes; cache-read token rates
    98	// remain covered by the model's promptCachedTokens price.
    99	const countOpenRouterCacheWriteTokens = positiveUsageCounter(
   100	    (event) => event.usage?.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_write_tokens,
   101	);
   102	
   103	// Provider usage and gateway metadata report cumulative billed search counts.
   104	const countReportedWebSearchRequests = positiveUsageCounter(
   105	    (event) =>
   106	        event.usage?.server_tool_use_details?.web_search_requests ??
   107	        Math.max(
   108	            0,
   109	            ...(event.choices ?? []).map(
   110	                (choice) =>
   111	                    (choice.message ?? choice.delta)?.provider_metadata?.gateway
   112	                        ?.gatewayToolCalls?.exa_search ?? 0,
   113	            ),
   114	        ),
   115	);
   116	
   117	export const VERCEL_EXA_SEARCH_BILLING: BillingRules = {
   118	    resolveTotalCost: reportedTextCost(),
   119	    adjustments: [
   120	        {
   121	            id: "vercel.exa.web_search.v1",
   122	            description: "Exa search adds $7 / 1K provider-reported requests.",
   123	            kind: "search_request",
   124	            unit: "request",
   125	            unitCost: 7 / 1_000,
   126	            publicPricing: {
   127	                label: "Search",
   128	                quantity: 1_000,
   129	                unit: "search requests",
   130	            },
   131	            countUnits: countReportedWebSearchRequests,
   132	        },
   133	    ],
   134	};
   135	
   136	/** Server-tool loops report aggregate dollars more accurately than modality counters. */
   137	export function reportedTextCost(
   138	    fee = 1,
   139	): (output: unknown) => number | undefined {
   140	    return (output) => {
   141	        for (const event of [...outputEvents(output)].reverse()) {
   142	            const cost = event.usage?.cost;
   143	            if (typeof cost === "number" && Number.isFinite(cost) && cost >= 0)
   144	                return cost * fee;
   145	        }
   146	        return undefined;
   147	    };
   148	}
   149	
   150	// Rates vary per model and route; each registry entry passes the current
   151	// true provider cost. Search is billed per request, cache storage per
   152	// 1M-token-hours prorated to OpenRouter's fixed five-minute cache TTL.
   153	export function openRouterGeminiBilling({
   154	    searchCostPerThousandRequests,
   155	    storageCostPerMillionTokenHours,
   156	}: {
   157	    searchCostPerThousandRequests: number;
   158	    storageCostPerMillionTokenHours: number;
   159	}): BillingRules {
   160	    return {
   161	        adjustments: [
   162	            {
   163	                id: "openrouter.google.web_search.v1",
   164	                description: `OpenRouter web search adds $${searchCostPerThousandRequests} / 1K search requests reported by provider usage.`,
   165	                kind: "search_request",
   166	                unit: "request",
   167	                unitCost: searchCostPerThousandRequests / 1_000,
   168	                publicPricing: {
   169	                    label: "Search",
   170	                    quantity: 1_000,
   171	                    unit: "search requests",
   172	                },
   173	                countUnits: countReportedWebSearchRequests,
   174	            },
   175	            {
   176	                id: "openrouter.google.cache_storage.v1",
   177	                description: `OpenRouter Google cache writes add $${storageCostPerMillionTokenHours} / 1M tokens / hour for the five-minute cache TTL.`,
   178	                kind: "cache_storage",
   179	                unit: "token_hour",
   180	                unitCost:
   181	                    (storageCostPerMillionTokenHours / 1_000_000) *
   182	                    OPENROUTER_CACHE_TTL_HOURS,
   183	                publicPricing: {
   184	                    label: "Cache storage",
   185	                    quantity: 1_000_000,
   186	                    unit: "tokens written",
   187	                    suffix: "5 min",
   188	                },
   189	                countUnits: countOpenRouterCacheWriteTokens,
   190	            },
   191	        ],
   192	    };
   193	}
   194	
   195	export function withVertexCacheStorage(
   196	    base: BillingRules,
   197	    storageCostPerMillionTokenHours: number,
   198	): BillingRules {
   199	    return {
   200	        adjustments: [
   201	            ...(base.adjustments ?? []),
   202	            {
   203	                id: "google.vertex.cache_storage.v1",
   204	                description: `Vertex explicit context caching storage: $${storageCostPerMillionTokenHours} / 1M tokens / hour, billed for the one-hour TTL on each cache create.`,
   205	                kind: "cache_storage",
   206	                unit: "token_hour",
   207	                unitCost:
   208	                    (storageCostPerMillionTokenHours / 1_000_000) *
   209	                    VERTEX_CACHE_TTL_HOURS,
   210	                publicPricing: {
   211	                    label: "Cache storage",
   212	                    quantity: 1_000_000,
   213	                    unit: "tokens written",
   214	                    suffix: "1 hour",
   215	                },
   216	                countUnits: countVertexCacheWriteTokens,
   217	            },
   218	        ],
   219	    };
   220	}
   221

  2556	    IMAGE_BASE_SERVICES,
  2557	    IMAGE_FALLBACKS,
  2558	);
  2559	
  2560	const isVideoService = (svc: {
  2561	    outputModalities?: readonly string[];
  2562	}): boolean => svc.outputModalities?.includes("video") ?? false;
  2563	
  2564	export const getVideoModelIds = (): string[] =>
  2565	    Object.keys(IMAGE_SERVICES).filter((id) =>
  2566	        isVideoService(IMAGE_SERVICES[id as ImageModelName]),
  2567	    );
  2568	
  2569	export const getImageModelIds = (): string[] =>
  2570	    Object.keys(IMAGE_SERVICES).filter(
  2571	        (id) => !isVideoService(IMAGE_SERVICES[id as ImageModelName]),
  2572	    );
===== shared/registry/inferenceport-billing.ts =====
     1	type InferencePortOutput = {
     2	    usage?: { payg_credits_charged?: unknown };
     3	    payg_usage?: { payg_credits_charged?: unknown };
     4	    payg_credits_charged?: unknown;
     5	    streamEvents?: InferencePortOutput[];
     6	};
     7	
     8	// PAYG receipts are cumulative USD totals, including rounded-to-zero charges.
     9	export function reportedInferencePortCost(output: unknown): number | undefined {
    10	    const value = output as InferencePortOutput | undefined;
    11	    const events = Array.isArray(value?.streamEvents)
    12	        ? value.streamEvents
    13	        : value
    14	          ? [value]
    15	          : [];
    16	    for (const event of [...events].reverse()) {
    17	        const cost =
    18	            event?.usage?.payg_credits_charged ??
    19	            event?.payg_usage?.payg_credits_charged ??
    20	            event?.payg_credits_charged;
    21	        if (typeof cost === "number" && Number.isFinite(cost) && cost >= 0)
    22	            return cost;
    23	    }
    24	    return undefined;
    25	}

     1	// Builds an MCP server.json entry (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/registry)

     6	const GEN_ORIGIN = "https://gen.pollinations.ai";
     7	const KEYS_URL = "https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys";
     8	
     9	// The registry caps `description` at 100 characters; composio's product
    10	// description runs longer, so it gets a shorter registry-only one.
    11	const DESCRIPTION_OVERRIDES: Partial<
    12	    Record<McpServerDefinition["id"], string>
    13	> = {
    14	    composio:
    15	        "Read Gmail, read and commit to GitHub, update Sheets, and post to Slack through Composio.",
    16	};
    17	
    18	export function buildServerEntry(
    19	    server: McpServerDefinition,
    20	    version: string,
    21	    origin = GEN_ORIGIN,
    22	) {
    23	    return {
    24	        $schema:
    25	            "https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json",
    26	        name: `io.github.pollinations/${server.id}`,
    27	        title: server.name,
    28	        description: DESCRIPTION_OVERRIDES[server.id] ?? server.description,
    29	        version,
    30	        websiteUrl: `${origin}/docs#tag/mcp-servers`,

    46	                        // it in so the client only ever prompts for the key.
    47	                        value: "Bearer {api_key}",

    49	                            api_key: {
    50	                                description: "Pollinations API key",
    51	                                isRequired: true,
    52	                                isSecret: true,
    53	                            },
    54	                        },
    55	                    },
    56	                ],
    57	            },
    58	        ],
    59	    };

===== shared/registry/merge-fallbacks.ts =====
     1	import type { ModelDefinition } from "./registry";
     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * An internal fallback route, stated as the difference from the model it stands
     5	 * in for.
     6	 *
     7	 * Everything left out is inherited from that model, so the public identity a
     8	 * caller sees — title, publisher, modalities — can never drift from the model they
     9	 * asked for. `provider` is required because it is the one thing a route must
    10	 * not inherit: it is what makes the route a route, and what the spend is
    11	 * attributed to. The omitted fields are owned by the merge — a route is always
    12	 * hidden and fallback-only, carries no aliases, and never chains further.
    13	 */
    14	export type FallbackDefinition = Partial<
    15	    Omit<
    16	        ModelDefinition,
    17	        "aliases" | "fallbacks" | "fallbackOnly" | "hidden" | "provider"
    18	    >
    19	> & { provider: string };
    20	
    21	/**
    22	 * Fallback routes, keyed by the model they serve and then by the id each route
    23	 * is registered under — the same key-is-the-id shape as the catalogs they merge
    24	 * into. Routes are tried in key order, ahead of any cross-model `fallbacks` the
    25	 * model declares itself, since a route still serves the model that was asked
    26	 * for.
    27	 */
    28	export type FallbackMap = Record<string, Record<string, FallbackDefinition>>;
    29	
    30	/** The ids the merge adds to the catalog. */
    31	type RouteIds<TFallbacks extends FallbackMap> = {
    32	    [ParentId in keyof TFallbacks]: keyof TFallbacks[ParentId];
    33	}[keyof TFallbacks] &
    34	    string;
    35	
    36	/**
    37	 * The catalog as it comes out: routes added as models, and every parent
    38	 * carrying the `fallbacks` list the merge injected — which its own declaration
    39	 * in the catalog no longer has to state.
    40	 */
    41	type Merged<TBase, TFallbacks extends FallbackMap> = TBase &
    42	    Record<keyof TFallbacks, { fallbacks: string[] }> &
    43	    Record<RouteIds<TFallbacks>, ModelDefinition>;
    44	
    45	/**
    46	 * Merges fallback routes into a service catalog: every parent gains the
    47	 * `fallbacks` list naming its routes in order, and each route is expanded into
    48	 * a full model definition placed directly after it, so ids and order match what
    49	 * the catalog would look like if the routes were written out by hand.
    50	 */
    51	export function mergeFallbacks<
    52	    TFallbacks extends FallbackMap,
    53	    TBase extends Record<string, ModelDefinition> &
    54	        Record<keyof TFallbacks, ModelDefinition>,
    55	>(base: TBase, fallbacks: TFallbacks): Merged<TBase, TFallbacks> {
    56	    const merged: Record<string, ModelDefinition> = {};
    57	    for (const [parentId, parent] of Object.entries(base)) {
    58	        const routes = (fallbacks as FallbackMap)[parentId];
    59	        if (!routes) {
    60	            merged[parentId] = parent;
    61	            continue;
    62	        }
    63	        merged[parentId] = {
    64	            ...parent,
    65	            fallbacks: [...Object.keys(routes), ...(parent.fallbacks ?? [])],
    66	        };
    67	        const {
    68	            aliases: _aliases,
    69	            fallbacks: _fallbacks,
    70	            fallbackOnly: _fallbackOnly,
    71	            hidden: _hidden,
    72	            ...inherited
    73	        } = parent;
    74	        for (const [routeId, overrides] of Object.entries(routes)) {
    75	            merged[routeId] = {
    76	                ...inherited,
    77	                ...overrides,
    78	                aliases: [],
    79	                hidden: true,
    80	                fallbackOnly: true,
    81	            };
    82	        }
    83	    }
    84	    return merged as Merged<TBase, TFallbacks>;
    85	}

   235	
   236	function getCapabilities(service: ModelDefinition): ModelCapability[] {
   237	    const capabilities: ModelCapability[] = [];
   238	    if (service.tools) capabilities.push("tool_calling");
   239	    if (service.reasoning) capabilities.push("reasoning");
   240	    if (service.search) capabilities.push("web_search");
   241	    if (service.codeExecution) capabilities.push("code_execution");
   242	    return capabilities;
   243	}
   244	
   245	type ModelInfoOptions = {
   246	    community?: boolean;
   247	    agent?: boolean;
   248	    verified?: boolean;
   249	};
   250	
   251	function pricingInfoFromDefinition(
   252	    priceDefinition: PriceDefinition,
   253	): Record<string, string> & { currency: "pollen" } {
   254	    const pricing: Record<string, string> & { currency: "pollen" } = {
   255	        currency: "pollen",
   256	    };
   257	    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(priceDefinition)) {
   258	        if (typeof value === "number" && value > 0) {
   259	            pricing[key] = toFixedPoint(value);
   260	        }
   261	    }
   262	    return pricing;
   263	}
   264	
   265	function pricingAdjustmentInfoFromRule(
   266	    rule: BillingAdjustmentRule,
   267	    service: ModelDefinition,
   268	) {
   269	    return publicPriceInfo(rule, service.priceMultiplier);
   270	}
   271	
   272	export function modelInfoFromDefinition(
   273	    name: string,
   274	    service: ModelDefinition,
   275	    options: ModelInfoOptions = {},
   276	): ModelInfo {
   277	    return {
   278	        name,
   279	        aliases: service.aliases,
   280	        category: service.category,
   281	        publisher: service.publisher,
   282	        brand_url: service.brandUrl,
   283	        brand_icon_url: service.brandIconUrl,
   284	        community: options.community ?? false,
   285	        agent: options.agent || undefined,
   286	        verified: options.verified || undefined,
   287	        per_user_rpm: service.perUserRpm,
   288	        pricing: pricingInfoFromDefinition(getPriceDefinitionForModel(service)),
   289	        pricing_variants:
   290	            service.costVariants && service.costVariantMetadata
   291	                ? Object.keys(service.costVariants).map((name) => {
   292	                      const metadata = service.costVariantMetadata?.[name];
   293	                      return {
   294	                          name,
   295	                          label: metadata?.label ?? name,
   296	                          description: metadata?.description ?? name,
   297	                          pricing: pricingInfoFromDefinition(
   298	                              getPriceDefinitionForModel(service, name),
   299	                          ),
   300	                      };
   301	                  })
   302	                : undefined,
   303	        pricing_default_label: service.defaultCostVariantLabel,
   304	        pricing_dimensions: service.pricingDimensions,
   305	        pricing_adjustments: service.billing?.adjustments?.map((rule) =>
   306	            pricingAdjustmentInfoFromRule(rule, service),
   307	        ),
   308	        resolutions: service.resolutions ? [...service.resolutions] : undefined,
   309	        // User-facing metadata from service definition
   310	        title: service.title,
   311	        description: service.description,
   312	        input_modalities: service.inputModalities,
   313	        output_modalities: service.outputModalities,
   314	        required_safety: service.requiredSafetyFeatures,
   315	        supported_endpoints: service.supportedEndpoints,
   316	        video_capabilities: service.videoCapabilities,
   317	        min_duration: service.minDuration,
   318	        max_duration: service.maxDuration,
   319	        default_duration: service.defaultDuration,
   320	        allowed_durations: service.allowedDurations
   321	            ? [...service.allowedDurations]
   322	            : undefined,
   323	        duration_step: service.durationStep,
   324	        max_reference_images: service.maxReferenceImages,
   325	        max_reference_videos: service.maxReferenceVideos,
   326	        capabilities: getCapabilities(service),
   327	        supported_parameters: service.supportedParameters,
   328	        tools: service.tools,
   329	        supports_structured_output: service.supportsStructuredOutput,
   330	        max_completion_tokens: service.maxCompletionTokens,
   331	        reasoning: service.reasoning,
   332	        supports_streaming: service.supportsStreaming,
   333	        context_length: service.contextLength,
   334	        voices: service.voices,
   335	        is_specialized: service.isSpecialized,
   336	        paid_only: service.paidOnly,
   337	        alpha: service.alpha,
   338	        flat_rate:
   339	            service.flatRate ??
   340	            (service.category === "image"
   341	                ? service.cost.promptTextTokens === undefined
   342	                : undefined),
   343	        pricing_units: service.priceUnits,
   344	        added_date: service.addedDate,
   345	    };
   346	}

===== shared/registry/model-permissions.ts =====
     1	import { and, eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
     2	import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/d1";
     3	import { HTTPException } from "hono/http-exception";
     4	import {
     5	    COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC,
     6	    communityModelId,
     7	    legacyCommunityModelId,
     8	    normalizeCommunityEndpointModality,
     9	    parseCommunityModelId,
    10	    parseListingPayload,
    11	} from "../community-endpoints.ts";
    12	import * as schema from "../db/better-auth.ts";
    13	import {
    14	    type Category,
    15	    getRegistryModelDefinition,
    16	    MODEL_CATEGORIES,
    17	    type ModelDefinition,
    18	    type ModelName,
    19	    resolveModelName,
    20	} from "./registry.ts";
    21	
    22	/**
    23	 * A key's `permissions.models` lists the model categories and model IDs it may
    24	 * call: null allows every model and [] none. A category allows every model
    25	 * whose registry `category` matches, so models join and leave a key's reach as
    26	 * the registry changes; a model ID allows exactly that model. Matching aliases
    27	 * keeps a stored ID working after its model is renamed.
    28	 *
    29	 * `endpoint` is the generation endpoint being called. Decision models also
    30	 * answer on chat endpoints, where `text` still allows them; only
    31	 * `/alpha/decisions` needs `decision`. Catalog listings pass no endpoint and
    32	 * show each model under its own category only.
    33	 */
    34	export function keyAllowsModel(
    35	    models: readonly string[] | null | undefined,
    36	    id: string,
    37	    { category, aliases }: Pick<ModelDefinition, "category" | "aliases">,
    38	    endpoint?: string,
    39	): boolean {
    40	    if (!models) return true;
    41	    const categories =
    42	        category === "decision" &&
    43	        endpoint !== undefined &&
    44	        endpoint !== "/alpha/decisions"
    45	            ? [category, "text"]
    46	            : [category];
    47	    return [...categories, id, ...aliases].some((value) =>
    48	        models.includes(value),
    49	    );
    50	}
    51	
    52	type ModelMatch = Pick<ModelDefinition, "category" | "aliases">;
    53	
    54	/**
    55	 * Normalizes requested key model permissions. Category names stay as they are
    56	 * and model IDs or aliases become canonical model IDs.
    57	 */
    58	export async function toModelPermissions(
    59	    dbBinding: D1Database,
    60	    values: readonly string[],
    61	): Promise<string[]> {
    62	    const permissions = await resolveModelPermissions(dbBinding, values);
    63	    return [
    64	        ...MODEL_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => permissions.has(category)),
    65	        ...[...permissions.keys()].filter((value) => !isModelCategory(value)),
    66	    ];
    67	}
    68	
    69	/**
    70	 * Whether a key limited to `models` may call everything the model permissions
    71	 * `values` allow, each model matched as gen matches a call to it.
    72	 */
    73	export async function keyAllowsModelPermissions(
    74	    dbBinding: D1Database,
    75	    models: readonly string[],
    76	    values: readonly string[],
    77	): Promise<boolean> {
    78	    const permissions = await resolveModelPermissions(dbBinding, values);
    79	    return [...permissions].every(([value, model]) =>
    80	        model ? keyAllowsModel(models, value, model) : models.includes(value),
    81	    );
    82	}
    83	
    84	export function isModelCategory(value: string): value is Category {
    85	    return (MODEL_CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
    86	}
    87	
    88	function registryPermission(value: string): string | undefined {
    89	    if (isModelCategory(value)) return value;
    90	    try {
    91	        const modelName = resolveModelName(value);
    92	        // Provider routes are internal; callers select the public model.
    93	        return getRegistryModelDefinition(modelName).fallbackOnly
    94	            ? undefined
    95	            : modelName;
    96	    } catch {
    97	        return undefined;
    98	    }
    99	}
   100	
   101	/**
   102	 * The canonical permissions for the requested values. Each model comes with
   103	 * the category and aliases a key's permissions match it by; a category maps
   104	 * to null.
   105	 */
   106	async function resolveModelPermissions(
   107	    dbBinding: D1Database,
   108	    values: readonly string[],
   109	): Promise<Map<string, ModelMatch | null>> {
   110	    const permissions = new Map<string, ModelMatch | null>();
   111	    const communityIds: string[] = [];
   112	    for (const value of values) {
   113	        const permission = registryPermission(value);
   114	        if (!permission) communityIds.push(value);
   115	        else {
   116	            permissions.set(
   117	                permission,
   118	                isModelCategory(permission)
   119	                    ? null
   120	                    : getRegistryModelDefinition(permission as ModelName),
   121	            );
   122	        }
   123	    }
   124	    const community = await communityModels(dbBinding, communityIds);
   125	    const unknown = communityIds.find((id) => !community.has(id));
   126	    if (unknown !== undefined) {
   127	        throw new HTTPException(400, {
   128	            message: `Model permission '${unknown}' is not a model category (${MODEL_CATEGORIES.join(", ")}) or a model ID from /models.`,
   129	        });
   130	    }
   131	    for (const { id, ...model } of community.values()) {
   132	        permissions.set(id, model);
   133	    }
   134	    return permissions;
   135	}
   136	
   137	/** The requested community model IDs that exist, by their canonical ID. */
   138	async function communityModels(
   139	    dbBinding: D1Database,
   140	    ids: readonly string[],
   141	): Promise<Map<string, ModelMatch & { id: string }>> {
   142	    const parsed = ids.flatMap((id) => {
   143	        const model = parseCommunityModelId(id);
   144	        return model ? [{ id, ...model }] : [];
   145	    });
   146	    if (parsed.length === 0) return new Map();
   147	    const rows = await drizzle(dbBinding)
   148	        .select({
   149	            owner: schema.user.githubUsername,
   150	            name: schema.communityEndpoint.name,
   151	            type: schema.communityEndpoint.type,
   152	            payload: schema.communityEndpoint.payload,
   153	        })
   154	        .from(schema.communityEndpoint)
   155	        .innerJoin(
   156	            schema.user,
   157	            eq(schema.communityEndpoint.ownerUserId, schema.user.id),
   158	        )
   159	        .where(
   160	            and(
   161	                inArray(
   162	                    schema.communityEndpoint.name,
   163	                    parsed.map(({ modelName }) => modelName),
   164	                ),
   165	                inArray(
   166	                    schema.user.githubUsername,
   167	                    parsed.map(
   168	                        ({ ownerGithubUsername }) => ownerGithubUsername,
   169	                    ),
   170	                ),
   171	            ),
   172	        );
   173	    const models = new Map<string, ModelMatch & { id: string }>();
   174	    for (const { id, ownerGithubUsername, modelName } of parsed) {
   175	        const row = rows.find(
   176	            (row) =>
   177	                row.owner === ownerGithubUsername && row.name === modelName,
   178	        );
   179	        if (!row) continue;
   180	        // As in gen's catalog: agents are text models and a proxy's modality
   181	        // sets its category.
   182	        const modality =
   183	            row.type === "proxy"
   184	                ? parseListingPayload("proxy", row.payload)?.modality
   185	                : undefined;
   186	        models.set(id, {
   187	            id: communityModelId(ownerGithubUsername, modelName),
   188	            category:
   189	                COMMUNITY_MODALITY_SPEC[
   190	                    normalizeCommunityEndpointModality(modality)
   191	                ].category,
   192	            aliases: [legacyCommunityModelId(ownerGithubUsername, modelName)],
   193	        });
   194	    }
   195	    return models;
   196	}

===== shared/registry/perplexity-billing.ts =====
     1	import type { BillingRules } from "./registry";
     2	
     3	// Agent API web_search, per invocation. A request can search any number of
     4	// times, including none.
     5	const WEB_SEARCH_COST_PER_THOUSAND = 2.5;
     6	
     7	type SearchUsage = {
     8	    tool_calls_details?: { search_web?: { invocation?: unknown } };
     9	    server_tool_use_details?: { web_search_requests?: unknown };
    10	};
    11	
    12	type UsageEvent = {
    13	    usage?: SearchUsage | null;
    14	    response?: { usage?: SearchUsage | null };
    15	};
    16	
    17	/**
    18	 * Searches the provider reported. Native Responses usage (a response or its
    19	 * `response.completed` event) carries `tool_calls_details`; the Chat adapter
    20	 * passes the same count on as `server_tool_use_details`.
    21	 */
    22	function countWebSearches(output: unknown): number {
    23	    const o = output as { streamEvents?: unknown } | undefined;
    24	    const events = (
    25	        Array.isArray(o?.streamEvents) ? o.streamEvents : [output]
    26	    ) as UsageEvent[];
    27	    for (const event of [...events].reverse()) {
    28	        const usage = event?.usage ?? event?.response?.usage;
    29	        const count =
    30	            usage?.tool_calls_details?.search_web?.invocation ??
    31	            usage?.server_tool_use_details?.web_search_requests;
    32	        if (typeof count === "number" && Number.isInteger(count) && count > 0)
    33	            return count;
    34	    }
    35	    return 0;
    36	}
    37	
    38	export const PERPLEXITY_WEB_SEARCH_BILLING: BillingRules = {
    39	    adjustments: [
    40	        {
    41	            id: "perplexity.web_search.v1",
    42	            description: `Perplexity web search adds $${WEB_SEARCH_COST_PER_THOUSAND} / 1K searches.`,
    43	            kind: "search_request",
    44	            unit: "request",
    45	            unitCost: WEB_SEARCH_COST_PER_THOUSAND / 1_000,
    46	            publicPricing: {
    47	                label: "Search",
    48	                quantity: 1_000,
    49	                unit: "searches",
    50	            },
    51	            countUnits: countWebSearches,
    52	        },
    53	    ],
    54	};
===== shared/registry/price-helpers.ts =====
     1	/**
     2	 * Converts dollars per million units to dollars per unit.
     3	 *
     4	 * @param dollarsPerMillion - The price in dollars per million units (tokens/images)
     5	 * @returns The price in dollars per unit
     6	 *
     7	 * @example
     8	 * ```ts
     9	 * // Convert $50 per million tokens to dollars per token
    10	 * const pricePerToken = perMillion(50); // 0.00005
    11	 *
    12	 * // Use in cost definitions
    13	 * const cost = {
    14	 *   promptTextTokens: perMillion(50),    // $50 per 1M tokens
    15	 *   completionTextTokens: perMillion(200) // $200 per 1M tokens
    16	 * };
    17	 * ```
    18	 */
    19	export function perMillion(dollarsPerMillion: number): number {
    20	    return dollarsPerMillion / 1_000_000;
    21	}
===== shared/registry/public-pricing.ts =====
     1	/** Values are keyed by rate-sheet name; the empty key selects base pricing. */

     9	export type PublicPricingDefinition = {
    10	    label: string;
    11	    quantity: number;
    12	    unit: string;
    13	    suffix?: string;

    15	        group: string;
    16	        value: string;

    25	export type BillingRateDefinition = {
    26	    id: string;
    27	    description: string;
    28	    kind: string;
    29	    unit: string;
    30	    unitCost: number;
    31	    publicPricing: PublicPricingDefinition;

    34	export type PublicPriceInfo = PublicPricingDefinition & {
    35	    name: string;
    36	    kind: string;
    37	    price: string;
    38	    currency: "pollen";
    39	};
    40	
    41	export function toFixedPoint(value: number): string {
    42	    return value.toFixed(12).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
    43	}
    44	
    45	export function publicPriceInfo(
    46	    rate: BillingRateDefinition,
    47	    priceMultiplier = 1,
    48	): PublicPriceInfo {
    49	    return {
    50	        name: rate.id,
    51	        kind: rate.kind,
    52	        price: toFixedPoint(
    53	            rate.unitCost * rate.publicPricing.quantity * priceMultiplier,
    54	        ),
    55	        currency: "pollen",
    56	        ...rate.publicPricing,
    57	    };
    58	}
===== shared/registry/realtime-billing.ts =====
     1	import type { BillingAdjustmentRule, BillingRules } from "./registry";
     2	
     3	const PER_MILLION = 1_000_000;
     4	
     5	type RealtimeBillingOutput = {
     6	    realtimeCache?: {
     7	        audioTokens?: unknown;
     8	        imageTokens?: unknown;
     9	    };
    10	};
    11	
    12	function countCachedTokens(
    13	    output: unknown,
    14	    modality: "audio" | "image",
    15	): number {
    16	    const value = output as RealtimeBillingOutput | undefined;
    17	    const tokens = value?.realtimeCache?.[`${modality}Tokens`];
    18	    return typeof tokens === "number" && Number.isFinite(tokens) && tokens > 0
    19	        ? tokens
    20	        : 0;
    21	}
    22	
    23	function cachedTokenAdjustment(
    24	    modality: "audio" | "image",
    25	    rate: number,
    26	    cachedTextRate: number,
    27	): BillingAdjustmentRule {
    28	    return {
    29	        id: `openai.realtime.cached_${modality}_delta.v1`,
    30	        description: `Cached ${modality} input costs $${rate.toFixed(2)}/M instead of the $${cachedTextRate.toFixed(2)}/M cached-text base rate.`,
    31	        kind: `cached_${modality}_input`,
    32	        unit: "token",
    33	        unitCost: (rate - cachedTextRate) / PER_MILLION,
    34	        publicPricing: {
    35	            label: `Cached ${modality} input`,
    36	            quantity: PER_MILLION,
    37	            unit: "tokens",
    38	        },
    39	        countUnits: (output) => countCachedTokens(output, modality),
    40	    };
    41	}
    42	
    43	// Generic cached input is billed at the cached-text rate. The provider reports
    44	// cached audio and image tokens separately, so these rules add only the
    45	// modality-specific difference and keep both usage and totals exact.
    46	export const OPENAI_REALTIME_CACHE_BILLING: BillingRules = {
    47	    adjustments: [cachedTokenAdjustment("image", 0.5, 0.4)],
    48	};
    49	
    50	export const OPENAI_REALTIME_2_1_MINI_CACHE_BILLING: BillingRules = {
    51	    adjustments: [
    52	        cachedTokenAdjustment("audio", 0.3, 0.06),
    53	        cachedTokenAdjustment("image", 0.08, 0.06),
    54	    ],
    55	};

   127	export type BillingAdjustmentRule = BillingRateDefinition & {
   128	    // Counts billable units from the response output (stream outputs carry a
   129	    // `streamEvents` array). Returning 0 skips the rule for this request.
   130	    // Provider-specific parsing lives with the rule's provider module
   131	    // (gemini-billing.ts, perplexity-billing.ts) — not in the registry.
   132	    countUnits: (output: unknown, input?: PricingInput) => number;
   133	    // Optional provider-reported unit cost (e.g. Perplexity usage.cost)
   134	    // resolved via the provider module's clamp-and-alert policy. Must never
   135	    // throw. Defaults to the static unitCost when omitted.
   136	    resolveUnitCost?: (
   137	        output: unknown,
   138	        model: string,
   139	        input?: PricingInput,
   140	    ) => number;
   141	};
   142	
   143	export type BillingRules = {
   144	    adjustments?: BillingAdjustmentRule[];
   145	    /** Complete provider charge, including tools, when token details cannot reproduce it. */
   146	    resolveTotalCost?: (output: unknown) => number | undefined;
   147	};
   148	
   149	// Per-rule billing breakdown, returned in parallel to the numeric usage maps.
   150	// The model's effective priceMultiplier applies uniformly to tokens and
   151	// adjustments alike (there is no per-rule multiplier), so adjustment prices
   152	// are always derivable from costs: price = cost × effective multiplier.
   153	export type BillingAdjustment = {
   154	    ruleId: string;
   155	    kind: string;
   156	    unit: string;
   157	    units: number;
   158	    unitCost: number;
   159	    cost: number;
   160	    price: number;
   161	};
   162	
   163	export type ModelDefinition = {
   164	    aliases: string[];
   165	    /** Supplier attributed to this route's cost, not its publisher or API protocol.
   166	     * Must resolve in the Economics vendor registry; CI checks all bundled routes.
   167	     */
   168	    provider: string;
   169	    /** Exact gateway-side request cap per Pollinations user. Null/unset means uncapped. */
   170	    perUserRpm?: number | null;
   171	    /** Ordered model ids to try when this model's upstream fails. */
   172	    fallbacks?: string[];
   173	    /** Input safety features callers cannot disable for this model. */
   174	    requiredSafetyFeatures?: SafetyFeature[];
   175	    /** Human-readable model publisher, e.g. "OpenAI" or "Anthropic". */
   176	    publisher: string;
   177	    category: Category;
   178	    cost: CostDefinition;
   179	    // Named alternate rate sheets, merged over `cost` when selectCostVariant
   180	    // picks one (keys not listed in a variant inherit the base rate). Rates
   181	    // are always data — selectors return a NAME, never a number. Provider
   182	    // tiers (long-context, resolution) each map to one named sheet here.
   183	    costVariants?: Record<string, CostDefinition>;
   184	    // Public explanation for every named rate sheet. Kept alongside the
   185	    // selector so /models and the dashboard can disclose when alternate rates
   186	    // apply without attempting to serialize selector code.
   187	    costVariantMetadata?: Record<string, CostVariantMetadata>;
   188	    // Public label for the base rate sheet selected when no named variant
   189	    // applies, such as "720p" or "≤272K context".
   190	    defaultCostVariantLabel?: string;
   191	    pricingDimensions?: PricingDimension[];
   192	    // Picks the rate sheet for one request, evaluated once at billing time
   193	    // inside calculateUsageBilling. Must be pure and never throw. Returning
   194	    // undefined (or an unknown name — warned) bills at base rates. Selection
   195	    // is code; money is data.
   196	    selectCostVariant?: (context: CostVariantContext) => string | undefined;
   197	    // USD-cost to Pollen-price multiplier. Required on every model — there is
   198	    // no implicit default. Typical values: 1 (sold at cost) or 1.5 (paid markup).
   199	    priceMultiplier: number;
   200	    // Override the multiplier for a named cost variant when customer tiers
   201	    // differ from the provider's tiers (e.g. flat-cost long-context inference).
   202	    priceMultiplierVariants?: Record<string, number>;
   203	    billing?: BillingRules;
   204	    // Date the model was added to the registry (ms epoch). Set once, never updated.
   205	    addedDate: number;
   206	    // User-facing metadata
   207	    title: string; // Human display name, e.g. "FLUX.1 Kontext"
   208	    brandUrl?: string;
   209	    brandIconUrl?: string;
   210	    // Backward compatibility: public descriptions currently include the title
   211	    // prefix ("Title - description"). Prefer `title` for display names.
   212	    description?: string;
   213	    inputModalities?: ModelInputModality[];
   214	    outputModalities?: ModelOutputModality[];
   215	    tools?: boolean;
   216	    /** Controls honored by this model through `/v1/chat/completions`. */
   217	    supportedParameters?: string[];
   218	    reasoning?: boolean;
   219	    search?: boolean;
   220	    codeExecution?: boolean;
   221	    contextLength?: number;
   222	    voices?: string[];
   223	    isSpecialized?: boolean;
   224	    // True when callers may only spend Paid Pollen; false when Quest Pollen
   225	    // also works. Required on every model — there is no implicit default.
   226	    paidOnly: boolean;
   227	    alpha?: boolean; // Experimental models with potential instability
   228	    // Flat per-generation pricing (one fee per request, independent of output
   229	    // size/length). Lets the pricing UI show a "/gen" badge instead of guessing
   230	    // a per-second rate from a per-token cost. Used to disambiguate flat-fee
   231	    // audio (e.g. Stable Audio) from per-character TTS, which share cost fields.
   232	    flatRate?: boolean;
   233	    priceUnits?: PriceUnits;
   234	    hidden?: boolean; // Hidden from /models endpoints and dashboard, but still usable via API
   235	    /** Internal provider route: hidden from discovery and rejected when selected by a caller. */
   236	    fallbackOnly?: boolean;
   237	    /** Change when the same request starts producing different media, so old cached results are not served. */
   238	    cacheVersion?: string;
   239	    supportedEndpoints?: string[]; // Override the default endpoints for specialized models
   240	    // Supported output resolutions; first entry is the default.
   241	    resolutions?: string[];
   242	    videoCapabilities?: VideoCapability[]; // Video-only: which frame controls the provider supports
   243	    minDuration?: number; // Video and audio: minimum accepted duration in seconds
   244	    maxDuration?: number; // Video and audio: maximum accepted duration in seconds
   245	    defaultDuration?: number; // Video-only: duration when caller omits the param
   246	    allowedDurations?: number[]; // Video and audio: explicit set of valid durations (overrides min/max range)
   247	    durationStep?: number; // Video-only: duration must be a multiple of this value
   248	    maxReferenceImages?: number; // Models with image input: effective accepted reference images
   249	    maxReferenceVideos?: number; // Models with video input: effective accepted reference videos
   250	    supportsTransparency?: boolean; // Image-only: `transparent=true` returns a PNG with alpha; other models reject it
   251	    /** Output-token limit enforced on public requests and fallback routes. */
   252	    maxCompletionTokens?: number;
   253	    /** False when the model rejects JSON/structured output requests. */
   254	    supportsStructuredOutput?: boolean;
   255	    /** False when the model answers JSON mode (json_object) with no content but honors json_schema. */
   256	    supportsJsonMode?: boolean;
   257	    /** False when the upstream has no SSE; Gen buffers `stream: true` calls. */
   258	    supportsStreaming?: boolean;
   259	};
   260	
   261	// Helper: Convert usage counts to rated USD-equivalent cost or Pollen charge.
   262	// When a usage type is reported by upstream but the registry has no rate for it,
   263	// log a warning (so we know which (model, usageType) pair needs adding) and bill
   264	// that line as 0. Throwing here drops the whole tracking event and creates a
   265	// silent billing leak.
   266	function convertUsage(
   267	    usage: Usage,
   268	    rateDefinition: CostDefinition,
   269	    model: string,
   270	): Usage {
   271	    const convertedUsage = Object.fromEntries(
   272	        Object.entries(usage).map(([usageType, amount]) => {
   273	            if (amount === 0) return [usageType, 0];
   274	            const usageTypeWithFallback =
   275	                usageType === "completionReasoningTokens"
   276	                    ? "completionTextTokens"
   277	                    : usageType;
   278	            const conversionRate =
   279	                rateDefinition[usageTypeWithFallback as UsageType];
   280	            if (conversionRate === undefined) {
   281	                console.warn(
   282	                    `[registry] Missing conversion rate: model=${model.toString()} usageType=${usageType} amount=${amount} — billing 0 for this line`,
   283	                );
   284	                return [usageType, 0];
   285	            }
   286	            return [usageType, amount * conversionRate];
   287	        }),
   288	    );
   289	    return convertedUsage as Usage;
   290	}
   291	
   292	export function derivePrice(
   293	    costDefinition: CostDefinition,
   294	    priceMultiplier: number,
   295	): PriceDefinition {
   296	    if (priceMultiplier === 1) return costDefinition;
   297	    return Object.fromEntries(
   298	        Object.entries(costDefinition).map(([k, v]) => [
   299	            k,
   300	            (v as number) * priceMultiplier,
   301	        ]),
   302	    ) as PriceDefinition;
   303	}
   304	
   305	// Resolve the variant name for one request. Never throws: a throwing or
   306	// misconfigured selector logs and falls back to base rates — a selector bug
   307	// must never drop the tracking event or bill zero.
   308	export type CostVariantSelectionStatus =
   309	    | "base"
   310	    | "selected"
   311	    | "unknown"
   312	    | "selector_error";
   313	
   314	type CostVariantSelection = {
   315	    name?: string;
   316	    status: CostVariantSelectionStatus;
   317	};
   318	
   319	function selectCostVariant(
   320	    model: string,
   321	    usage: Usage,
   322	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   323	    input?: PricingInput,
   324	): CostVariantSelection {
   325	    if (!svc.selectCostVariant) return { status: "base" };
   326	    let name: string | undefined;
   327	    try {
   328	        name = svc.selectCostVariant({ usage, input });
   329	    } catch (error) {
   330	        console.warn(
   331	            `[registry] selectCostVariant threw for model=${model} — billing base rates`,
   332	            error,
   333	        );
   334	        return { status: "selector_error" };
   335	    }
   336	    if (name === undefined) return { status: "base" };
   337	    if (!svc.costVariants?.[name]) {
   338	        console.warn(
   339	            `[registry] Unknown cost variant "${name}" for model=${model} — billing base rates`,
   340	        );
   341	        return { status: "unknown" };
   342	    }
   343	    return { name, status: "selected" };
   344	}
   345	
   346	function calculateLinearCost(
   347	    model: string,
   348	    usage: Usage,
   349	    costDefinition: CostDefinition,
   350	): UsageCost {
   351	    const usageCost = convertUsage(usage, costDefinition, model);
   352	    const totalCost = Object.values(usageCost).reduce(
   353	        (total, cost) => total + cost,
   354	        0,
   355	    );
   356	    return {
   357	        ...usageCost,
   358	        totalCost,
   359	    };
   360	}
   361	
   362	// Single source of truth: the per-rule breakdown. Cost/price totals are derived
   363	// from this so there is no duplicated rule loop. The registry stays generic:
   364	// each rule brings its own counter and (optionally) provider-cost resolution.
   365	export function calculateBillingAdjustments(
   366	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   367	    output: unknown,
   368	    model: string,
   369	    input?: PricingInput,
   370	    priceMultiplier = svc.priceMultiplier,
   371	): BillingAdjustment[] {
   372	    const adjustments: BillingAdjustment[] = [];
   373	    for (const rule of svc.billing?.adjustments ?? []) {
   374	        const units = rule.countUnits(output, input);
   375	        if (units === 0) continue;
   376	        const unitCost =
   377	            rule.resolveUnitCost?.(output, model, input) ?? rule.unitCost;
   378	        const cost = units * unitCost;
   379	        adjustments.push({
   380	            ruleId: rule.id,
   381	            kind: rule.kind,
   382	            unit: rule.unit,
   383	            units,
   384	            unitCost,
   385	            cost,
   386	            price: cost * priceMultiplier,
   387	        });
   388	    }
   389	    return adjustments;
   390	}
   391	
   392	// Full billing for one model definition. Fallbacks rate the served and quoted
   393	// definitions independently because their costs, prices, and rules may differ.
   394	export type UsageBilling = {
   395	    cost: UsageCost;
   396	    price: UsagePrice;
   397	    adjustments: BillingAdjustment[];
   398	    // Effective per-unit Pollen price sheet (cost variant × multiplier), not
   399	    // the request-time base sheet. Provider-reported billing units can differ
   400	    // from public usage units, so this sheet alone may not reproduce totals
   401	    // overridden by providerBilling; those use its units and unitCost.
   402	    priceDefinition: PriceDefinition;
   403	    // Name of the applied cost variant, if any (financial identity — distinct
   404	    // from modelUsed, which stays observational).
   405	    costVariant?: string;
   406	    // Distinguishes a normal base-rate request from selector failures that
   407	    // safely fell back to base rates.
   408	    costVariantStatus: CostVariantSelectionStatus;
   409	    /**
   410	     * What the model that actually ran would have been charged for this usage.
   411	     * Equal to `price.totalPrice` unless a fallback served, where it is what
   412	     * bounds the serving owner's reward — they are paid on their own listing,
   413	     * not on the (higher) one the caller bought.
   414	     */
   415	    servedPrice: number;
   416	};
   417	
   418	export type UsageBillingInput = {
   419	    model: string;
   420	    usage: Usage;
   421	    /** Whose upstream ran — decides what the generation cost us. */
   422	    servedBy: ModelDefinition;
   423	    /**
   424	     * Whose listing the caller bought — decides what they are charged. Defaults
   425	     * to the model that served, which is every case except a fallback.
   426	     */
   427	    quotedBy?: ModelDefinition;
   428	    output?: unknown;
   429	    /**
   430	     * Normalized request facts that select a cost variant. Applied to both
   431	     * sides of a fallback: each definition picks the variant from its own
   432	     * sheet, so the caller's tier and the server's tier stay independent.
   433	     */
   434	    input?: PricingInput;
   435	};
   436	
   437	/**
   438	 * Rates one usage against one model definition.
   439	 *
   440	 * Price is the cost scaled by that definition's multiplier, so it cannot be
   441	 * borrowed across definitions: community endpoints carry per-usage-type rate
   442	 * vectors their owners set, and rescaling one owner's cost by another's
   443	 * multiplier would invent a price neither of them published.
   444	 */
   445	function rateAgainst(
   446	    model: string,
   447	    usage: Usage,
   448	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   449	    output?: unknown,
   450	    input?: PricingInput,
   451	): Omit<UsageBilling, "servedPrice"> {
   452	    const selection = selectCostVariant(model, usage, svc, input);
   453	    const costVariant = selection.name;
   454	    const priceMultiplier = getPriceMultiplier(svc, costVariant);
   455	    const adjustments = calculateBillingAdjustments(
   456	        svc,
   457	        output,
   458	        model,
   459	        input,
   460	        priceMultiplier,
   461	    );
   462	    const adjustmentCost = adjustments.reduce((total, a) => total + a.cost, 0);
   463	    const adjustmentPrice = adjustments.reduce(
   464	        (total, a) => total + a.price,
   465	        0,
   466	    );
   467	
   468	    const effectiveCost = costVariant
   469	        ? { ...svc.cost, ...svc.costVariants?.[costVariant] }
   470	        : svc.cost;
   471	    const usageCost = calculateLinearCost(model, usage, effectiveCost);
   472	    const cost =
   473	        adjustmentCost === 0
   474	            ? usageCost
   475	            : {
   476	                  ...usageCost,
   477	                  totalCost: usageCost.totalCost + adjustmentCost,
   478	              };
   479	
   480	    const usagePrice = Object.fromEntries(
   481	        Object.entries(usageCost)
   482	            .filter(([usageType]) => usageType !== "totalCost")
   483	            .map(([usageType, usageTypeCost]) => [
   484	                usageType,
   485	                (usageTypeCost as number) * priceMultiplier,
   486	            ]),
   487	    ) as Usage;
   488	    const tokenTotalPrice = Object.values(usagePrice).reduce(
   489	        (total, price) => total + price,
   490	        0,
   491	    );
   492	    const price = {
   493	        ...usagePrice,
   494	        totalPrice: roundPollenLedgerAmount(tokenTotalPrice + adjustmentPrice),
   495	    };
   496	
   497	    // Opt-in provider totals include search; adjustments remain an informational breakdown.
   498	    const reportedCost = svc.billing?.resolveTotalCost?.(output);
   499	
   500	    return {
   501	        cost: reportedCost === undefined ? cost : { totalCost: reportedCost },
   502	        price:
   503	            reportedCost === undefined
   504	                ? price
   505	                : {
   506	                      totalPrice: roundPollenLedgerAmount(
   507	                          reportedCost * priceMultiplier,
   508	                      ),
   509	                  },
   510	        adjustments,
   511	        priceDefinition: derivePrice(effectiveCost, priceMultiplier),
   512	        costVariant,
   513	        costVariantStatus: selection.status,
   514	    };
   515	}
   516	
   517	/**
   518	 * What the generation cost us, and what the caller pays for it.
   519	 *
   520	 * Trusted provider billing units and their rate replace estimated cost;
   521	 * price is that cost times the serving model's multiplier. A fallback still
   522	 * charges the requested listing's price.
   523	 */
   524	export function calculateUsageBilling({
   525	    model,
   526	    usage,
   527	    servedBy,
   528	    quotedBy = servedBy,
   529	    output,
   530	    input,
   531	}: UsageBillingInput): UsageBilling {
   532	    const served = rateAgainst(model, usage, servedBy, output, input);
   533	    // Provider units need not match public usage units (e.g. weighted video
   534	    // seconds), so the receipt gives a total, not a per-usage-type breakdown.
   535	    if (input?.providerBilling) {
   536	        const totalCost =
   537	            input.providerBilling.units * input.providerBilling.unitCost;
   538	        served.cost = { totalCost };
   539	        served.price = {
   540	            totalPrice: roundPollenLedgerAmount(
   541	                totalCost * getPriceMultiplier(servedBy, served.costVariant),
   542	            ),
   543	        };
   544	    }
   545	    if (quotedBy === servedBy) {
   546	        return { ...served, servedPrice: served.price.totalPrice };
   547	    }
   548	    // Rated independently rather than rescaled: see rateAgainst.
   549	    const quoted = rateAgainst(model, usage, quotedBy, output, input);
   550	    const selectionStatuses = [
   551	        served.costVariantStatus,
   552	        quoted.costVariantStatus,
   553	    ];
   554	    const costVariantStatus = selectionStatuses.includes("selector_error")
   555	        ? "selector_error"
   556	        : selectionStatuses.includes("unknown")
   557	          ? "unknown"
   558	          : quoted.costVariantStatus;
   559	    return {
   560	        cost: served.cost,
   561	        adjustments: served.adjustments,
   562	        price: quoted.price,
   563	        servedPrice: served.price.totalPrice,
   564	        // The rate sheet and variant identify what the caller was billed. The
   565	        // status is a health signal, so a failure on either side takes priority.
   566	        priceDefinition: quoted.priceDefinition,
   567	        costVariant: quoted.costVariant,
   568	        costVariantStatus,
   569	    };
   570	}

   572	const MODEL_REGISTRY = {
   573	    ...TEXT_SERVICES,
   574	    ...IMAGE_SERVICES,
   575	    ...AUDIO_SERVICES,
   576	    ...EMBEDDING_SERVICES,
   577	    ...REALTIME_SERVICES,
   578	    ...MODEL3D_SERVICES,
   579	} as Record<ModelName, ModelDefinition>;
   580	
   581	/**
   582	 * Resolve a model name from a canonical name or alias
   583	 * @param model - Model name or alias
   584	 * @returns Resolved canonical model name
   585	 * @throws Error if model is not found
   586	 */
   587	export function resolveModelName(model: string): ModelName {
   588	    if (MODEL_REGISTRY[model as ModelName]) {
   589	        return model as ModelName;
   590	    }
   591	    for (const [modelName, service] of Object.entries(MODEL_REGISTRY)) {
   592	        if (service.aliases.includes(model)) {
   593	            return modelName as ModelName;
   594	        }
   595	    }
   596	    throw new Error(
   597	        `Invalid model or alias: "${model}". Must be a valid model name or alias.`,
   598	    );
   599	}

   644	/** The catalog's flat-rate rule: an explicit `flatRate`, or an image model with no prompt-token rate. */
   645	export const isFlatRateModel = (definition: ModelDefinition): boolean =>
   646	    definition.flatRate ??
   647	    (definition.category === "image" &&
   648	        definition.cost.promptTextTokens === undefined);
   649	
   650	/** No request can bill: every rate sheet is zero and no billing rule adds a charge. */
   651	export const isFreeModel = (definition: ModelDefinition): boolean =>
   652	    !definition.billing &&
   653	    getCostSheetsForModel(definition).every((sheet) =>
   654	        Object.values(sheet).every((rate) => rate === 0),
   655	    );
   656	
   657	/** Why the registry refuses this duration for the model, or undefined when it accepts it. */
   658	export function durationError(
   659	    model: string,
   660	    { minDuration, maxDuration, allowedDurations }: ModelDefinition,
   661	    duration: number,
   662	): string | undefined {
   663	    const accepted = allowedDurations
   664	        ? allowedDurations.includes(duration)
   665	        : duration >= (minDuration ?? duration) &&
   666	          duration <= (maxDuration ?? duration);
   667	    if (accepted) return undefined;
   668	    const range =
   669	        allowedDurations?.join(", ") ?? `${minDuration}-${maxDuration}`;
   670	    return `Unsupported duration for ${model}: ${duration}. It accepts ${range} seconds.`;
   671	}

   673	export const isVisibleModelDefinition = (
   674	    definition: ModelDefinition,
   675	): boolean => definition.hidden !== true && definition.fallbackOnly !== true;

   682	export const getVisibleRealtimeModels = () =>

   684	export const getVisibleModel3dModels = () => filterVisible(getModel3dModels());

   686	/**
   687	 * Get a model definition from the bundled registry.
   688	 *
   689	 * This only covers built-in Pollinations models. Runtime models, such as
   690	 * community endpoints, should be resolved at the request boundary and then
   691	 * passed around as a `ModelDefinition`.
   692	 */
   693	export function getRegistryModelDefinition(model: ModelName): ModelDefinition {
   694	    const definition = MODEL_REGISTRY[model];
   695	    if (!definition) {
   696	        throw new Error(`Invalid model: "${model}"`);
   697	    }
   698	    return definition;
   699	}
   700	
   701	export function getPriceDefinitionForModel(
   702	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   703	    variant?: string,
   704	): PriceDefinition {
   705	    return derivePrice(
   706	        variant ? { ...svc.cost, ...svc.costVariants?.[variant] } : svc.cost,
   707	        getPriceMultiplier(svc, variant),
   708	    );
   709	}
   710	
   711	function getPriceMultiplier(svc: ModelDefinition, variant?: string): number {
   712	    return (
   713	        (variant ? svc.priceMultiplierVariants?.[variant] : undefined) ??
   714	        svc.priceMultiplier
   715	    );
   716	}
   717	
   718	/** Every cost sheet a model can bill at: its base cost and each variant over it. */
   719	export function getCostSheetsForModel(svc: ModelDefinition): CostDefinition[] {
   720	    return [
   721	        svc.cost,
   722	        ...Object.values(svc.costVariants ?? {}).map((variant) => ({
   723	            ...svc.cost,
   724	            ...variant,
   725	        })),
   726	    ];
   727	}
   728	
   729	/**
   730	 * True when `target` costs no more than `primary` for every usage type. A
   731	 * usage type the primary does not price counts as free, so a target that
   732	 * charges for it is rejected.
   733	 */
   734	export function isFallbackPricingAllowed(
   735	    primary: PriceDefinition,
   736	    target: PriceDefinition,
   737	): boolean {
   738	    return Object.entries(target).every(
   739	        ([usageType, price]) =>
   740	            (price ?? 0) <= (primary[usageType as UsageType] ?? 0),
   741	    );
   742	}
   743	
   744	/**
   745	 * Get cost definition for a public model name
   746	 */
   747	export function getCostDefinition(model: ModelName): CostDefinition | null {
   748	    return MODEL_REGISTRY[model]?.cost ?? null;
   749	}
   750	
   751	/**
   752	 * Get Pollen price definition for a public model name (cost × multiplier)
   753	 */
   754	export function getPriceDefinition(model: ModelName): PriceDefinition | null {
   755	    const svc = MODEL_REGISTRY[model];
   756	    if (!svc) return null;
   757	    return getPriceDefinitionForModel(svc);
   758	}
   759	
   760	/**
   761	 * Calculate cost for a model based on usage
   762	 */
   763	export function calculateCost(
   764	    model: ModelName,
   765	    usage: Usage,
   766	    output?: unknown,
   767	    input?: PricingInput,
   768	): UsageCost {
   769	    const svc = MODEL_REGISTRY[model];
   770	    if (!svc)
   771	        throw new Error(
   772	            `Failed to get current cost for model: ${model.toString()}`,
   773	        );
   774	    return calculateCostForModelDefinition(model, usage, svc, output, input);
   775	}
   776	
   777	export function calculateCostForModelDefinition(
   778	    model: string,
   779	    usage: Usage,
   780	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   781	    output?: unknown,
   782	    input?: PricingInput,
   783	): UsageCost {
   784	    return calculateUsageBilling({ model, usage, servedBy: svc, output, input })
   785	        .cost;
   786	}
   787	
   788	/**
   789	 * Calculate price for a model based on usage
   790	 */
   791	export function calculatePrice(
   792	    model: ModelName,
   793	    usage: Usage,
   794	    output?: unknown,
   795	    input?: PricingInput,
   796	): UsagePrice {
   797	    const svc = MODEL_REGISTRY[model];
   798	    if (!svc)
   799	        throw new Error(
   800	            `Failed to get current price for model: ${model.toString()}`,
   801	        );
   802	    return calculatePriceForModelDefinition(model, usage, svc, output, input);
   803	}
   804	
   805	export function calculatePriceForModelDefinition(
   806	    model: string,
   807	    usage: Usage,
   808	    svc: ModelDefinition,
   809	    output?: unknown,
   810	    input?: PricingInput,
   811	): UsagePrice {
   812	    return calculateUsageBilling({ model, usage, servedBy: svc, output, input })
   813	        .price;
   814	}
===== shared/registry/sandbox.ts =====
     1	// The sandbox templates Pollinations runs, and what they cost. Gen starts and
     2	// bills sandboxes from these tables; /alpha/e2b/pricing and the dashboard
     3	// list them.
     4	
     5	export type SandboxProvider = "e2b" | "azure";
     6	
     7	// What each provider charges us per running second, in pollen (1 pollen ≈ $1):
     8	// E2B's list prices, and Azure's for a running box, which our Azure credits
     9	// pay. Callers pay `share` of them: a launch promo on both providers, review
    10	// by 2026-12-31.
    11	export const SANDBOX_PROVIDERS: Record<
    12	    SandboxProvider,
    13	    { name: string; vcpuSecond: number; gibSecond: number; share: number }
    14	> = {
    15	    e2b: {
    16	        name: "E2B",
    17	        vcpuSecond: 0.000014,
    18	        gibSecond: 0.0000045,
    19	        share: 0.25,
    20	    },
    21	    azure: {
    22	        name: "Azure",
    23	        vcpuSecond: 0.000024,
    24	        gibSecond: 0.000003,
    25	        share: 0.25,
    26	    },
    27	};
    28	
    29	export type SandboxTemplate = {
    30	    id: string;
    31	    name: string;
    32	    provider: SandboxProvider;
    33	    cpuCount: number;
    34	    memoryMB: number;
    35	    diskSizeMB: number;
    36	};
    37	
    38	// One image with polli and the coding harnesses in several sizes
    39	// (operations/infrastructure/e2b and azure-sandboxes); gen logs polli in inside
    40	// them. E2B resolves the exact ids to our team's templates, with the sizes they
    41	// were built with. Azure gets the size from gen and picks the disk by it.
    42	export const SANDBOX_TEMPLATES: readonly SandboxTemplate[] = [
    43	    {
    44	        id: "pollinations",
    45	        name: "Pollinations",
    46	        provider: "e2b",
    47	        cpuCount: 2,
    48	        memoryMB: 2048,
    49	        diskSizeMB: 26640,
    50	    },
    51	    {
    52	        id: "pollinations-large",
    53	        name: "Pollinations Large",
    54	        provider: "e2b",
    55	        cpuCount: 4,
    56	        memoryMB: 8192,
    57	        diskSizeMB: 60432,
    58	    },
    59	    {
    60	        id: "pollinations-azure",
    61	        name: "Pollinations",
    62	        provider: "azure",
    63	        cpuCount: 2,
    64	        memoryMB: 2048,
    65	        diskSizeMB: 40960,
    66	    },
    67	    {
    68	        id: "pollinations-azure-large",
    69	        name: "Pollinations Large",
    70	        provider: "azure",
    71	        cpuCount: 4,
    72	        memoryMB: 8192,
    73	        diskSizeMB: 81920,
    74	    },
    75	    {
    76	        id: "pollinations-azure-xl",
    77	        name: "Pollinations XL",
    78	        provider: "azure",
    79	        cpuCount: 8,
    80	        memoryMB: 16384,
    81	        diskSizeMB: 163840,
    82	    },
    83	];
    84	
    85	export const sandboxTemplate = (id: string | undefined) =>
    86	    SANDBOX_TEMPLATES.find((template) => template.id === id);
    87	
    88	type Rates = { vcpuSecond: number; gibSecond: number };
    89	
    90	// The rates a caller pays on this provider.
    91	export function callerRates(provider: SandboxProvider): Rates {
    92	    const { vcpuSecond, gibSecond, share } = SANDBOX_PROVIDERS[provider];
    93	    return { vcpuSecond: vcpuSecond * share, gibSecond: gibSecond * share };
    94	}
    95	
    96	export const perSecond = (
    97	    rates: Rates,
    98	    size: { cpuCount: number; memoryMB: number },
    99	) =>
   100	    size.cpuCount * rates.vcpuSecond + (size.memoryMB / 1024) * rates.gibSecond;

  4327	        isSpecialized: true,
  4328	    },
  4329	} as const satisfies Record<string, ModelDefinition>;

   101	export function getOpenAIEmbeddingUsage(
   102	    value: unknown,
   103	): OpenAIEmbeddingUsage | null {
   104	    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("usage" in value)) {
   105	        return null;
   106	    }
   107	    const usage = value.usage;
   108	    if (
   109	        !usage ||
   110	        typeof usage !== "object" ||
   111	        !("prompt_tokens" in usage) ||
   112	        !isTokenCount(usage.prompt_tokens) ||
   113	        !("total_tokens" in usage) ||
   114	        !isTokenCount(usage.total_tokens) ||
   115	        usage.total_tokens !== usage.prompt_tokens
   116	    ) {
   117	        return null;
   118	    }
   119	    return usage as OpenAIEmbeddingUsage;

   122	export function getOpenAIImageUsage(value: unknown): OpenAIImageUsage | null {
   123	    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("usage" in value)) {
   124	        return null;
   125	    }
   126	    const usage = value.usage;
   127	    if (!usage || typeof usage !== "object") return null;
   128	    const details =
   129	        "input_tokens_details" in usage
   130	            ? usage.input_tokens_details
   131	            : undefined;
   132	    if (!details || typeof details !== "object") return null;
   133	    if (
   134	        !("input_tokens" in usage) ||
   135	        !isTokenCount(usage.input_tokens) ||
   136	        !("output_tokens" in usage) ||
   137	        !isTokenCount(usage.output_tokens) ||
   138	        !("total_tokens" in usage) ||
   139	        !isTokenCount(usage.total_tokens) ||
   140	        !("text_tokens" in details) ||
   141	        !isTokenCount(details.text_tokens) ||
   142	        !("image_tokens" in details) ||
   143	        !isTokenCount(details.image_tokens)
   144	    ) {
   145	        return null;
   146	    }
   147	    if (
   148	        usage.input_tokens !== details.text_tokens + details.image_tokens ||
   149	        usage.total_tokens !== usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens
   150	    ) {
   151	        return null;
   152	    }
   153	    return usage as OpenAIImageUsage;
   154	}

   156	export function usageToOpenAIImageUsage(usage: Usage): OpenAIImageUsage {
   157	    const inputTextTokens =
   158	        (usage.promptTextTokens ?? 0) +
   159	        (usage.promptCachedTokens ?? 0) +
   160	        (usage.promptCacheWriteTokens ?? 0);
