   189	/**
   190	 * Convert OpenAI usage format to Usage format.
   191	 *
   192	 * The OpenAI spec defines `completion_tokens` (and `prompt_tokens`) as the
   193	 * inclusive grand total, with `*_details` subcategories that sum into it.
   194	 * Some providers violate or extend this: Grok/xAI reasoning can report
   195	 * reasoning as an additive counter separate from completion_tokens. Others
   196	 * have returned inconsistent inclusive details greater than the headline
   197	 * count, which we cap to avoid impossible negative usage.
   198	 *
   199	 * We detect the convention per-row from `total_tokens`. If total_tokens is
   200	 * prompt + completion, details are inclusive subcategories. If total_tokens
   201	 * includes detail counters beyond prompt + completion, only the matching
   202	 * detail bucket is additive and the related top-level count is already the
   203	 * visible-text count.
   204	 */
   205	export function openaiUsageToUsage(openaiUsage: {
   206	    prompt_tokens: number;
   207	    completion_tokens: number;
   208	    total_tokens: number;
   209	    prompt_tokens_details?: {
   210	        cached_tokens?: number | null;
   211	        cache_write_tokens?: number | null;
   212	        cache_creation_input_tokens?: number | null;
   213	        audio_tokens?: number | null;
   214	        image_tokens?: number | null;
   215	        video_tokens?: number | null;
   216	    } | null;
   217	    cached_input_tokens?: number | null;
   218	    cache_read_input_tokens?: number | null;
   219	    cache_creation_input_tokens?: number | null;
   220	    reasoning_tokens?: number | null;
   221	    completion_tokens_details?: {
   222	        reasoning_tokens?: number | null;
   223	        audio_tokens?: number | null;
   224	        image_tokens?: number | null;
   225	        accepted_prediction_tokens?: number | null;
   226	        rejected_prediction_tokens?: number | null;
   227	    } | null;
   228	}): Usage {
   229	    const promptCachedTokens =
   230	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ||
   231	        openaiUsage.cached_input_tokens ||
   232	        openaiUsage.cache_read_input_tokens ||
   233	        0;
   234	    const promptCacheWriteTokens =
   235	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_write_tokens ??
   236	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_creation_input_tokens ??
   237	        openaiUsage.cache_creation_input_tokens ??
   238	        0;
   239	    const promptDetails = [
   240	        promptCachedTokens,
   241	        promptCacheWriteTokens,
   242	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.audio_tokens || 0,
   243	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.image_tokens || 0,
   244	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.video_tokens || 0,
   245	    ];
   246	
   247	    const rawCompletionReasoningTokens =
   248	        openaiUsage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens ||
   249	        openaiUsage.reasoning_tokens ||
   250	        0;
   251	    const completionDetails = [
   252	        openaiUsage.completion_tokens_details?.accepted_prediction_tokens || 0,
   253	        openaiUsage.completion_tokens_details?.rejected_prediction_tokens || 0,
   254	        openaiUsage.completion_tokens_details?.audio_tokens || 0,
   255	        openaiUsage.completion_tokens_details?.image_tokens || 0,
   256	        rawCompletionReasoningTokens,
   257	    ];
   258	
   259	    const promptDetailTokens = sumTokens(promptDetails);
   260	    const completionDetailTokens = sumTokens(completionDetails);
   261	    const { promptDetailsAreAdditive, completionDetailsAreAdditive } =
   262	        detectUsageConvention(
   263	            openaiUsage,
   264	            promptDetailTokens,
   265	            completionDetailTokens,
   266	            rawCompletionReasoningTokens,
   267	        );
   268	
   269	    const cappedPromptDetails = promptDetailsAreAdditive
   270	        ? promptDetails
   271	        : capDetailsToTotal(openaiUsage.prompt_tokens, promptDetails);
   272	    const cappedCompletionDetails = completionDetailsAreAdditive
   273	        ? completionDetails
   274	        : capDetailsToTotal(openaiUsage.completion_tokens, completionDetails);
   275	
   276	    const promptTextTokens = promptDetailsAreAdditive
   277	        ? openaiUsage.prompt_tokens
   278	        : openaiUsage.prompt_tokens - sumTokens(cappedPromptDetails);
   279	
   280	    const completionTextTokens = completionDetailsAreAdditive
   281	        ? openaiUsage.completion_tokens
   282	        : openaiUsage.completion_tokens - sumTokens(cappedCompletionDetails);
   283	
   284	    const [
   285	        cappedPromptCachedTokens,
   286	        cappedPromptCacheWriteTokens,
   287	        promptAudioTokens,
   288	        promptImageTokens,
   289	        promptVideoTokens,
   290	    ] = cappedPromptDetails;
   291	    const [
   292	        ,
   293	        ,
   294	        completionAudioTokens,
   295	        completionImageTokens,
   296	        completionReasoningTokens,
   297	    ] = cappedCompletionDetails;
   298	
   299	    return {
   300	        promptTextTokens,
   301	        promptCachedTokens: cappedPromptCachedTokens,
   302	        promptCacheWriteTokens: cappedPromptCacheWriteTokens,
   303	        promptAudioTokens,
   304	        promptImageTokens,
   305	        promptVideoTokens,
   306	        completionTextTokens,
   307	        completionAudioTokens,
   308	        completionImageTokens,
   309	        completionReasoningTokens,
   310	    };
   311	}

   351	function isTokenCount(value: unknown): value is number {
   352	    return (
   353	        typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0
   354	    );
   355	}
   356	
   357	function sumTokens(tokens: readonly number[]): number {
   358	    return tokens.reduce((sum, token) => sum + token, 0);
   359	}
   360	
   361	function capDetailsToTotal(totalTokens: number, details: number[]): number[] {
   362	    let remaining = totalTokens;
   363	    return details.map((token) => {
   364	        const capped = Math.min(token, remaining);
   365	        remaining -= capped;
   366	        return capped;
   367	    });
   368	}
   369	
   370	function detectUsageConvention(
   371	    openaiUsage: {
   372	        prompt_tokens: number;
   373	        completion_tokens: number;
   374	        total_tokens: number;
   375	    },
   376	    promptDetailTokens: number,
   377	    completionDetailTokens: number,
   378	    completionReasoningTokens: number,
   379	): {
   380	    promptDetailsAreAdditive: boolean;
   381	    completionDetailsAreAdditive: boolean;
   382	} {
   383	    const topLevelTotal =
   384	        openaiUsage.prompt_tokens + openaiUsage.completion_tokens;
   385	    const additiveDetails = openaiUsage.total_tokens - topLevelTotal;
   386	
   387	    if (additiveDetails <= 0) {
   388	        return {
   389	            promptDetailsAreAdditive: false,
   390	            completionDetailsAreAdditive: false,
   391	        };
   392	    }
   393	
   394	    if (additiveDetails === promptDetailTokens + completionDetailTokens) {
   395	        return {
   396	            promptDetailsAreAdditive: promptDetailTokens > 0,
   397	            completionDetailsAreAdditive: completionDetailTokens > 0,
   398	        };
   399	    }
   400	
   401	    // Known additive Grok/xAI rows expose the extra total as reasoning tokens.
   402	    if (
   403	        completionReasoningTokens > 0 &&
   404	        additiveDetails === completionReasoningTokens
   405	    ) {
   406	        return {
   407	            promptDetailsAreAdditive: false,
   408	            completionDetailsAreAdditive: true,
   409	        };
   410	    }
   411	
   412	    const promptOnly =
   413	        additiveDetails === promptDetailTokens &&
   414	        promptDetailTokens !== completionDetailTokens;
   415	    const completionOnly =
   416	        additiveDetails === completionDetailTokens &&
   417	        promptDetailTokens !== completionDetailTokens;
   418	
   419	    return {
   420	        promptDetailsAreAdditive: promptOnly,
   421	        completionDetailsAreAdditive: completionOnly,
   422	    };
   423	}
   424	
   425	/**
   426	 * Build usage tracking headers from Usage object
   427	 * Returns headers with x-usage-* prefix for all non-zero usage types
   428	 */
   429	export function buildUsageHeaders(
   430	    modelUsed: string,
   431	    usage?: Usage,
   432	): Record<string, string> {
   433	    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
   434	        [MODEL_USED_HEADER]: modelUsed,
   435	    };
   436	
   437	    if (!usage) {
   438	        headers[USAGE_MISSING_HEADER] = "true";
   439	        return headers;
   440	    }
   441	
   442	    for (const [usageType, headerName] of Object.entries(USAGE_TYPE_HEADERS)) {
   443	        const value = usage[usageType as UsageType];
   444	        if (value && value > 0) {
   445	            headers[headerName] = String(value);
   446	        }
   447	    }
   448	
   449	    return headers;
   450	}
   451	
   452	/**
   453	 * Parse usage headers back to Usage object
   454	 */
   455	export function parseUsageHeaders(
   456	    headers: Headers | Record<string, string>,
   457	): Usage {
   458	    const usage: Usage = {};
   459	
   460	    const getHeader = (name: string) =>
   461	        headers instanceof Headers ? headers.get(name) : headers[name];
   462	
   463	    for (const [usageType, headerName] of Object.entries(USAGE_TYPE_HEADERS)) {
   464	        const value = getHeader(headerName);
   465	        if (value) {
   466	            // buildUsageHeaders writes String(number), and Number() is its
   467	            // exact inverse: integer token counts and fractional units
   468	            // (seconds, megapixels) parse alike.
   469	            usage[usageType as UsageType] = Number(value);
   470	        }
   471	    }
   472	
   473	    return usage;
   474	}

===== shared/response-bytes.ts =====
     1	/**
     2	 * Read a response body without ever buffering more than `maxBytes`.
     3	 *
     4	 * Content-Length is checked before streaming, then the running byte count is
     5	 * checked while reading because the header can be absent or incorrect.
     6	 */
     7	export async function readResponseBytes(
     8	    response: Response,
     9	    maxBytes: number,
    10	    tooLarge: (total: number) => Error,
    11	): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
    12	    const contentLength = response.headers.get("content-length");
    13	    if (contentLength) {
    14	        const declaredSize = Number.parseInt(contentLength, 10);
    15	        if (Number.isFinite(declaredSize) && declaredSize > maxBytes) {
    16	            throw tooLarge(declaredSize);
    17	        }
    18	    }
    19	
    20	    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
    21	    if (!reader) {
    22	        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
    23	        if (arrayBuffer.byteLength > maxBytes) {
    24	            throw tooLarge(arrayBuffer.byteLength);
    25	        }
    26	        return new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);
    27	    }
    28	
    29	    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    30	    let total = 0;
    31	    try {
    32	        while (true) {
    33	            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    34	            if (done) break;
    35	            total += value.byteLength;
    36	            if (total > maxBytes) throw tooLarge(total);
    37	            chunks.push(value);
    38	        }
    39	    } finally {
    40	        reader.releaseLock();
    41	    }
    42	
    43	    const bytes = new Uint8Array(total);
    44	    let offset = 0;
    45	    for (const chunk of chunks) {
    46	        bytes.set(chunk, offset);
    47	        offset += chunk.byteLength;
    48	    }
    49	    return bytes;
    50	}
    51	
    52	/** Read a bounded response as UTF-8 text without buffering an untrusted body. */
    53	export async function readResponseText(
    54	    response: Response,
    55	    maxBytes: number,
    56	    tooLarge: (total: number) => Error,
    57	): Promise<string> {
    58	    const bytes = await readResponseBytes(response, maxBytes, tooLarge);
    59	    return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
    60	}
===== shared/schemas/decisions.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * Decisions API schemas.
     5	 *
     6	 * OpenAI defines no typed-decision endpoint, so the wire contract follows the
     7	 * published OpenRouter one (`openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions`, verified
     8	 * against the live route on 2026-09-20): the request body is the provider's
     9	 * native shape and the response returns `answers` plus token usage.
    10	 */
    11	
    12	/** The only decision model today; callers may omit `model` entirely. */
    13	export const DEFAULT_DECISION_MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.14";
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * State, instructions, and criteria all accept any JSON the caller wants to
    17	 * hand the model — a sentence, a record, or a list of records — so none of
    18	 * them is narrowed to a string.
    19	 */
    20	const DecisionContentSchema = z.union([
    21	    z.string(),
    22	    z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),
    23	    z.array(z.unknown()),
    24	]);
    25	
    26	const ChoiceQuestionSchema = z.object({
    27	    type: z.literal("choice"),
    28	    instructions: DecisionContentSchema.meta({
    29	        description: "What to decide.",
    30	        example: "Which team should handle this?",
    31	    }),
    32	    criteria: z.record(z.string(), DecisionContentSchema.nullable()).meta({
    33	        description:
    34	            "Selectable options mapped to what each one means. The answer returns one of these keys.",
    35	        example: {
    36	            billing: "Payment issues",
    37	            technical: "Product failures",
    38	        },
    39	    }),
    40	});
    41	
    42	const ScoreQuestionSchema = z.object({
    43	    type: z.literal("score"),
    44	    instructions: DecisionContentSchema.meta({
    45	        description: "What to rate.",
    46	        example: "How urgent is follow-up?",
    47	    }),
    48	    criteria: z
    49	        .array(DecisionContentSchema)
    50	        .min(2)
    51	        .meta({
    52	            description:
    53	                "Ordered rungs from lowest to highest. The answer's score is a position on this scale, and its legend maps each index back to the rung.",
    54	            example: ["none", "low", "medium", "high"],
    55	        }),
    56	});
    57	
    58	const NoulQuestionSchema = z.object({
    59	    type: z.literal("noul"),
    60	    instructions: DecisionContentSchema.meta({
    61	        description: "The yes/no proposition to evaluate.",
    62	        example: "Does this convey urgency?",
    63	    }),
    64	    criteria: z
    65	        .object({
    66	            true: DecisionContentSchema.optional(),
    67	            false: DecisionContentSchema.optional(),
    68	        })
    69	        .optional()
    70	        .meta({
    71	            description:
    72	                "Optional descriptions of what true and false mean for this proposition.",
    73	        }),
    74	});
    75	
    76	const DecisionQuestionSchema = z
    77	    .discriminatedUnion("type", [
    78	        ChoiceQuestionSchema,
    79	        ScoreQuestionSchema,
    80	        NoulQuestionSchema,
    81	    ])
    82	    .meta({
    83	        description:
    84	            "A `choice` between named options, a `score` on an ordered scale, or a `noul` probability for a yes/no proposition.",
    85	    });
    86	
    87	export const CreateDecisionRequestSchema = z.object({
    88	    model: z.string().optional().meta({
    89	        description:
    90	            "Decision model to use. Defaults to `jev`. See the `/models` endpoint for models that list `/alpha/decisions` in `supported_endpoints`.",
    91	        example: "jev",
    92	    }),
    93	    state: DecisionContentSchema.meta({
    94	        description:
    95	            "The facts to decide on. Confidence can stay high when facts are missing, so supply what is relevant rather than everything.",
    96	        example: "My payouts have been failing for 3 days.",
    97	    }),
    98	    questions: z
    99	        .record(z.string(), DecisionQuestionSchema)
   100	        .refine((questions) => Object.keys(questions).length > 0, {
   101	            message: "questions must contain at least one question",
   102	        })
   103	        .meta({
   104	            description:
   105	                "Questions to answer about the state, keyed by a name you choose. Each question is evaluated independently and answered under the same key.",
   106	        }),
   107	});
   108	
   109	export type CreateDecisionRequest = z.infer<typeof CreateDecisionRequestSchema>;
   110	
   111	const ChoiceAnswerSchema = z.object({
   112	    type: z.literal("choice"),
   113	    choice: z.string().meta({
   114	        description: "The selected criteria key.",
   115	    }),
   116	    probabilities: z.record(z.string(), z.number()).meta({
   117	        description: "Probability assigned to each option.",
   118	    }),
   119	    confidence: z.number(),
   120	});
   121	
   122	const ScoreAnswerSchema = z.object({
   123	    type: z.literal("score"),
   124	    score: z.number().meta({
   125	        description:
   126	            "Position on the criteria scale. Fractional: 2.72 sits between the rungs at index 2 and 3.",
   127	    }),
   128	    legend: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).meta({
   129	        description:
   130	            "Maps each scale index back to its criteria entry. Read it before interpreting the score.",
   131	    }),
   132	    probabilities: z.record(z.string(), z.number()),
   133	    confidence: z.number(),
   134	});
   135	
   136	const NoulAnswerSchema = z.object({
   137	    type: z.literal("noul"),
   138	    noul: z.number().meta({
   139	        description: "Probability that the proposition is true, 0 to 1.",
   140	    }),
   141	});
   142	
   143	/**
   144	 * Response schemas document the API. The adapter forwards native answers
   145	 * without parsing them, preserving any extra fields added by the provider.
   146	 */
   147	const DecisionAnswerSchema = z
   148	    .union([ChoiceAnswerSchema, ScoreAnswerSchema, NoulAnswerSchema])
   149	    .meta({
   150	        description:
   151	            "Answer for one question, matching the question's type. Score answers carry a legend; choice and score answers carry per-option probabilities and a confidence.",
   152	    });
   153	
   154	export const CreateDecisionResponseSchema = z.object({

   161	        example: "TypeSafe",
   162	    }),

   166	    usage: z

   169	            output_tokens: z.number(),

   171	        .meta({

   173	                "Token usage for the decision. Jev bills input tokens only.",
   174	        }),
   175	});

    24	    parentRequestId?: string;

    99	     * About grain, not about fallback. This table used to be exactly one row per

   213	    // biome-ignore format: custom formatting

   221	            priceDefinition?.promptCacheWriteTokens || 0,

   225	            priceDefinition?.promptAudioSeconds || 0,
   226	        tokenPricePromptVideoSeconds:
   227	            priceDefinition?.promptVideoSeconds || 0,
   228	        tokenPricePromptImage:
   229	            priceDefinition?.promptImageTokens || 0,
   230	        tokenPricePromptVideo:
   231	            priceDefinition?.promptVideoTokens || 0,
   232	        tokenPriceCompletionText:
   233	            priceDefinition?.completionTextTokens || 0,
   234	        tokenPriceCompletionReasoning:
   235	            priceDefinition?.completionReasoningTokens ??
   236	            priceDefinition?.completionTextTokens ??
   237	            0,
   238	        tokenPriceCompletionAudio:
   239	            priceDefinition?.completionAudioTokens || 0,
   240	        tokenPriceCompletionAudioSeconds:
   241	            priceDefinition?.completionAudioSeconds || 0,
   242	        tokenPriceCompletionImage:
   243	            priceDefinition?.completionImageTokens || 0,
   244	        tokenPriceCompletionVideoSeconds:
   245	            priceDefinition?.completionVideoSeconds || 0,

   213	const ChatCompletionMessageToolCallSchema = z
   214	    .object({
   215	        id: z.string(),
   216	        type: z.literal("function"),
   217	        function: z.object({
   218	            name: z.string(),
   219	            arguments: z.string(),
   220	            thought_signature: z.string().optional(),
   221	        }),
   222	        // Google's OpenAI-compatible field for the same Gemini signature.
   223	        // Malformed values are dropped so they never fail a request or a
   224	        // provider response parsed with this schema.
   225	        extra_content: z
   226	            .object({
   227	                google: z
   228	                    .object({ thought_signature: z.string().optional() })
   229	                    .optional(),
   230	            })
   231	            .nullish()
   232	            .catch(undefined),
   233	    })
   234	    .transform(({ extra_content, ...call }) => {
   235	        const thought_signature =
   236	            call.function.thought_signature ??
   237	            extra_content?.google?.thought_signature;
   238	        return thought_signature
   239	            ? { ...call, function: { ...call.function, thought_signature } }
   240	            : call;
   241	    });

   563	export const CreateResponseResponseSchema = z
   564	    .object({
   565	        id: z.string(),
   566	        object: z.literal("response"),
   567	        created_at: z.number().int().optional(),
   568	        model: z.string(),
   569	        status: z.enum([
   570	            "completed",
   571	            "failed",
   572	            "in_progress",
   573	            "cancelled",
   574	            "queued",
   575	            "incomplete",
   576	        ]),
   577	        output: z.array(z.object({ type: z.string() }).passthrough()),
   578	        usage: ResponseUsageSchema.nullable(),
   579	    })
   580	    .passthrough()
   581	    .superRefine((response, context) => {
   582	        if (
   583	            (response.status === "completed" ||
   584	                response.status === "incomplete") &&
   585	            response.usage === null
   586	        ) {
   587	            context.addIssue({
   588	                code: "custom",
   589	                path: ["usage"],
   590	                message: "Successful Responses must include valid usage",
   591	            });
   592	        }
   593	    })
   594	    .meta({ $id: "CreateResponseResponse" });

===== shared/schemas/response-function-items.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	
     3	const ItemStatusSchema = z.enum(["in_progress", "completed", "incomplete"]);
     4	
     5	export const ResponseFunctionCallSchema = z.object({
     6	    type: z.literal("function_call"),
     7	    id: z.string().min(1).optional(),
     8	    call_id: z.string().min(1),
     9	    name: z.string().min(1),
    10	    arguments: z.string(),
    11	    status: ItemStatusSchema.optional(),
    12	});
    13	
    14	// Tool output is a string or content parts, as in the OpenAI Responses API.
    15	// Non-text parts (input_image, input_file) are accepted but carry no text.
    16	const FunctionOutputPartSchema = z.union([
    17	    z.object({ type: z.literal("input_text"), text: z.string() }),
    18	    z.object({ type: z.string() }).loose(),
    19	]);
    20	
    21	export const ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema = z.object({
    22	    type: z.literal("function_call_output"),
    23	    id: z.string().min(1).optional(),
    24	    call_id: z.string().min(1),
    25	    output: z.union([z.string(), z.array(FunctionOutputPartSchema)]),
    26	    status: ItemStatusSchema.optional(),
    27	});
    28	
    29	export function functionOutputText(
    30	    output: z.infer<typeof ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema>["output"],
    31	): string {
    32	    if (typeof output === "string") return output;
    33	    return output
    34	        .map((part) => (part.type === "input_text" ? String(part.text) : ""))
    35	        .join("");
    36	}
    37	
    38	export type ResponseFunctionCall = z.infer<typeof ResponseFunctionCallSchema>;
    39	export type ResponseFunctionCallOutput = z.infer<
    40	    typeof ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema
    41	>;
    42	
    43	/** A returned result means the server, not the Chat client, executed the call. */
    44	export function completedFunctionCalls(output: Record<string, unknown>[]) {
    45	    const calls = new Map<string, ResponseFunctionCall>();
    46	    const results = new Map<string, ResponseFunctionCallOutput>();
    47	    for (const item of output) {
    48	        if (item.type === "function_call") {
    49	            const call = ResponseFunctionCallSchema.parse(item);
    50	            if (calls.has(call.call_id))
    51	                throw new Error("Duplicate function call");
    52	            calls.set(call.call_id, call);
    53	        } else if (item.type === "function_call_output") {
    54	            const result = ResponseFunctionCallOutputSchema.parse(item);
    55	            if (result.status && result.status !== "completed")
    56	                throw new Error("Incomplete function result");
    57	            if (results.has(result.call_id))
    58	                throw new Error("Duplicate function result");
    59	            results.set(result.call_id, result);
    60	        }
    61	    }
    62	    for (const callId of results.keys()) {
    63	        const call = calls.get(callId);
    64	        if (!call || (call.status && call.status !== "completed"))
    65	            throw new Error("Function result has no completed matching call");
    66	    }
    67	    return { calls, results };
    68	}
===== shared/schemas/safety.ts =====
     1	import { z } from "zod";
     2	
     3	export const SAFETY_FEATURES = [
     4	    "privacy",
     5	    "secrets",
     6	    "sexual",
     7	    "violence",
     8	    "shield",
     9	] as const;
    10	
    11	export type SafetyFeature = (typeof SAFETY_FEATURES)[number];
    12	export type SafeValue = string | boolean | undefined | null;
    13	export const SAFETY_HEADER_NAME = "Pollinations-Safe";
    14	export const HARMFUL_CONTENT_SAFETY_FEATURES = [
    15	    "sexual",
    16	    "violence",
    17	] as const satisfies readonly SafetyFeature[];
    18	
    19	const SAFETY_ALIASES: Record<string, SafetyFeature[]> = {
    20	    true: ["privacy", "secrets"],
    21	    nsfw: [...HARMFUL_CONTENT_SAFETY_FEATURES],
    22	};
    23	
    24	const DISABLED_SAFE_TOKENS = new Set(["false", "0"]);
    25	
    26	export const VALID_SAFE_TOKENS = new Set([
    27	    ...SAFETY_FEATURES,
    28	    ...Object.keys(SAFETY_ALIASES),
    29	    ...DISABLED_SAFE_TOKENS,
    30	]);
    31	
    32	const SAFE_DESCRIPTION =
    33	    "Safety features: comma-separated list of " +
    34	    [...SAFETY_FEATURES, ...Object.keys(SAFETY_ALIASES)].join(", ") +
    35	    `. true enables privacy,secrets; nsfw enables sexual,violence. Also accepted in the ${SAFETY_HEADER_NAME} header. Defaults to off; false and 0 are accepted as off.`;
    36	
    37	export function normalizeSafeValue(value: SafeValue): string | undefined {
    38	    if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "true" : "false";
    39	    if (value === null || value === undefined) return undefined;
    40	    return value;
    41	}
    42	
    43	export function invalidSafeTokens(value: SafeValue): string[] {
    44	    const normalized = normalizeSafeValue(value);
    45	    if (!normalized) return [];
    46	    return normalized
    47	        .split(",")
    48	        .map((part) => part.trim().toLowerCase())
    49	        .filter((part) => part.length > 0 && !VALID_SAFE_TOKENS.has(part));
    50	}
    51	
    52	export function parseSafeFeatures(value: SafeValue): Set<SafetyFeature> {
    53	    const normalized = normalizeSafeValue(value);
    54	    if (!normalized) return new Set();
    55	
    56	    const features = new Set<SafetyFeature>();
    57	    for (const part of normalized.split(",")) {
    58	        const token = part.trim().toLowerCase();
    59	        if (!VALID_SAFE_TOKENS.has(token)) continue;
    60	        if (DISABLED_SAFE_TOKENS.has(token)) continue;
    61	        for (const feature of SAFETY_ALIASES[token] ?? [
    62	            token as SafetyFeature,
    63	        ]) {
    64	            features.add(feature);
    65	        }
    66	    }
    67	    return features;
    68	}
    69	
    70	export const SafeSchema = z
    71	    .union([z.string(), z.boolean()])
    72	    .optional()
    73	    .transform((value) => normalizeSafeValue(value))
    74	    .refine((value) => invalidSafeTokens(value).length === 0, {
    75	        message: `Unknown safe feature. Valid: ${[...VALID_SAFE_TOKENS].join(", ")}`,
    76	    })
    77	    .meta({ description: SAFE_DESCRIPTION });
===== shared/secret-encryption.ts =====
     1	const VERSION = "v1";
     2	
     3	export async function encryptSecret(
     4	    plaintext: string,
     5	    secret: string,
     6	): Promise<string> {
     7	    const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
     8	    const key = await deriveKey(secret);
     9	    const ciphertext = new Uint8Array(
    10	        await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    11	            { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
    12	            key,
    13	            new TextEncoder().encode(plaintext),
    14	        ),
    15	    );
    16	    return `${VERSION}:${bytesToBase64(iv)}:${bytesToBase64(ciphertext)}`;
    17	}
    18	
    19	export async function decryptSecret(
    20	    encrypted: string,
    21	    secret: string,
    22	): Promise<string> {
    23	    const [version, ivBase64, ciphertextBase64] = encrypted.split(":");
    24	    if (version !== VERSION || !ivBase64 || !ciphertextBase64) {
    25	        throw new Error("Unsupported encrypted secret format");
    26	    }
    27	    const key = await deriveKey(secret);
    28	    const plaintext = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
    29	        { name: "AES-GCM", iv: base64ToBytes(ivBase64) },
    30	        key,
    31	        base64ToBytes(ciphertextBase64),
    32	    );
    33	    return new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext);
    34	}
    35	
    36	async function deriveKey(secret: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    37	    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    38	        "SHA-256",
    39	        new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    40	    );
    41	    return crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", digest, "AES-GCM", false, [
    42	        "encrypt",
    43	        "decrypt",
    44	    ]);
    45	}
    46	
    47	function bytesToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    48	    let binary = "";
    49	    for (const byte of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);
    50	    return btoa(binary);
    51	}
    52	
    53	function base64ToBytes(value: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
    54	    const binary = atob(value);
    55	    const bytes = new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(binary.length));
    56	    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i += 1) {
    57	        bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    58	    }
    59	    return bytes;
    60	}
===== shared/secret-equal.ts =====
     1	const encoder = new TextEncoder();
     2	
     3	const digest = async (value: string) =>
     4	    new Uint8Array(
     5	        await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", encoder.encode(value)),
     6	    );
     7	
     8	/**
     9	 * Compare a presented secret with the expected one in constant time. Hashing
    10	 * first gives equal-length inputs, so neither content nor length leaks.
    11	 */
    12	export async function secretEquals(
    13	    presented: string,
    14	    expected: string,
    15	): Promise<boolean> {
    16	    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([digest(presented), digest(expected)]);
    17	    let mismatch = 0;
    18	    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) mismatch |= a[i] ^ b[i];
    19	    return mismatch === 0;
    20	}

===== shared/test/mocks/fetch.ts =====
     1	import { getLogger } from "@logtape/logtape";
     2	import type { Hono } from "hono";
     3	import { vi } from "vitest";
     4	
     5	const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
     6	const activeRequests = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
     7	
     8	export type MockMap = {
     9	    [name: string]: MockAPI<unknown>;
    10	};
    11	export type MockHandler = (request: Request) => Promise<Response>;
    12	export type MockHandlerMap = { [hostname: string]: MockHandler };
    13	
    14	export type MockAPI<TState> = {
    15	    state: TState;
    16	    handlerMap: MockHandlerMap;
    17	    reset: () => void;
    18	};
    19	
    20	export function createHonoMockHandler(handler: Hono): MockHandler {
    21	    return async (request: Request) => {
    22	        const url = new URL(request.url);
    23	        // trim trailing slashes
    24	        url.pathname = url.pathname.endsWith("/")
    25	            ? url.pathname.slice(0, -1)
    26	            : url.pathname;
    27	        const mockRequest = new Request(url, {
    28	            method: request.method,
    29	            headers: request.headers,
    30	            body: request.body,
    31	        });
    32	        return await handler.fetch(mockRequest);
    33	    };
    34	}
    35	
    36	type FetchMockOptions = {
    37	    logRequests?: boolean;
    38	};
    39	
    40	export function createFetchMock<TMocks extends MockMap>(
    41	    mocks: TMocks,
    42	    options?: FetchMockOptions,
    43	) {
    44	    const log = getLogger(["test", "mock", "fetch"]);
    45	    const opts = options ?? {};
    46	    let handlers: MockHandlerMap = {};
    47	
    48	    globalThis.fetch = vi
    49	        .fn()
    50	        .mockImplementation(
    51	            async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
    52	                let url: URL;
    53	                let request: Request;
    54	
    55	                if (input instanceof Request) {
    56	                    request = input;
    57	                    url = new URL(request.url);
    58	                } else {
    59	                    url = typeof input === "string" ? new URL(input) : input;
    60	                    request = new Request(url, init);
    61	                }
    62	                if (opts.logRequests) {
    63	                    log.debug(`${request.method} ${request.url}`);
    64	                }
    65	
    66	                const handler = handlers[url.host];
    67	                const responsePromise = handler
    68	                    ? handler(request)
    69	                    : originalFetch(request);
    70	                activeRequests.add(responsePromise);
    71	
    72	                const response = await responsePromise;
    73	                activeRequests.delete(responsePromise);
    74	
    75	                return response;
    76	            },
    77	        );
    78	
    79	    const enable = async (...names: (keyof TMocks)[]) => {
    80	        await clear();
    81	        for (const name of names) {
    82	            const mock = mocks[name];
    83	            handlers = {
    84	                ...handlers,
    85	                ...mock.handlerMap,
    86	            };
    87	        }
    88	    };
    89	
    90	    const clear = async () => {
    91	        await Promise.allSettled(Array.from(activeRequests));
    92	        activeRequests.clear();
    93	        handlers = {};
    94	    };
    95	
    96	    return {
    97	        enable,
    98	        clear,
    99	        ...mocks,
   100	    };
   101	}
   102	
   103	export async function teardownFetchMock() {
   104	    // Wait for active requests to complete
   105	    await Promise.allSettled(Array.from(activeRequests));
   106	    activeRequests.clear();
   107	
   108	    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
   109	    vi.restoreAllMocks();
   110	}

     1	export type StoredR2Object = {
     2	    body: Uint8Array;
     3	    httpMetadata?: R2HTTPMetadata;
     4	    customMetadata?: Record<string, string>;
     5	    storageClass?: R2Object["storageClass"];
     6	    uploaded: Date;

     8	
     9	export type TestR2Bucket = R2Bucket & {
    10	    getObject(key: string): StoredR2Object | undefined;
    11	    readonly putCount: number;
    12	};
    13	
    14	export function createTestR2Bucket(): TestR2Bucket {
    15	    const objects = new Map<string, StoredR2Object>();
    16	    let putCount = 0;
    17	    let uploadTime = 0;
    18	
    19	    function createR2Object(key: string, object: StoredR2Object): R2Object {
    20	        return {
    21	            key,
    22	            version: "test",
    23	            size: object.body.byteLength,
    24	            etag: "test",
    25	            httpEtag: '"test"',
    26	            uploaded: object.uploaded,
    27	            httpMetadata: object.httpMetadata,
    28	            customMetadata: object.customMetadata,
    29	            storageClass: object.storageClass,
    30	            checksums: {},
    31	        } as unknown as R2Object;
    32	    }
    33	
    34	    return {
    35	        head: async (key: string) => {
    36	            const object = objects.get(key);
    37	            return object ? createR2Object(key, object) : null;
    38	        },
    39	        get: async (key: string) => {
    40	            const object = objects.get(key);
    41	            if (!object) return null;
    42	            return {
    43	                ...createR2Object(key, object),
    44	                body: new Response(object.body.slice()).body,
    45	            };
    46	        },
    47	        put: async (key: string, value: BodyInit, options?: R2PutOptions) => {
    48	            const httpMetadata =
    49	                options?.httpMetadata instanceof Headers
    50	                    ? undefined
    51	                    : options?.httpMetadata;
    52	
    53	            putCount += 1;
    54	            uploadTime += 1;
    55	            objects.set(key, {
    56	                body: new Uint8Array(await new Response(value).arrayBuffer()),
    57	                httpMetadata,
    58	                customMetadata: options?.customMetadata,
    59	                storageClass: options?.storageClass,
    60	                uploaded: new Date(uploadTime),
    61	            });
    62	            return null;
    63	        },
    64	        getObject: (key: string) => objects.get(key),
    65	        get putCount() {
    66	            return putCount;
    67	        },
    68	    } as unknown as TestR2Bucket;
    69	}
===== shared/test/mocks/snapshot-server.ts =====
     1	import fs from "node:fs/promises";
     2	import path from "node:path";
     3	import { serve } from "@hono/node-server";
     4	import { getLogger } from "@logtape/logtape";
     5	import { Hono } from "hono";
     6	import type { TestProject } from "vitest/node";
     7	
     8	const log = getLogger(["test", "mock", "vcr", "storage"]);
     9	
    10	type SnapshotServerOptions = {
    11	    snapshotsDir?: string;
    12	    port?: number;
    13	};
    14	
    15	export function createSnapshotServerSetup(options: SnapshotServerOptions = {}) {
    16	    const snapshotsDir =
    17	        options.snapshotsDir ??
    18	        path.join(process.cwd(), "test", "mocks", "snapshots");
    19	    const port = options.port ?? 3210;
    20	    let server: ReturnType<typeof serve> | null = null;
    21	
    22	    return {
    23	        setup: async ({ provide }: TestProject) => {
    24	            await fs.mkdir(snapshotsDir, { recursive: true });
    25	
    26	            const vcrStorageServer = new Hono()
    27	                .get("/:filename", async (c) => {
    28	                    try {
    29	                        const filename = c.req.param("filename");
    30	                        const filePath = path.join(snapshotsDir, filename);
    31	                        const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
    32	                        return c.json(JSON.parse(content));
    33	                    } catch (error) {
    34	                        if (
    35	                            (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT"
    36	                        ) {
    37	                            return c.json({ error: "Snapshot not found" }, 404);
    38	                        }
    39	                        return c.json(
    40	                            { error: "Failed to read snapshot" },
    41	                            500,
    42	                        );
    43	                    }
    44	                })
    45	                .put("/:filename", async (c) => {
    46	                    try {
    47	                        const filename = c.req.param("filename");
    48	                        const filePath = path.join(snapshotsDir, filename);
    49	                        const data = await c.req.json();
    50	                        await fs.writeFile(
    51	                            filePath,
    52	                            JSON.stringify(data, null, 2),
    53	                            "utf-8",
    54	                        );
    55	                        return c.json({ success: true }, 200);
    56	                    } catch {
    57	                        return c.json(
    58	                            { error: "Failed to write snapshot" },
    59	                            500,
    60	                        );
    61	                    }
    62	                });
    63	
    64	            server = serve({
    65	                fetch: vcrStorageServer.fetch,
    66	                port,
    67	            });
    68	
    69	            log.info(`VCR storage server started on http://localhost:${port}`);
    70	            provide("snapshotServerUrl", `http://localhost:${port}`);
    71	        },
    72	        teardown: async () => {
    73	            if (server) {
    74	                log.info("Shutting down VCR storage server...");
    75	                server.close();
    76	                server = null;
    77	            }
    78	        },
    79	    };
    80	}

    84	        snapshotServerUrl: string;
    85	    }

   155	        "api.europe-west2.gcp.tinybird.co": createHonoMockHandler(tinybirdAPI),
   156	    };
   157	
   158	    const reset = () => {
   159	        state.events = [];
   160	        state.errorEvents = [];
   161	        state.referralEvents = [];
   162	        state.productEvents = [];
   163	        state.stripeEvents = [];
   164	        state.dailyResponse = [];
   165	        state.usageResponse = [];
   166	        state.earningsResponse = [];
   167	        state.earningsTransactionsResponse = [];
   168	        state.appDirectoryResponse = [];
   169	        state.appUsageResponse = [];
   170	        state.modelModalitiesResponse = [];
   171	        state.agentUsageResponse = [];
   172	        state.modelHealthResponse = [];
   173	        state.modelRunsResponse = [];
   174	        state.pipeCalls = [];
   175	    };
   176	
   177	    return { state, reset, handlerMap };
   178	}
   179	
   180	function parseNdjson<T>(input: string): T[] {
   181	    return input
   182	        .split("\n")
   183	        .filter((line) => line.trim().length > 0)
   184	        .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as T);
   185	}

    13	// Manual invalidation lever for model-request snapshots: bump when an
    14	// upstream model/deployment changes behind an unchanged public name and
    15	// provider, so stale recordings don't keep replaying.
    16	const MODEL_SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
    17	
    18	// Limit binary/stream snapshot bodies to 16KB to avoid multi-MB video snapshots.
    19	// Tests only need enough data to verify content-type and minimum size.
    20	const MAX_SNAPSHOT_BODY_BYTES = 16 * 1024;

    62	async function getSnapshotHash(request: Request): Promise<string> {
    63	    const hash = crypto.createHash("md5");
    64	    // Exclude authorization header — it changes per test run and doesn't affect
    65	    // backend response content. This allows VCR snapshots to be reused across runs.
    66	    hash.update(request.headers.get("content-type") || "");
    67	    hash.update(`${request.method}:${request.url}`);
    68	    try {
    69	        const text = await request.clone().text();
    70	        const body = JSON.parse(text || "{}");
    71	        hash.update(`${body.model}` || "");
    72	        hash.update(`${body.stream}` || "");
    73	        hash.update(`${body.tool_choice}` || "");
    74	        // Include the provider so snapshots auto-invalidate when a model
    75	        // migrates to a different backend (e.g. fireworks → azure). The
    76	        // registry no longer carries provider-facing model IDs, so a
    77	        // same-provider deployment change won't shift the hash on its own —
    78	        // bump MODEL_SNAPSHOT_VERSION to invalidate model snapshots manually.
    79	        try {
    80	            const modelName = resolveModelName(body.model);
    81	            const def = getRegistryModelDefinition(modelName);
    82	            hash.update(`${def.provider}:v${MODEL_SNAPSHOT_VERSION}`);
    83	        } catch {
    84	            // Unknown model — hash stays request-only
    85	        }
    86	        hash.update(`${JSON.stringify(body.messages)}`);
    87	        if (body.input) hash.update(`${JSON.stringify(body.input)}`);
    88	        if (body.dimensions) hash.update(`${body.dimensions}`);
    89	        if (body.task_type) hash.update(`${body.task_type}`);
    90	    } catch (error) {
    91	        log.warn("Failed to parse request body: {error}", { error });
    92	    }
    93	    return hash.digest("hex");
    94	}
    95	
    96	async function getSnapshotFilename(
    97	    hosts: { name: string; host: string }[],
    98	    request: Request,
    99	): Promise<string> {
   100	    const url = new URL(request.url);
   101	    const hash = await getSnapshotHash(request);
   102	
   103	    const matchingHost = hosts.find(({ host }) => host === url.host)?.name;
   104	
   105	    const host =
   106	        matchingHost ||
   107	        url.host
   108	            .toLowerCase()
   109	            .replace(/^www\./, "")
   110	            .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
   111	            .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
   112	
   113	    return `${host}-${hash}.json`;
   114	}

   116	async function getSnapshot(
   117	    snapshotServerUrl: string,
   118	    filename: string,
   119	): Promise<Snapshot> {
   120	    log.trace(`Reading snapshot: ${filename}`);
   121	    const response = await fetch(`${snapshotServerUrl}/${filename}`);
   122	    if (!response.ok) {
   123	        const { error } = (await response.json()) as { error: string };
   124	        throw new Error(`Error reading snapshot: ${error}`);
   125	    }
   126	    return await response.json();
   127	}

   129	async function writeSnapshot(
   130	    snapshotServerUrl: string,
   131	    filename: string,
   132	    snapshot: Snapshot,
   133	): Promise<void> {
   134	    log.trace(`Writing snapshot: ${filename}`);
   135	    const response = await fetch(`${snapshotServerUrl}/${filename}`, {
   136	        method: "PUT",
   137	        body: JSON.stringify(snapshot),
   138	    });
   139	    if (!response.ok) {
   140	        const data = (await response.json()) as { error?: string };
   141	        log.warning("Error writing snapshot: {error}", { error: data.error });
   142	    }

   145	export function createMockVcr({
   146	    originalFetch,
   147	    hosts,
   148	    snapshotServerUrl,
   149	    mode = "replay-or-record",
   150	}: CreateMockVcrOptions): MockAPI<{}> {
   151	    const vcr = new Hono()
   152	        .all("*", async (c) => {
   153	            const snapshotFilename = await getSnapshotFilename(
   154	                hosts,
   155	                c.req.raw,
   156	            );
   157	
   158	            if (mode !== "record-only") {
   159	                // Replay snapshot if it exists
   160	                try {
   161	                    const snapshot = await getSnapshot(
   162	                        snapshotServerUrl,
   163	                        snapshotFilename,
   164	                    );
   165	                    return replaySnapshotResponse(snapshot);
   166	                } catch {
   167	                    log.warn(`Missing snapshot: ${snapshotFilename}`);
   168	                }
   169	            }
   170	
   171	            if (mode !== "replay-only") {
   172	                // Record actual upstream response
   173	                log.trace(`Recording: ${c.req.method} ${c.req.url}`);
   174	                // Clone request before fetch since it will consume the body
   175	                const requestClone = c.req.raw.clone() as Request;
   176	                const response = await originalFetch(c.req.raw);
   177	                const responseClone = response.clone();
   178	                const snapshot = await recordSnapshot(
   179	                    requestClone,
   180	                    responseClone,
   181	                );
   182	                await writeSnapshot(
   183	                    snapshotServerUrl,
   184	                    snapshotFilename,
   185	                    snapshot,
   186	                );
   187	                return response;
   188	            }
   189	
   190	            expect.fail(
   191	                [
   192	                    "Encountered missing snapshot in replay-only mode.",
   193	                    "Run without TEST_VCR_MODE=replay-only to capture.",
   194	                ].join("\n"),
   195	            );
   196	        })
   197	        .onError((error) => {
   198	            throw error;
   199	        });

   202	        state: {},
   203	        handlerMap: Object.fromEntries(
   204	            hosts.map(({ host }) => [host, createHonoMockHandler(vcr)]),
   205	        ),
   206	        reset: () => {},
   207	    };
   208	}

   210	async function recordRequestBody(
   211	    request: Request,
   212	): Promise<RequestBodySnapshot> {
   213	    if (!request.body || ["GET", "HEAD"].includes(request.method)) {
   214	        return { type: "empty", data: null };
   215	    }
   216	    const contentType = request.headers.get("content-type") || "";
   217	    // json
   218	    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
   219	        const text = await request.text();
   220	        try {
   221	            return {
   222	                type: "json",
   223	                data: JSON.parse(text),
   224	            };
   225	        } catch {
   226	            return {
   227	                type: "text",
   228	                data: text,
   229	            };
   230	        }
   231	    }
   232	    // form data
   233	    if (
   234	        contentType.includes("multipart/form-data") ||
   235	        contentType.includes("application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
   236	    ) {
   237	        const formData = await request.formData();
   238	        return {
   239	            type: "formdata",
   240	            data: Object.fromEntries(formData.entries()),
   241	        };
   242	    }
   243	    // text
   244	    if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
   245	        return {
   246	            type: "text",
   247	            data: await request.text(),
   248	        };
   249	    }
   250	    const buffer = await request.arrayBuffer();
   251	    return {
   252	        type: "binary",
   253	        data: Buffer.from(buffer).toString("base64"),
   254	    };
   255	}
   256	
   257	async function recordResponseBody(
   258	    response: Response,
   259	): Promise<ResponseBodySnapshot> {
   260	    const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type");
   261	    const transferEncoding = response.headers.get("transfer-encoding");
   262	    // empty
   263	    if (!response.body) {
   264	        return { type: "empty", data: null };
   265	    }
   266	    // binary stream (video/octet-stream) — truncate to limit snapshot size
   267	    if (contentType?.includes("application/octet-stream")) {
   268	        const chunks = await recordChunks(
   269	            response.clone(),
   270	            MAX_SNAPSHOT_BODY_BYTES,
   271	        );
   272	        return {
   273	            type: "stream",
   274	            data: chunks,
   275	        };
   276	    }
   277	    // text stream (SSE, chunked) — record in full
   278	    if (
   279	        transferEncoding === "chunked" ||
   280	        contentType?.includes("text/event-stream")
   281	    ) {
   282	        const chunks = await recordChunks(response.clone());
   283	        return {
   284	            type: "stream",
   285	            data: chunks,
   286	        };
   287	    }
   288	    // json
   289	    if (contentType?.includes("application/json")) {
   290	        try {
   291	            return {
   292	                type: "json",
   293	                data: await response.json(),
   294	            };
   295	        } catch {
   296	            return {
   297	                type: "text",
   298	                data: await response.clone().text(),
   299	            };
   300	        }
   301	    }
   302	    // text
   303	    if (
   304	        contentType?.startsWith("text/") ||
   305	        contentType?.includes("application/xml") ||
   306	        contentType?.includes("application/javascript")
   307	    ) {
   308	        return {
   309	            type: "text",
   310	            data: await response.text(),
   311	        };
   312	    }
   313	    // binary — truncate to avoid multi-MB video/image snapshots
   314	    const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
   315	    const truncated =
   316	        buffer.byteLength > MAX_SNAPSHOT_BODY_BYTES
   317	            ? buffer.slice(0, MAX_SNAPSHOT_BODY_BYTES)
   318	            : buffer;
   319	    return {
   320	        type: "binary",
   321	        data: Buffer.from(truncated).toString("base64"),
   322	    };
   323	}
   324	
   325	async function recordChunks(
   326	    response: Response,
   327	    maxBytes?: number,
   328	): Promise<{ data: string; delay: number }[]> {
   329	    const chunks: { data: string; delay: number }[] = [];
   330	    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
   331	
   332	    if (!reader) {
   333	        return chunks;
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
   337	    let lastTimestamp = Date.now();
   338	    let totalBytes = 0;
   339	
   340	    try {
   341	        while (true) {
   342	            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
   343	            if (done) break;
   344	
   345	            const now = Date.now();
   346	            const delay = now - lastTimestamp;
   347	            lastTimestamp = now;
   348	
   349	            // When maxBytes is set, stop storing after limit (but drain the stream)
   350	            if (maxBytes != null && totalBytes >= maxBytes) {
   351	                continue;
   352	            }
   353	
   354	            let chunkValue = value;
   355	            if (maxBytes != null) {
   356	                const remaining = maxBytes - totalBytes;
   357	                if (value.byteLength > remaining) {
   358	                    chunkValue = value.slice(0, remaining);
   359	                }
   360	            }
   361	
   362	            chunks.push({
   363	                data: decoder.decode(chunkValue, { stream: true }),
   364	                delay,
   365	            });
   366	            totalBytes += value.byteLength;
   367	        }
   368	    } finally {
   369	        reader.releaseLock();
   370	    }
   371	
   372	    return chunks;
   373	}
   374	
   375	async function recordRequest(request: Request): Promise<RequestSnapshot> {
   376	    return {
   377	        url: request.url,
   378	        method: request.method,
   379	        body: await recordRequestBody(request),
   380	        params: { ...new URL(request.url).searchParams },
   381	    };
   382	}
   383	
   384	async function recordResponse(response: Response): Promise<ResponseSnapshot> {
   385	    return {
   386	        status: response.status,
   387	        statusText: response.statusText,
   388	        headers: Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries()),
   389	        body: await recordResponseBody(response),
   390	    };
   391	}
   392	
   393	async function recordSnapshot(
   394	    request: Request,
   395	    response: Response,
   396	): Promise<Snapshot> {
   397	    return {
   398	        request: await recordRequest(request),
   399	        response: await recordResponse(response),
   400	    };
   401	}
   402	
   403	function replayChunks(
   404	    snapshot: StreamSnapshot,
   405	    maxDelayMs: number = 10,
   406	): ReadableStream {
   407	    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
   408	    async function* streamGenerator(): AsyncGenerator<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
   409	        for (const chunk of snapshot) {
   410	            await new Promise((resolve) =>
   411	                setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(maxDelayMs, chunk.delay)),
   412	            );
   413	            yield encoder.encode(chunk.data);
   414	        }
   415	    }
   416	    // @ts-expect-error - ReadableStream.from is supported
   417	    return ReadableStream.from(streamGenerator());
   418	}
   419	
   420	function replayResponseBody(
   421	    snapshot: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof recordResponseBody>>,
   422	): BodyInit | null {
   423	    switch (snapshot.type) {
   424	        case "empty":
   425	            return null;
   426	
   427	        case "json":
   428	            return JSON.stringify(snapshot.data);
   429	
   430	        case "text":
   431	            return snapshot.data as string;
   432	
   433	        case "binary":
   434	            return Buffer.from(snapshot.data as string, "base64");
   435	
   436	        case "stream":
   437	            return replayChunks(snapshot.data as StreamSnapshot);
   438	    }
   439	}
   440	
   441	function replaySnapshotResponse(snapshot: Snapshot): Response {
   442	    const body = replayResponseBody(snapshot.response.body);
   443	    return new Response(body, {
   444	        status: snapshot.response.status,
   445	        statusText: snapshot.response.statusText,
   446	        headers: snapshot.response.headers,
   447	    });
   448	}
===== shared/test/reset-storage.ts =====
     1	import { beforeEach } from "vitest";
     2	
     3	type Storage = {
     4	    db?: D1Database;
     5	    kv?: KVNamespace[];
     6	    r2?: R2Bucket[];
     7	};
     8	
     9	type Table = { name: string; rows: Record<string, unknown>[] };
    10	
    11	const TABLES_SQL =
    12	    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite\\_%' ESCAPE '\\' AND name NOT LIKE '\\_cf\\_%' ESCAPE '\\' AND name <> 'd1_migrations'";
    13	
    14	/**
    15	 * `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` isolates storage per test file, not per test.
    16	 * The state the first test of a file starts from (after migrations and any
    17	 * `beforeAll` seeding) is restored before every later test: D1 rows are put
    18	 * back, and KV keys and R2 objects added since are deleted.
    19	 */
    20	export function resetStorageBeforeEach({ db, kv = [], r2 = [] }: Storage) {
    21	    let baseline:
    22	        | { tables: Table[]; kvKeys: Set<string>[]; r2Keys: Set<string>[] }
    23	        | undefined;
    24	    beforeEach(async () => {
    25	        baseline ??= {
    26	            tables: db ? await readTables(db) : [],
    27	            kvKeys: await Promise.all(
    28	                kv.map(async (namespace) => new Set(await kvKeys(namespace))),
    29	            ),
    30	            r2Keys: await Promise.all(
    31	                r2.map(async (bucket) => new Set(await r2Keys(bucket))),
    32	            ),
    33	        };
    34	        const { tables, kvKeys: keptKv, r2Keys: keptR2 } = baseline;
    35	        if (db) await restoreTables(db, tables);
    36	        await Promise.all([
    37	            ...kv.map(async (namespace, i) => {
    38	                const added = (await kvKeys(namespace)).filter(
    39	                    (key) => !keptKv[i].has(key),
    40	                );
    41	                await Promise.all(added.map((key) => namespace.delete(key)));
    42	            }),
    43	            ...r2.map(async (bucket, i) => {
    44	                const added = (await r2Keys(bucket)).filter(
    45	                    (key) => !keptR2[i].has(key),
    46	                );
    47	                if (added.length > 0) await bucket.delete(added);
    48	            }),
    49	        ]);
    50	    });
    51	}
    52	
    53	async function readTables(db: D1Database): Promise<Table[]> {
    54	    const { results } = await db.prepare(TABLES_SQL).all<{ name: string }>();
    55	    return Promise.all(
    56	        results.map(async ({ name }) => ({
    57	            name,
    58	            rows: (await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM "${name}"`).all()).results,
    59	        })),
    60	    );
    61	}
    62	
    63	async function restoreTables(db: D1Database, tables: Table[]) {
    64	    await db.batch([
    65	        db.prepare("PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = ON"),
    66	        ...tables.map(({ name }) => db.prepare(`DELETE FROM "${name}"`)),
    67	        ...tables.flatMap(({ name, rows }) =>
    68	            rows.map((row) => {
    69	                const columns = Object.keys(row);
    70	                return db
    71	                    .prepare(
    72	                        `INSERT INTO "${name}" (${columns.map((column) => `"${column}"`).join(", ")}) VALUES (${columns.map(() => "?").join(", ")})`,
    73	                    )
    74	                    .bind(...Object.values(row));
    75	            }),
    76	        ),
    77	    ]);
    78	}
    79	
    80	async function kvKeys(namespace: KVNamespace) {
    81	    const keys: string[] = [];
    82	    let cursor: string | undefined;
    83	    do {
    84	        const page = await namespace.list({ cursor });
    85	        keys.push(...page.keys.map((key) => key.name));
    86	        cursor = page.list_complete ? undefined : page.cursor;
    87	    } while (cursor);
    88	    return keys;
    89	}
    90	
    91	async function r2Keys(bucket: R2Bucket) {
    92	    const keys: string[] = [];
    93	    let cursor: string | undefined;
    94	    do {
    95	        const page = await bucket.list({ cursor });
    96	        keys.push(...page.objects.map((object) => object.key));
    97	        cursor = page.truncated ? page.cursor : undefined;
    98	    } while (cursor);
    99	    return keys;
   100	}
===== shared/user-media-url.ts =====
     1	export type UserMediaUrlValidation =
     2	    | { ok: true; url: URL }
     3	    | { ok: false; reason: "invalid" | "protocol" | "private" };
     4	
     5	const BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = /^localhost$/i;
     6	
     7	function isBlockedUserMediaHost(hostname: string): boolean {
     8	    const host = hostname.replace(/^\[|\]$/g, "");
     9	    const normalized = host.toLowerCase();
    10	    if (
    11	        BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES.test(normalized) ||
    12	        normalized.endsWith(".localhost")
    13	    ) {
    14	        return true;
    15	    }
    16	
    17	    if (normalized.includes(":")) return true;
    18	
    19	    const parts = normalized.split(".").map(Number);
    20	    return (
    21	        parts.length === 4 &&
    22	        parts.every(
    23	            (part) => Number.isInteger(part) && part >= 0 && part <= 255,
    24	        )
    25	    );
    26	}
    27	
    28	/**
    29	 * Apply the same URL policy to every user-supplied media fetch: HTTP(S) only,
    30	 * with credentialed hosts, loopback names, and literal IP addresses refused.
    31	 */
    32	export function validateUserMediaUrl(value: string): UserMediaUrlValidation {
    33	    let url: URL;
    34	    try {
    35	        url = new URL(value);
    36	    } catch {
    37	        return { ok: false, reason: "invalid" };
    38	    }
    39	
    40	    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") {
    41	        return { ok: false, reason: "protocol" };
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    if (url.username || url.password || isBlockedUserMediaHost(url.hostname)) {
    45	        return { ok: false, reason: "private" };
    46	    }
    47	
    48	    return { ok: true, url };
    49	}

    11	
    12	type NonNullableValue<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T;
    13	
    14	type RemoveUnset<T> = {
    15	    [K in keyof T as T[K] extends null | undefined
    16	        ? never
    17	        : K]: NonNullableValue<T[K]>;
    18	};
    19	
    20	export function removeUnset<T extends object>(obj: T): RemoveUnset<T> {
    21	    return Object.fromEntries(
    22	        Object.entries(obj).filter(
    23	            ([_, value]) => value !== null && value !== undefined,
    24	        ),
    25	    ) as RemoveUnset<T>;
    26	}
    27	
    28	export function capitalize(str: string): string {
    29	    return `${str.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${str.slice(1)}`;
    30	}
    31	
    32	const resetColor = "\x1b[0m";
    33	
    34	export type AnsiColor =
    35	    | "black"
    36	    | "red"
    37	    | "green"
    38	    | "yellow"
    39	    | "blue"
    40	    | "magenta"
    41	    | "cyan"
    42	    | "white";
    43	
    44	const ansiColors: Record<AnsiColor, string> = {
    45	    black: "\x1b[30m",
    46	    red: "\x1b[31m",
    47	    green: "\x1b[32m",
    48	    yellow: "\x1b[33m",
    49	    blue: "\x1b[34m",
    50	    magenta: "\x1b[35m",
    51	    cyan: "\x1b[36m",
    52	    white: "\x1b[37m",
    53	};
    54	
    55	export function applyColor(color: AnsiColor, str: string): string {
    56	    return `${ansiColors[color]}${str}${resetColor}`;
    57	}

     4	export const TINYBIRD_MODEL_STATS_URL =
     5	    "https://api.europe-west2.gcp.tinybird.co/v0/pipes/public_model_stats.json?token=p.eyJ1IjogImFjYTYzZjc5LThjNTYtNDhlNC05NWJjLWEyYmFjMTY0NmJkMyIsICJpZCI6ICI5ZWZmMGM3Ni1kOTZkLTQwYjgtYWQwOC1mNDFlMmRiYjBmYTIiLCAiaG9zdCI6ICJnY3AtZXVyb3BlLXdlc3QyIn0.6VnVkAQ5h_fkcDZVDUoU38dzTxaw0xo3DnmKkhECbA8&limit=5000";
     6	const CACHE_KEY = "model-stats-v3";
     7	const CACHE_TTL = 3600; // 1 hour
     8	
     9	// Raw Tinybird response format - no transformation needed
    10	export type TinybirdModelStats = {
    11	    data: Array<{
    12	        model: string;
    13	        avg_cost_usd: number;
    14	        request_count?: number;
    15	        priced_success_count?: number;
    16	        user_count?: number;
    17	    }>;
    18	};
    19	
    20	export async function getModelStats(
    21	    kv: KVNamespace,
    22	    log: Logger,
    23	): Promise<TinybirdModelStats> {
    24	    return await cached(fetchModelStats, {
    25	        log,
    26	        ttl: CACHE_TTL,
    27	        kv,
    28	        keyGenerator: () => CACHE_KEY,
    29	    })(log);
    30	}
    31	
    32	async function fetchModelStats(log: Logger): Promise<TinybirdModelStats> {
    33	    try {
    34	        const response = await fetch(TINYBIRD_MODEL_STATS_URL);
    35	        if (!response.ok) {
    36	            throw new Error(`Tinybird API error: ${response.status}`);
    37	        }
    38	        return (await response.json()) as TinybirdModelStats;
    39	    } catch (error) {
    40	        log.error("Failed to fetch model stats from Tinybird: {error}", {
    41	            error,
    42	        });
    43	        return { data: [] };
    44	    }
    45	}
===== shared/utils/public-docs.ts =====
     1	export function isPublicEnterPath(path: string): boolean {
     2	    return (
     3	        isPublicAccountPath(path) ||
     4	        isPublicQuestCatalogPath(path) ||
     5	        isX402KeyPath(path)
     6	    );
     7	}
     8	
     9	function isPublicAccountPath(path: string): boolean {
    10	    return (
    11	        path === "/account" ||
    12	        path.startsWith("/account/") ||
    13	        path === "/api/account" ||
    14	        path.startsWith("/api/account/")
    15	    );
    16	}
    17	
    18	// Only the catalog is part of the public gen API. Session-only dashboard quest
    19	// actions stay on enter and are omitted from the merged gen docs.
    20	export function isPublicQuestCatalogPath(path: string): boolean {
    21	    return path === "/quests/catalog" || path === "/api/quests/catalog";
    22	}
    23	
    24	// x402 key purchases are only served by enter, so their public path keeps /api.
    25	export function isX402KeyPath(path: string): boolean {
    26	    return path === "/x402/keys" || path.startsWith("/x402/keys/");
    27	}
    28	
    29	export function publicEnterPath(path: string): string {
    30	    return path
    31	        .replace(/^\/api\/account(?=\/|$)/, "/account")
    32	        .replace(/^\/api\/quests(?=\/|$)/, "/quests")
    33	        .replace(/^\/x402\/keys(?=\/|$)/, "/api/x402/keys");
    34	}
===== shared/video-mime.ts =====
     1	export type VideoMimeType = "video/mp4";
     2	
     3	/** Detect the MP4 container returned by Pollinations video routes. */
     4	export function detectVideoMimeType(bytes: Uint8Array): VideoMimeType | null {
     5	    // ISO base media files (MP4 and compatible brands) start with a box size,
     6	    // followed by the `ftyp` box marker.
     7	    if (bytes.length < 16) return null;
     8	    if (
     9	        bytes[4] !== 0x66 ||
    10	        bytes[5] !== 0x74 ||
    11	        bytes[6] !== 0x79 ||
    12	        bytes[7] !== 0x70
    13	    ) {
    14	        return null;
    15	    }
    16	
    17	    const boxSize =
    18	        bytes[0] * 0x1000000 + bytes[1] * 0x10000 + bytes[2] * 0x100 + bytes[3];
    19	    // An ftyp box contains its header, major brand, and minor version. A
    20	    // truncated or oversized first box is not a valid MP4 payload.
    21	    if (boxSize < 16 || boxSize > bytes.length) return null;
    22	
    23	    // A brand header alone is not media. Walk the remaining ISO-BMFF boxes
    24	    // and require a complete media-bearing `moov` or `mdat` box. This catches
    25	    // truncated/placeholder payloads without attempting codec-level parsing.
    26	    let offset = boxSize;
    27	    let hasMediaBox = false;
    28	    while (offset < bytes.length) {
    29	        if (offset + 8 > bytes.length) return null;
    30	        const size =
    31	            bytes[offset] * 0x1000000 +
    32	            bytes[offset + 1] * 0x10000 +
    33	            bytes[offset + 2] * 0x100 +
    34	            bytes[offset + 3];
    35	        const type = String.fromCharCode(
    36	            bytes[offset + 4],
    37	            bytes[offset + 5],
    38	            bytes[offset + 6],
    39	            bytes[offset + 7],
    40	        );
    41	        if (size === 0) {
    42	            if (
    43	                offset + 8 < bytes.length &&
    44	                (type === "moov" || type === "mdat" || type === "moof")
    45	            ) {
    46	                hasMediaBox = true;
    47	            }
    48	            break;
    49	        }
    50	        if (size < 8 || offset + size > bytes.length) return null;
    51	        if (
    52	            size > 8 &&
    53	            (type === "moov" || type === "mdat" || type === "moof")
    54	        ) {
    55	            hasMediaBox = true;
    56	        }
    57	        offset += size;
    58	    }
    59	    return hasMediaBox ? "video/mp4" : null;
    60	}
